jobs.title: Chargé technico-commercial-e
jobs.description:
Nous allons réaliser ensemble  
Chargé\-e technico\-commercial\-e  
Nous allons réaliser ensemble  
En tant que Chargé·e technico commercial·e, vous apportez un soutien et une expertise technico commerciale au front office en concevant et proposant des solutions adaptées aux besoins des client·es.  
Rattachée à l’unité Solutions Clients et Partenaires, vous contribuez au développement de solutions énergétiques en coordination avec les équipes commerciales, marketing et techniques. L’unité soutient les chargé·es de client·es, développe des solutions adaptées et anime un réseau de partenaires afin de renforcer la dynamique économique locale.  
Votre énergie au service d’une Genève durable  
Dans le cadre de votre fonction vous serez amené·e à :  
Contribuer à l’étude de faisabilité technique des projets clients et à l’élaboration des offres associées ;  
Coordonner la construction des offres en lien avec les parties prenantes internes ;  
Identifier les enjeux financiers et commerciaux des client·es afin de proposer des solutions pertinentes ;  
Proposer des solutions thermiques innovantes, adaptées et compétitives ;  
Participer à la négociation des conditions commerciales et au respect des engagements contractuels ;  
Présenter les solutions technico commerciales et contribuer aux échanges en réunions de zones RTS.  
Votre personnalité et vos compétences  
Doté·e d’un excellent relationnel, vous entretenez une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs et faites preuve d’un fort esprit d’équipe. Organisé·e et orienté·e solutions, vous savez gérer les priorités et mener plusieurs projets simultanément avec autonomie. Résistant·e au stress, agile et à l’aise dans des environnements en évolution, vous adoptez une attitude positive et collaborative.  
Vous disposez d’une solide culture technique et commerciale dans les domaines thermique, solaire et de l’électromobilité. Vous maîtrisez les techniques de négociation et faites preuve d’un bon esprit d’analyse. Vous possédez également des connaissances en gestion financière de projets et êtes à l’aise dans l’animation de groupes de travail technico commerciaux.  
Votre parcours académique  
Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme d’Ingénieur·e EPF ou HES, spécialisé·e dans le domaine thermique, et justifiez de 5 à 6 ans d’expérience dans une activité commerciale, idéalement dans le secteur de l’énergie.  
Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des marchés publics et privés du territoire genevois ainsi que de la Suisse romande. Une expérience dans un bureau d’ingénieurs ou dans les métiers de l’énergie constitue un atout.  
Rejoindre SIG, c’est participer au changement !  
SIG est une entreprise publique de proximité au service de la population, des entreprises et des collectivités publiques genevoises. Elle fournit un large panel de prestations dans la distribution des énergies, de l’eau et de la valorisation des déchets. Elle s'engage, en tant que bras industriel de l'Etat de Genève, en faveur d'une transition écologique ambitieuse.  
Soucieuse de promouvoir l’égalité entre femmes et hommes ainsi que la diversité au sein de ses équipes, notre institution encourage les candidatures de toutes et tous, indépendamment de leur genre, de leur origine ou de toute autre caractéristique personnelle.  
Dans les domaines où les femmes sont actuellement sous\-représentées, les candidatures féminines sont particulièrement encouragées.

19 août 2026 jpid09403c0jm jpit0731jm jpiy26jm

jobs.description:
Teamleiter\*in Service Desk  
Per 1\. September 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung suchen wir Dich als Teamleiter\*in Service Desk  
Teamleiter\*in Service Desk  
Werde Teil unseres Teams  
Deine Arbeit hat Wirkung – für Bern und für die Menschen, die hier leben und arbeiten. Gestalte mit uns die Gemeinschaft und die Zukunft dieser Stadt: sichtbar, spürbar, nachhaltig.  
Die Direktion Finanzen, Personal und Informatik erbringt vielfältige stadtinterne Dienstleistungen und stellt zentrale Ressourcen bereit. Die Informatik Stadt Bern ist der Service\-Integrator und \-Provider für kundenorientierte und wirtschaftliche ICT\-Lösungen für die Stadtverwaltung und die Volksschulen.  
Was du bewegst  
Du führst und entwickelst das Service Desk in fachlicher, personeller und organisatorischer Hinsicht (inkl. Planung, Einsatz und Förderung der Mitarbeitenden und sowie der Lernenden)  
Du trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für das Service Desk und stellst einen professionellen, stabilen, effizienten und zukunftsorientierten IT Supportbetrieb sowie eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicher  
In deiner Rolle als Prozessowner\*in verantwortest du die dir zugewiesenen Prozesse (Incident Management, Major Incident Management und Problem Management). Die kontinuierliche Optimierung dieser Prozesse, die Steuerung relevanter KPI's sowie die Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Schnitstellen fallen dir leicht.  
Du arbeitest in interdisziplinären Teams und Gremien und wirkst in verschiedensten Projekten aktiv mit  
Du fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl und verfügst über eine ausgeprägte Hands\-on\-Mentalität. Dein Team zu unterstützen und im Tagesgeschäft aktiv mitzuwirken, ist für dich selbstverständlich  
Was du mitbringst  
abgeschlossene ICT\-Ausbildung, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF oder FH, evtl. vergleichbare Qualifikation und mehrjährige Berufserfahrung  
fundierte Kenntnisse im Prozessmanagement (Weiterentwicklung, Optimierung und Verankerung)  
ausgewiesene, mehrjährige Führungserfahrung  
hohe Kundenorientierung, Zuverlässigkeit und klare Kommunikation  
Lust und Freude, Veränderungen aktiv mitzugestalten, gepaart mit der nötigen Ruhe, Ausdauer und Lösungsorientierung  
Deine Benefits in Bern  
Für Sinn \& Stadtleben  
Bei uns veränderst du etwas. Du gestaltest das Stadtleben mit, trägst Verantwortung und machst Bern lebenswerter.  
Sicherheit \& Stabilität  
Wir bieten dir faire Bezahlung, klare Strukturen, geregelte Arbeitszeiten und langfristige Perspektiven.  
Platz für dein ganzes Leben  
Unser Arbeitsmodell passt sich, wo immer möglich, deinem Leben an. Bei uns bringst du alle Lebensbereiche in Einklang.  
Wachsen mit Bern  
Wir geben dir Raum für Entwicklung, Weiterbildung und eigenverantwortliches Handeln.  
Gesund im Alltag  
Mit Sport, Bewegung und Beratung bleibst du in Form: körperlich, mental, sozial – und das nicht nur am Arbeitsplatz.  
Vorteile für jeden Tag  
Wir bieten dir praktische Extras, die deinen Alltag erleichtern und bereichern.  
Kontakt  
Du hast Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess oder zur Arbeitgeberin Stadt Bern? Ich freue mich, dir weiterzuhelfen. Bitte keine Dossiers von Personalberatungen.  
Knüsel  
Leiter/in Personaldienstleistungen  
(Mo\-Do, ohne 5\./6\. August)  
Du möchtest mehr über diese Stelle und unser Team bei der Stadt Bern erfahren? Ich freue mich, dich kennenzulernen und helfe gerne weiter!  
Fernandez  
Bereichsleiter Kundensupport \& Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung  

Dein Bewerbungsprozess  
So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei uns ab:  
Schritt 1: Online Bewerbung  
Reiche deine Bewerbungsunterlagen online über unser Jobportal ein. Damit wir deine Unterlagen weiterbearbeiten können, musst du ein Login erstellen. Nachdem du deine Bewerbung eingereicht hast, erhältst du eine Bestätigung. Wir beurteilen jede Bewerbung individuell anhand der Kriterien im Stelleninserat. Das braucht manchmal etwas Zeit. Wenn deine Bewerbung passt, kontaktieren wir dich für ein erstes Gespräch.  
Schritt 2: Gespräche  
Im Vorstellungsgespräch \- telefonisch, vor Ort oder online \- möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Wir überprüfen, ob deine Erwartungen an die Stelle mit unseren übereinstimmen, welche Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten du mitbringst, ob dich unsere Kultur anspricht und wie du ins Team passt. Bei beidseitigem Interesse und je nach Stelle finden mehrere Gespräche statt. Alle deine Fragen zur Stelle, zum Team oder zu den Anstellungsbedingungen sind immer willkommen.  
Schritt 3: Bewerbungsentscheid  
Du bist von uns überzeugt und wir von dir? Nach einer mündlichen Zusage erhältst du eine Bestätigung, die Vertragsunterlagen und Informationen, wie es bis zum Stellenantritt weitergeht. Es hat nicht geklappt? Wir freuen uns, wenn du dich trotz Absage auf andere spannende Stellen bewirbst.  
Für Bern. Mit Herz. Mit Wirkung.  
In der Stadt Bern arbeiten über 4'500 Menschen verteilt auf fünf Direktionen und mehr als 80 Berufsbilder zusammen. Wir engagieren uns mit Leidenschaft und Überzeugung für die Menschen, die hier leben, die hier arbeiten. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gemeinschaft und die Zukunft dieser Stadt – sichtbar, spürbar, nachhaltig. Für unsere Stadt. Für Bern. jpidda2777fjm jit0731jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Access Executive Director
jobs.description:
Location: Strong preference to be based in one of the five MSF Access Regional Hubs (Rio de Janeiro, Dakar, Brussels, Nairobi, and Kuala Lumpur). Placement in associated strategic locations may be considered.

Duration: MSF office contract, minimum 3 years commitment, extendable by 3 years, according to MSF practice and subject to national labour laws

Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting to: The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date: Beginning of Q3 2026 preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL
Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND
Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:
“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”
Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION
The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access’s mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION
The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
The Executive Director’s primary responsibilities will include:
Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability
Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access
Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget
Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director

Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee

Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access

External Representation and Engagement
Representation of MSF Access in critical high-level global health and access discussions including in multilateral fora and processes, in government engagements where requested, with private sector leaders and other relevant stakeholders alongside the MSF Access MT

Steer MSF Access’s overall external partnership strategy in alignment with the broader MSF Access strategy and cultivate engagement with key global health and access stakeholders

Internal Leadership and Management
Management and coordination of key MSF Access functions (as articulated below) alongside the management team

Report to the MSF Access Board on key strategic and governance decisions and with informational updates of note, including but not limited to, major decisions relating to the content of MSF’s Access work, any material engagement with MSF leadership and governance structures, management of the MSF Access MT along with the DED, regular budgetary updates and accountabilities, and alongside the Head of Human Resources any HR issues requiring the attention of the board.

Alongside the DED and management team, translating the MSF Access Strategic Plan into annual plans for each respective body of work, including through individual projects and initiatives

Oversee development of MSF Access administrative policies and processes and addressing critical human resources issues

Development and finalization of the MSF Access annual plan and budget alongside relevant members of the management team

Representing MSF Access on the Medical Operational (MedOps) platform (which includes all medical directors and directors of operations across MSF) including participation in MedOps meetings as required

The ED is also responsible for ensuring that MSF Access fulfils its articulated responsibilities to the movement, which are:

Advise the Movement on the Common Priorities
Provide or source support on access issues to all entities that request it within MSF
Design and implement access initiatives to respond to the Common Priorities
Maintain an overview and report on access initiatives movement-wide on an annual basis
Survey and analyze the external access landscape

Job requirements
15+ years of senior management and leadership experience in global health policy, advocacy, institutional management, or humanitarian affairs

PhD or Master’s degree in health sciences (medical, (bio)medical, pharmacy) or international relations, public policy, public administration, public health with significant experience working in and knowledge of global health and access issues.
Demonstrated experience in global health and access issues in a broad range of subjects relevant to MSF’s medical humanitarian mission and operations.
Deep understanding of MSF’s operational and medical nature and its medical humanitarian mission.
Advanced managerial capabilities and experience with excellent project management capabilities, multidisciplinary teams and ability to work effectively and independently in a fast-paced environment.
Experience in developing and maintaining professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and organizations, including government officials, multilateral representatives, medical professionals, civil society, community organizations, academia, and global health donor organizations.
Experience in strategy development processes and demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.
Proven track record of external engagements and external representation; ability to actively participate in public speaking engagements, including—but not limited to—presenting at conferences, conducting print and broadcast media interviews, and representation in external meetings.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.

Note: All offers of employment will be subject to reference checks and to appropriate screening checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her/their understanding of these recruitment procedures.

jobs.title: Lead - Archive Management
jobs.description:
In short
We are establishing our first-ever Product Archive at our Zurich HQ and are ready to transition from vision to reality. We are looking for a visionary Product Archive Lead to spearhead this effort and drive it into its operational phase.

As an incredible self-starter with deep roots in the cultural sector, you will be the custodian of our Design heritage. With the Archive you will manage a dynamic, multi-faceted ecosystem: serving as an internal creative engine for our designers, an external-facing cultural landmark in the heart of Zurich, and a secure digital repository for our innovation. This is an opportunity to bridge our rich history with our future creative ambitions, turning our archive into a world-class inspiration hub.

Your Mission
- Establish the Center of Competence: Define and execute a holistic archive strategy. You will develop the criteria for our collection, ensuring it serves as a rigorous, authoritative, and accessible knowledge base that fuels internal research and preserves our brand DNA for the long term.
- Oversee Physical Stewardship: Manage the full lifecycle of our physical collections. This includes depot planning, organization, and qualification processes, as well as the identification and documentation of previously unrecorded object groups (shoes, textiles, accessories) and long-term conservation.
- Drive Digital & Data Infrastructure: Architect our digital repository. You will lead the implementation and integration of archive databases, ensuring seamless data flow with internal systems, and overseeing metadata standards (keywording, photo documentation) to make our history searchable and usable.
- Bridge the Past, Present, and Future: Partner with Design and Product teams to establish the archive as a functional, high-access creative engine. You will build the workflows that allow teams to search, borrow, and analyze historical product references, ensuring our past innovations directly inform and inspire current seasonal concepts.
- Collaborate on Cultural Engagement: Partner with our exhibition programming team to position the archive as a cultural landmark. You will provide the necessary historical context, exhibit curation, and material expertise to bring our brand stories to life through internal and external showcases.
- Operational Excellence: Manage the archive’s working budget, vendor relationships, and IT collaborations to ensure the archive functions as a high-performance, future-proof service.

Your story
- Heritage & Cultural Expert: You possess a deep background in managing high-value archives, heritage collections, or design museums (6-8 years of experience). You are comfortable engaging with the cultural sector and understand how to translate institutional history into a compelling modern narrative.
- Meticulous & Precise: Your approach is defined by rigorous organization. You thrive in the details of inventory management, documentation, and data standards, ensuring that every object in our care is perfectly accounted for and categorized.
- Systems Thinker: You are as comfortable with database architecture as you are with physical conservation. You can define, implement, and maintain complex systems that ensure data flows seamlessly from our past into our digital tools.
- Collaborative & Communicative: You are a natural bridge-builder. You possess the diplomacy to work across departments—from IT and Finance to Design and Marketing—and you thrive in a team environment where knowledge-sharing is the priority.
- Narrative Driven: You excel at bringing our heritage to life, transforming archival records into compelling stories. You have a unique ability to uncover the "why" behind past design decisions and can translate that historical context into actionable, relevant insights for designers working today.
- Strategic Self-Starter: You don’t wait for instructions to build a process. You are an autonomous project lead who can manage budgets, external vendors, and multi-year timelines with the agility required in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

About the Team
You will report directly to the Chief of Staff (CoS) of Design, sitting at the heart of a vibrant and diverse Design Studio that drives On’s disruptive product design across footwear, apparel, and accessories. We are a team that values creativity, curiosity, and collaboration, and we are looking for someone who shares our passion for turning the "why" of our past into the "what's next" of our future.

jobs.title: Infirmier
jobs.description:
Infirmier  
Infirmier·ère en santé mentale – Dès le 1er novembre 2026, rejoignez une équipe qui place l'humain au cœur de son engagement  
À la Fondation Stanislas, nous sommes convaincus qu'un accompagnement de qualité repose avant tout sur les femmes et les hommes qui le rendent possible chaque jour.  
Notre ambition est simple : ne jamais cesser de progresser. Nous remettons continuellement nos pratiques en question, développons nos compétences et cherchons ensemble les meilleures réponses aux besoins de nos clients. Cette culture de l'amélioration continue fait partie intégrante de notre identité.  
Pour y parvenir, nous recherchons des professionnels expérimentés ou des personnes désireuses de développer leur expertise. Mais, au\-delà des compétences techniques, nous recherchons avant tout des personnalités humaines, bienveillantes et engagées, qui partagent notre envie de faire la différence auprès des personnes que nous accompagnons. Chez nous, les qualités relationnelles, l'écoute, le respect et l'esprit d'équipe ont autant de valeur que les compétences professionnelles.  
Votre mission  
En tant qu'Établissement psycho\-social médicalisé (EPSM), conformément à notre mission de maintien et de réhabilitation, nous offrons à nos clients un accompagnement global 7 jours sur 7 et 24 heures sur 24\. Nous proposons des prestations de soins adaptées aux besoins temporaires ou chroniques de nos usagers, un soutien logistique ainsi qu'un accompagnement socio\-éducatif favorisant le maintien des habiletés dans les activités de la vie quotidienne.  
Au sein de l'équipe psychosociale, vous accompagnez des personnes concernées par une problématique de santé mentale dans leur parcours de rétablissement grâce à un accompagnement individualisé.  
En qualité d'infirmier·ère, vous :  
dispensez des soins de qualité dans des situations parfois complexes et évolutives ;  
jouez un rôle central dans la coordination des projets d'accompagnement avec les partenaires internes et externes ;  
participez activement à une prise en charge interdisciplinaire centrée sur les besoins et les ressources des clients ;  
contribuez, par vos idées et votre expertise, à l'évolution continue de nos pratiques.  
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  
Rejoindre la Fondation Stanislas aujourd'hui, c'est intégrer une institution à taille humaine qui investit dans son avenir… et dans celui de ses collaborateurs.  
La Fondation a récemment mis à l'enquête un ambitieux projet de reconstruction de son établissement sur son site actuel. Ce futur bâtiment offrira un environnement de travail moderne, fonctionnel et pensé aussi bien pour le bien\-être des clients que pour celui des professionnels. Une formidable opportunité de participer à cette nouvelle étape de notre histoire et d'évoluer demain dans des infrastructures de grande qualité.  
Nous vous offrons également :  
un cadre de travail agréable au sein d'une institution à taille humaine ;  
l'opportunité de participer activement aux projets institutionnels ;  
la possibilité d'assumer des responsabilités particulières en fonction de vos compétences ;  
un accompagnement dans votre développement professionnel grâce à des formations continues ;  
l'accès à la médecine du travail ;  
des conditions de travail et des prestations salariales conformes à la CCT du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois.  
Votre profil  
Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bachelor en soins infirmiers ou d'un titre jugé équivalent.  
Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée en psychiatrie adulte ou en santé mentale, ou vous avez une réelle volonté de développer votre expertise dans ce domaine.  
Vous êtes titulaire d'un permis de conduire, disposez d'un véhicule et résidez à environ 45 minutes de notre établissement afin d'assurer le service de piquet.  
Surtout, vous êtes une personne :  
profondément humaine et bienveillante ;  
reconnue pour son écoute et la qualité de ses relations ;  
motivée à s'investir durablement auprès des clients et de ses collègues ;  
appréciant le travail en équipe et la collaboration interdisciplinaire ;  
organisée, réflexive et capable de s'adapter aux changements ;  
convaincue par une approche orientée vers le rétablissement.  
Envie de construire l'avenir avec nous ?  
Si vous souhaitez exercer votre métier dès le 1er novembre 2026 dans une institution où l'exigence professionnelle s'allie à des valeurs humaines fortes, où chacun peut contribuer à faire évoluer les pratiques et où un projet d'établissement ambitieux se dessine, nous serons heureux de faire votre connaissance.  
Vous pouvez nous transmettre votre dossier de candidature diretement par JobUp. Vous recevrez dans tous les cas une réponse si vous répondez aux critères. Le processus de sélection se fera dès le 19 août 2026\. jpidd0938adjm jpit0731jm jpiy26jm

jobs.title: Bilingual Primary Teacher / Headteacher, Lausanne Region
jobs.description:
Bilingual Primary Teacher / Headteacher, Lausanne Region  
A rare opportunity to help shape a small, high\-quality bilingual educational project from an early stage.  
A hands\-on role combining pedagogy, structure, and meaningful engagement with children and families.  
We are opening a new boutique bilingual primary school project in the Lausanne area and are looking for an experienced and inspiring educator to help guide and shape the project as it enters its next phase of development.  
This is a rare opportunity to contribute to an educational environment with a clear vision: combining strong Montessori foundations with a carefully guided transition towards structured academic learning.  
Alongside this role, we are continuing to build a small, high\-quality teaching team and welcome interest from experienced teachers who may wish to contribute to the project.  
The school:  
We are developing a small, family\-oriented primary environment, typically serving children from ages 4 through the later primary years.  
The early years (ages 4–6\) are fully Montessori. From age 6 onwards, children transition progressively into more structured academic learning, drawing on a broader range of complementary child\-centred pedagogical approaches, while maintaining a strong emphasis on independence, clarity of thinking, and academic excellence.  
The school is fully bilingual (French–English), with the aim of developing real fluency and academic capability in both languages.  
We place particular importance on individual attention, pastoral care, and a strong sense of community.  
The project is rooted in a spiritually open, non\-denominational approach, welcoming families of all backgrounds, and fostering respect, reflection, and a sense of meaning. This extends naturally into a strong connection with nature, outdoor learning, and the surrounding environment.  
The project is based in a warm, intimate setting with a private garden and outdoor play area, as well as nearby green spaces. The project builds on prior experience within a school\-designated setting.  
The project also benefits from access to an alpine environment in the Verbier region, supporting seasonal outdoor activities and contributing to a broader approach to physical development, resilience, and experiential learning.  
A core group of families, children, and educators is already engaged with the educational project, and we are now looking to bring additional structure and leadership as the project develops.  
Structure:  
The project combines a full\-time school programme aligning with the PER alongside a hybrid section supporting families from the homeschooling community already connected to the broader educational project.  
The role:  
The successful candidate will play a central, hands\-on role in the life of the project, working in close partnership with the founders to help shape and develop the school over time.  
This includes leading or supporting the day\-to\-day running, bringing structure and clarity to a growing environment, contributing to curriculum and educational development, guiding the Montessori to academic transition, and working closely with teachers and families.  
For candidates with appropriate experience and interest, the role may evolve towards broader pedagogical and organisational leadership within the school.  
As the project develops, the role may also involve engaging with relevant local authorities and contributing to the project’s formal structuring and development.  
This is a practical, engaged role with a strong presence in the classroom environment.  
Profile:  
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in both French and English, holds recognised teaching qualifications, and has experience with primary\-aged children.  
The role would suit someone who enjoys being actively involved in the classroom, is happy to teach and support when needed, and brings a grounded, practical approach. A natural ease with children and an interest in building a school environment over time are essential.  
Experience with Montessori and/or international education would be an advantage.  
Team:  
We are also recruiting a small number of teaching positions to complement the existing team, particularly in French, science, mathematics, and physical education.  
Experienced teachers who are interested in contributing to a small, high\-quality bilingual environment are welcome to apply directly via this advert.  
Why join:  
This is an opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a project at an early but already active stage, within a small, high\-quality environment where relationships and impact are real.  
Applications:  
Please send your CV and a short note outlining your experience and educational approach.  
Bilingual Primary Teacher / Headteacher, Lausanne Region  
Une occasion rare de contribuer à façonner un projet éducatif bilingue de petite taille et de grande qualité dès ses premières étapes.  
Un rôle concret alliant pédagogie, organisation et engagement significatif auprès des enfants et des familles.  
Nous ouvrons un nouveau projet d’école primaire bilingue à taille humaine dans la région de Lausanne et recherchons un(e) éducateur(trice) expérimenté(e) et inspirant(e) pour accompagner et façonner le projet dans sa prochaine phase de développement.  
Il s’agit d’une occasion rare de contribuer à un environnement éducatif doté d’une vision claire : associer de solides fondements Montessori à une transition soigneusement accompagnée vers un apprentissage académique structuré.  
Parallèlement à ce poste, nous continuons à constituer une petite équipe enseignante de grande qualité et accueillons également les candidatures d’enseignants expérimentés souhaitant contribuer au projet.  
L’école :  
Nous développons un environnement primaire de petite taille, à caractère familial, accueillant généralement des enfants de 4 ans jusqu’aux dernières années du primaire.  
Les premières années (4–6 ans) sont entièrement Montessori. À partir de 6 ans, les enfants passent progressivement à un apprentissage académique plus structuré, s’appuyant sur un éventail plus large d’approches pédagogiques complémentaires centrées sur l’enfant, tout en maintenant un fort accent sur l’autonomie, la clarté de la pensée et l’excellence académique.  
L’école est entièrement bilingue (français–anglais), avec pour objectif de développer une véritable maîtrise et des compétences académiques dans les deux langues.  
Nous accordons une importance particulière à l’attention individuelle, à l’accompagnement pastoral et à un fort esprit de communauté.  
Le projet repose sur une approche spirituellement ouverte et non confessionnelle, accueillant des familles de tous horizons et favorisant le respect, la réflexion et le sens. Cette approche s’étend naturellement à un lien fort avec la nature, l’apprentissage en plein air et l’environnement.  
Le projet est installé dans un cadre chaleureux et intime, avec un jardin privé et un espace de jeux extérieur, ainsi que des espaces verts à proximité. Il s’appuie sur une expérience antérieure au sein d’un établissement déjà affecté à un usage scolaire.  
Le projet bénéficie également d’un accès à un environnement alpin dans la région de Verbier, favorisant des activités de plein air saisonnières et contribuant à une approche plus large du développement physique, de la résilience et de l’apprentissage par l’expérience.  
Un noyau de familles, d’enfants et d’éducateurs est déjà engagé dans le projet éducatif, et nous cherchons désormais à apporter davantage de structure et de leadership à mesure que le projet se développe.  
Structure :  
Le projet combine un programme scolaire à temps plein conforme au PER avec une section hybride destinée à accompagner des familles issues de la communauté de l’instruction à domicile déjà liée au projet éducatif dans son ensemble.  
Le poste :  
La personne retenue jouera un rôle central et concret dans la vie du projet, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les fondateurs afin de contribuer au développement de l’école au fil du temps.  
Cela comprend la direction ou le soutien au fonctionnement quotidien, l’apport de structure et de clarté dans un environnement en développement, la contribution au développement pédagogique et curriculaire, l’accompagnement de la transition entre Montessori et l’enseignement académique, ainsi qu’un travail étroit avec les enseignants et les familles.  
Pour les candidats disposant de l’expérience et de l’intérêt nécessaires, le poste pourra évoluer vers des responsabilités plus larges de direction pédagogique et organisationnelle au sein de l’école.  
À mesure que le projet se développe, le rôle pourra également impliquer des échanges avec les autorités locales compétentes ainsi qu’une contribution à la structuration et au développement formels du projet.  
Il s’agit d’un rôle pratique et engagé, avec une forte présence dans l’environnement de la classe.  
Profil :  
Nous recherchons une personne à l’aise en français et en anglais, titulaire de qualifications reconnues dans l’enseignement et possédant une expérience auprès d’enfants d’âge primaire.  
Ce poste conviendra à une personne qui apprécie d’être activement impliquée en classe, qui est heureuse d’enseigner et d’apporter son soutien lorsque cela est nécessaire, et qui adopte une approche pragmatique et concrète. Une aisance naturelle avec les enfants ainsi qu’un intérêt pour la construction d’un environnement scolaire dans la durée sont essentiels.  
Une expérience en pédagogie Montessori et/ou dans l’enseignement international constituerait un atout.  
Équipe :  
Nous recrutons également un petit nombre d’enseignants afin de compléter l’équipe existante, notamment en français, sciences, mathématiques et éducation physique.

Weitere Informationen unter streamnow AG \- Wir digitalisieren Immobilien.  
Du suchst eine neue Herausforderung im Bereich Gebäudedigitalisierung und möchtest digitale Lösungen direkt in der Praxis umsetzen? Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir dich als  
Techniker / Projektleiter Gebäudedigitalisierung (m/w/d), 80\-100 %  
Dein Arbeitsort ist unser Hauptsitz in Opfikon, mit Einsatzgebiet in der ganzen Schweiz.

In dieser Rolle leitest du Digitalisierungsprojekte End\-to\-End \- von der Konfiguration unserer Plattform bis zur Abnahme beim Kunden.

Von Vorteil leitest oder begleitest du zusätzlich Software\- und Webseitenprojekte (z. B. Immobilien\-Vermarktungsseiten oder Areal\-Plattformen) \- von der Anforderungsaufnahme über das Requirements Engineering bis zum Go\-live.

Darüber hinaus verfügst du über ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für Software\-Konfigurationen, Web\-Interfaces und APIs und bewegst dich sicher in digitalen und webbasierten Systemen.  
Von Vorteil bringst du grundlegende Programmierkenntnisse (z. B. HTML/CSS, JavaScript, PHP oder ) mit, welche das Requirements Engineering in Software\- und Webseitenprojekten unterstützen.  
Zudem hast du gute Kenntnisse in der Netzwerktechnik (TCP/IP, WLAN, Switching, PoE, VLAN) sowie idealerweise Erfahrung in der Gebäudetechnik (z. B. KNX, BACnet, DALI) und mit Zutrittssystemen (z. B. Salto, Glutz, dormakaba).

jobs.title: Assistant Professorship tenure track for Climate Research
jobs.description:
Assistant Professorship tenure track for Climate Research  
We are seeking candidates at the intersection of climate research and geography. You have expertise in concepts and theories related to climate interactions with respect to present and future environments. You have demonstrable skills in the modelling and analysis of spatio\-temporal variability of climate and associated uncertainties. You have experience in integrating climate change scenarios and model outputs in your work (e.g., for informing climate adaptation). Your research shows evidence of open and reproducible research practices, and you have an interest in communicating the results of your work to policymakers and the public. You have a developing track record in terms of research output, acquisition of third\-party funding, and teaching and mentoring.  
Assistant Professorship tenure track for Climate Research  
Autumn 2027 (negotiable)  
As a future assistant professor, you will strengthen the scientific impact and societal role of the Department of Geography (GIUZ). You will also contribute to teaching and its further development at both Bachelor and Master levels, in both Geography and Earth Systems Science, in particular introducing our students to the fundamentals of atmosphere and climate, and teaching on topics such as climate impacts, statistical data analysis or climate extremes. You will teach in English and German, and if you have not already mastered German you are prepared to do so in the future. You will supervise Master and PhD students in topics related to your field.  
UZH sees researchers as modern leaders who conduct excellent research through their own research projects and the promotion of excellent junior researchers, who constructively work with university administration and who help to shape a future\-oriented University with innovative research\-based teaching. Situated in the open\-minded and family\-friendly city of Zurich, which combines the vibrant cultural scene of a modern European city with the convenient accessibility to its beautiful natural surroundings, UZH is well integrated in the city's community and research environment.  
UZH provides generous research support, including dedicated funds for personnel and operating expenses, and competitive start\-up packages. Additionally, the successful applicant is expected to acquire external research funding. Zurich's scientific environment encompasses a rich spectrum of diverse activities.  
The employment conditions for this position follow UZH's legal regulations and include part\-time options. UZH is an equal\-opportunities employer, and the Faculty of Science, in particular, strives to increase the percentage of women and underrepresented groups in leading positions. Therefore, qualified female researchers are particularly encouraged to apply. Care\-time interruptions are considered during the evaluation of applicants of all genders.  
What we offer  
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers.  
Location  
Department of Geography  
Information on your application  
Applicants are kindly invited to submit their applications, which should include:  
a cover letter (. 1 page)  
a Curriculum Vitae with date of submission, including teaching and supervisory track record; outreach activities; a list of acquired competitive funding, including role and amount awarded to the candidate  
a description of their research outputs relevant for this application and their importance for the field (at most five outputs, . 1 page in total)  
a research plan describing their mid\-term scientific strategy and expected impact (. 2 pages)  
a teaching reflection on their educational values, tools and methods, and their potential contribution to the curriculum development at UZH (. 1 page)  
a description of their track record and/or planned measures towards diversity, equality, inclusion, and sustainability (. 0\.5 page)  
a list of publications and other research outputs, including dataset, code, etc.  
a copy of their PhD certificate  
Please note that page limitations do not include references.  
The evaluation processes at UZH and its Faculty of Science follow the DORA recommendations for assessing research quality and impact. Applicants are thus asked to refrain from referring to non\-personal measures such as impact factors.  
Please upload your application to by 31 August 2026\. The interviews will take place on 05 and 06 November 2026\.  
For further information, please contact Prof. Dr. Ross Purves ([Write an email](<>)).

jobs.description:
Senior Specialist Metabolic Health \- Hormone Regulation  
The Nestlé Group is the world's largest food and beverage company with 92\.6 billion Swiss Francs in sales in 2019\. It is present in 187 countries around the world, has 403 factories and its 291'000 employees are committed to Nestlé's purpose of enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. Nestlé offers a wide portfolio of products and services for people and their pets throughout their lives. Its more than 2000 brands range from global icons like Nescafé or Nespresso to local favourites. Company performance is driven by its Nutrition, Health and Wellness strategy. Nestlé is based in the Swiss town of Vevey where it was founded more than 150 years ago. Learn more about our Group and reasons to join us on  
Senior Specialist Metabolic Health \- Hormone Regulation  
Location: Vers\-chez\-les\-, Switzerland  
Work model: Hybrid / Full time  
Contract type / duration: Permanent  
Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.  
As a Senior Specialist Metabolic Health \- Hormone Regulation at Nestlé Research, your mission is to advance nutrition\-based health solutions by deepening scientific understanding of how hormonal regulation influences metabolic health, body composition and physiological functions. You'll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, innovation partners and technical teams across Nestlé Research and the wider research and development community. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.  
How you'll make an impact as a Senior Specialist Metabolic Health \- Hormone Regulation  
Leading research that links nutrition, hormonal regulation and metabolic health to create new health\-focused innovation opportunities.  
Translating scientific evidence on gut hormones, insulin sensitivity, sex hormones and body composition into actionable nutrition concepts.  
Developing mechanistic insights that help move scientific observations into clear modes of action and stronger health recommendations.  
Building external scientific networks in metabolic health, endocrinology and women's health to strengthen collaboration and future innovation.  
Contributing high\-quality scientific outputs, including research milestones, publications, presentations and innovation inputs.  
Inspiring cross\-functional teams and supporting junior team members through coaching and mentoring, while connecting deep scientific expertise with practical nutrition solutions that improve health outcomes.  
What will make you successful  
Bringing a PhD or MD/PhD with recognized scientific expertise in metabolic health and hormone regulation, including gut\-derived hormones, insulin sensitivity and sex hormones, with extensive years of relevant experience.  
Applying experience in nutritional interventions, health outcomes and human physiology to generate robust scientific insights.  
Using project leadership, stakeholder engagement and scientific communication skills to turn evidence into meaningful innovation.  
Collaborating with curiosity, agility and creativity across research, technology and innovation teams.  
Communicating fluently in English.  
Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing\-oriented mindset.

jobs.title: Research Engineer - Nanofabrication 80-100%
jobs.description:
Research Engineer \- Nanofabrication 80\-100%  
The Institute PSI is the largest research institute for natural and engineering sciences within Switzerland. We perform cutting\-edge research in the fields of future technologies, energy and climate, health innovation and fundamentals of nature. By performing fundamental and applied research, we work on sustainable solutions for major challenges facing society, science and economy. PSI is committed to the training of future generations. Therefore, about one quarter of our staff are post\-docs, post\-graduates or apprentices. Altogether, PSI employs 2300 people.  
Enable cutting\-edge research through world\-class nanofabrication infrastructure  
The Nanotechnology Group at the Institute (PSI) is looking for a motivated Research Engineer \- Nanofabrication to support the operation and continuous development of the PICO (Park Innovaare Cleanroom for Optics and Innovation) facility.  
This interdisciplinary position combines hands\-on cleanroom work, software development, scientific instrumentation, and research infrastructure management. Approximately half of your time will be spent working in the cleanroom, while the other half will focus on developing and maintaining the digital infrastructure that enables efficient operation of the facility.  
Rather than supporting a single research project, you will help build and continuously improve the infrastructure that enables hundreds of researchers from academia and industry to perform world\-class science.  
Research Engineer \- Nanofabrication 80\-100%  
Your tasks  
Develop and optimize nanofabrication processes with a focus on direct\-write laser lithography and wet chemical processing  
Become the technical expert and equipment owner for the DWL lithography systems and additional cleanroom equipment, including commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, and user support  
Develop, improve, and maintain the software infrastructure supporting cleanroom operation, including the time\-tracking system used for facility access management and billing, process database and PICO website  
Provide technical and administrative support to cleanroom users, organize user training, and contribute to a positive user experience within an international research environment  
Ensure accurate documentation, facility usage tracking, and invoicing according to the requirements of different funding agencies  
Diagnose technical problems on laboratory equipment and, whenever feasible, repair electronic and mechanical issues  
Support collaborative R\&D projects with PSI research groups as well as academic and industrial partners  
Contribute to the continuous improvement of the PICO cleanroom infrastructure and its digital ecosystem  
Your profile  
We are looking for a person who enjoys building reliable research infrastructure and continuously improving laboratory operations. Success in this position requires curiosity, technical versatility, and a systematic way of working.  
A Master's degree (MSc) or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Microengineering, Nanotechnology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline  
Enthusiasm for combining cleanroom work with software development, scientific instrumentation, and research infrastructure  
Experience programming in and an interest in developing scientific software. Experience with PHP, databases, web technologies, or software automation is an advantage  
A structured, systematic, and detail\-oriented working style. You enjoy maintaining accurate documentation and organizing operational processes such as facility usage tracking and invoicing  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, ideally with experience diagnosing and/or repairing laboratory or electronic equipment  
Excellent communication skills and a service\-oriented mindset. You enjoy working with researchers from diverse scientific backgrounds and helping them succeed  
Experience with cleanroom technologies is required, direct\-write lithography, or semiconductor processing is a strong advantage  
Excellent command of English. German language skills are an advantage  
We offer  
A highly interdisciplinary role combining nanofabrication, software engineering, scientific instrumentation, and research infrastructure  
The opportunity to become the technical expert for state\-of\-the\-art direct\-write laser lithography systems and other advanced cleanroom equipment  
A modern cleanroom facility supporting leading\-edge research in nanotechnology, quantum technologies, photonics, microfabrication, and advanced materials  
Collaboration with internationally recognized researchers and industrial partners  
A stimulating working environment with a high degree of independence, responsibility, and opportunities for professional development  
Competitive employment conditions at one of Europe's leading multidisciplinary research institutes  
If you enjoy combining engineering, software development, cleanroom work, and user interaction, and would like to help build the research infrastructure that enables tomorrow's scientific breakthroughs, we look forward to receiving your application.  
For further information, please contact Dr. Vitaliy Guzenko, mail: [Write an email](<>)  
Please submit your application online for the position as a Research Engineer \- Nanofabrication 80\-100% (Index\-Nr. ).

jobs.title: Podinspektor do spraw ochrony środowiska K/M
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: 1.Prowadzenie spraw związanych z wydawaniem zezwoleń na usuwanie drzew i krzewów oraz wymierzanie kar za samodzilnie usunięcie drzew i krzewów. Prowadzenie w tym zakresie ewidencji wniosków, protokołów, oględzin i decyzji
2.Rozpatrywanie wiosków dotyczących wykonywania cięć technicznych drzew na terenie Miasta oraz nadzór nad ich realizacją
3.Utrzymanie zieleni miejskiej na terenach komunalnych. Nadzór nad utrzymaniem rabat, kwietników, donic oraz zieleńców
4.Nadzór nad utrzymaniem Parku Miejskiego przy ul. Drawskiej
5.Prowadzenie spraw związanych z ochroną środkowiska,a zwłaszcza:
-rozpatrywanie skarg dotyczących zanieczyszczenia środkowiska
- prowadzenie i udostępnianie informacji o środkowisku i jego ochronie
- opracowywanie i aktualizacja Programu Ochrony Środowiska
6. Prowadzenie rejestru pomników przyrody oraz nadzór nad pracami związanymiz pielęgnacją pomników
7. Prowadzenie spraw związanych z wydawaniem decyzji środowiskowych
8. Nadzór nad utrzymaniem cmentarzy komunalnych
9. Prowadzenie rejestru psów ras uznanych za agresywne oraz spraw związanych z ochroną zwierząt
10. Realizacja programu opieki nad zwierzętami bezdomnymi
11. Opiniowanie projektów prac geologicznych
12. Nadzór nad gospodarką wodną i funkcjonowaniem gospodarki ściekowej
13. Kontrola likwidowanych szamb, prowadzenie ewidencji szamb na terenie Miasta i ich kontrola
14. Regulowanie opłaty stałej i zmiennej za usługi wodne- odprowadzanie wód  opadowych i roztopowych
15. Udział w realizacji zadań wynikających z planu zarządzania kryzysowego Urzędu ,iasta Świdwin w zakresie ochrony środowiska
16. Bieżące zastępstwo pracownika zatrudnionego na stanowisku ds. gospodarki odpadami.

jobs.title: Pracownik socjalny (K/M)
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: - rozpoznawanie oraz analiza indywidualnych potrzeb mieszkańców danego rejonu we współpracy z asystentem rodziny,
- przeprowadzanie rodzinnych wywiadów środowiskowych,
- wprowadzanie i aktualizowanie wywiadów środowiskowych do systemu, wydawanie decyzji administracyjnych w oparciu o wywiad środowiskowy oraz ustawę o pomocy społecznej, przygotowywanie list wypłat, sprawozdań,
- wspieranie rodzin przeżywających trudności opiekuńczo-wychowawcze w tym w szczególności współpraca w tym zakresie z asystentem rodziny,
- współdziałanie z placówkami oświaty, służby zdrowia, organami Policji i Sądem oraz kuratorami sądowymi,
- prowadzenie indywidualnej pracy socjalnej w oparciu o kontrakt socjalny,
- prowadzenie środowiskowej pracy socjalnej,
- informowanie o możliwościach korzystania z pomocy, a także kontaktowanie podopiecznych Ośrodka z odpowiednimi placówkami, instytucjami i organizacjami,\
- realizacja zadań wynikających z innych ustaw, w tym w szczególności z ustawy o przeciwdziałaniu przemocy w rodzinie, ustawy o ochronie zdrowia psychicznego, ustawy o wychowaniu w trzeźwości i przeciwdziałaniu alkoholizmowi, ustawy o zatrudnieniu socjalnym oraz ustawy o pomocy obywatelom Ukrainy w związku z konfliktem zbrojnym na terytorium tego państwa,
- pobudzanie społecznej aktywności w zaspokajaniu niezbędnych potrzeb osób i rodzin,
- inicjowanie nowych form pracy i pomocy osobom i rodzinom w trudnej sytuacji życiowej,
- prowadzenie dokumentacji środowisk objętych pomocą i realizowanych zadań,
- realizacja innych zadań wynikających z ustawy o pomocy społecznej, mających na celu ochronę poziomu życia osób i rodzin, w tym lokalnych i rządowych programów osłonowych,
- analiza i ocena zjawisk rodzących zapotrzebowanie na świadczenia pomocy społecznej,
- opracowywanie i przedkładanie danych właściwym komórkom organizacyjnym, w celach analitycznych i statystycznych
- inicjowanie lub współuczestniczenie w działaniach profilaktycznych nakierowanych na zapobieganie lub łagodzenie problemów społecznych,

jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: - opracowywanie i realizacja planu pracy z rodziną we współpracy z członkami rodziny oraz pracownikiem socjalnym;

jobs.title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
jobs.description:
Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  
Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.  
The Department of Process Engineering (ENG) has a vacancy for a  
Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  
Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  
The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.  
This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in Sumo, which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design.  
We are looking for a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. The preferred starting date is September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\.

About Millennium
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

The Portfolio Manager will support a Senior Portfolio Manager in the systematic trading of interest rate derivatives, cross-currency products, and long-dated currency derivatives across developed and emerging markets, generating high-quality risk-adjusted returns through the effective deployment of allocated Firm capital.

What You’ll Do
Formulate and implement relative value investment strategies across global fixed income and macro markets.
Manage a multi-currency, multi-product portfolio with a focus on generating strong risk-adjusted returns through disciplined risk-taking and scalable capital deployment.
Identify and execute trading opportunities across linear and non-linear rates products, including swaps, options, cross-currency instruments, sovereign rates products, and related macro instruments.
Conduct fundamental and quantitative analysis across macroeconomic, geopolitical, central bank, and market-technical factors to generate trade ideas and inform portfolio positioning.
Develop and enhance analytical infrastructure, data frameworks, and tools, including PnL analytics, PCA modelling and back testing, to support investment decision-making, portfolio construction, and risk management.
Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders and external counterparties to support effective portfolio implementation, market access, and trading outcomes.
Monitor positions, exposures, liquidity, and risk limits on an ongoing basis, and optimize execution and trade efficiency on a cost-adjusted basis.
Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory, legal, and internal policy requirements.

Qualifications/ Skills Required
At a minimum a Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, or a closely related quantitative discipline.
Minimum of 10 years of experience trading global fixed income rates and macro markets (including G10 markets with a specific focus on Japan and Australia), with substantial expertise in interest rate derivatives, cross-currency products, and related relative value strategies - specifically Interest Rate Swaps (IRS), Cross-Currency Swaps (Xccy), and Bonds.
Minimum of 2–3 years of portfolio management experience managing a macro / interest rate / FX relative value investment strategy within an institutional trading environment.
Experience operating successfully in a high-performance trading environment and working collaboratively within a team of investment professionals.
Demonstrated experience managing multi-currency, multi-product portfolios across both developed and emerging markets.

jobs.title: Head of Finance - Banking
jobs.description:
Description de l'entreprise  
Client:  
Head of Finance \- Banking  
Description de l'entreprise  
Client:  
A well\-established financial institution \- Banking Category 5 FINMA. A small yet busy and highly successful office that has been established in Geneva for over 40 years. Our client provides traditional private banking services and is recognised as a highly respected global brand with strong ethics, values, and an excellent reputation within its field. Backed by a strong shareholder base and solid credit rating, the bank offers a stable and reputable platform combined with modern, state\-of\-the\-art offices in central Geneva (Rive Gauche). This opportunity offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution at C\-suite\-equivalent level within a dynamic and close\-knit environment.  
Description du poste  
The Role:  
Within this banking environment, the Head of Finance role will lead a small team while remaining highly hands\-on. This is effectively a CFO/COO/CRO\-type position within a reputable FINMA\-regulated institution, combining finance, operations, treasury, and risk oversight in one broad and varied remit. The role is responsible for ensuring the smooth running of accounting, operational, treasury, and risk management processes, while supervising a team of four people in total, including operations and accounting staff. The team's primary focus is financial controlling, reporting, and accounting, with additional responsibility for treasury and risk management matters.  
Working very closely with the CEO, this executive position plays a central role in overseeing financial operations, compliance, back office activities, and risk management across the business. The role requires full\-time presence in the Geneva office; remote working is not available. This is a genuinely unique opportunity within the Geneva banking market, offering a candidate from a banking background broader visibility, increased responsibility, and a greater diversity of tasks than would typically be found in a larger structure. The position offers real autonomy, close interaction with senior management, and long\-term career potential within a stable and highly reputable institution.  
Key Responsibilities (including but not limited to):  
Supervise daily accounting, treasury, and back\-office activities, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and regulatory compliance.  
Monitor and manage operational, financial, and compliance risks, including asset management and investment\-related matters.  
Review monthly financial statements and ensure timely legal and FINMA reporting.  
Implement, improve, and adapt internal procedures and controls, including follow\-up on audit recommendations.  
Support HR\-related processes including payroll, social security, and insurance administration.  
Participate in internal committees and coordinate ad hoc projects requested by senior management.  
Prepare Board documentation and reporting in close coordination with the CEO.  
Why Join:  
Opportunity to join a small, agile, and successful team with direct impact on operations and strategic decision\-making.  
Broad and visible role with genuine autonomy and exposure to senior management.  
Entrepreneurial and pragmatic working environment with varied responsibilities.  
Long\-term opportunity within a stable, globally respected financial institution with an excellent reputation.  
Profil recherché  
Profile:  
10\+ years of experience within accounting, finance, and Swiss banking risk management, including FINMA reporting.  
Previous experience as CFO, Head of Finance, or within a Big 4 environment auditing small Swiss banks.  
Hands\-on management style with experience supervising small teams and operational processes.  
Previous exposure to Swiss Category 4 or 5 banks is a must.  
Good understanding of compliance, operational risk, credit risk, and treasury management.  
Fluent or mother\-tongue French with fluent English.  
Strong IT and systems skills.  
Swiss resident preferred; cross\-border commuters may also be considered.  
Available for a permanent, full\-time contract (no home office).

jobs.title: Veterinær eller fiskehelsebiolog
jobs.description:
Er du ein engasjert veterinær eller fiskehelsebiolog som vil arbeide med akvakultur?
Vi har to ledige stillingar som veterinær eller fiskehelsebiolog i avdeling sjø, med kontorstad i Førde og Bodø. Avdelinga er del av Tilsynsdivisjon akvakultur.
Som veterinær eller fiskehelsebiolog hjå oss får du ein variert arbeidskvardag der du kan nytte kompetansen din i eit samfunnsoppdrag som verkeleg betyr noko. Du vil arbeide med førebygging, tilsyn og beredskap mot sjukdommar hjå akvatiske dyr. Du får delta i å løyse komplekse utfordringar i skjeringspunktet mellom biologi, miljø og samfunn. Vi arbeider kvar dag for å fremje høgare overleving for fisk i akvakultur, for å betre fiskevelferda og ei berekraftig utvikling i norsk akvakulturnæring. 
Hjå oss tek du del i eit engasjert fagmiljø med gode moglegheiter for fagleg utvikling og eit nært og godt samarbeid med dyktige kollegaer. Dersom du trivst med å arbeide saman med andre, tek ansvar for eigen arbeidskvardag og har god rolleforståing, får du høve til å gjere ein konkret forskjell – saman med kollegaer som brenn for faget. 
 
Sentrale arbeidsoppgåver 
  • Oppfølging av anlegg med dårleg velferd. 
  • Arbeid med tiltak for å redusere dødelegheit og velferdsutfordringar. 
  • Inspeksjonar og prøveuttak i akvakulturanlegg. 
  • Setje i verk tiltak ved påvising av alvorlege sjukdommar. 
  • Hjelpe andre team som arbeider med tilsyn ved slakteri, fartøy eller landanlegg. 
  • Rettleiing av næring og publikum. 
  • Andre oppgåver må også reknast med ut frå samla behov og prioriteringar. 

 
Kvalifikasjonskrav
Du må: 
  • Vere veterinær eller fiskehelsebiolog med norsk autorisasjon. 
  • Ha god skriftleg og munnleg framstillingsevne på norsk. 
  • Vere trygg i bruk av digitale verktøy og setje deg raskt inn i nye system. 
  • Ha gyldig førarkort klasse B. 

 
Det er ein fordel om du i tillegg har: 
  • Erfaring frå arbeid i havbruksnæringa, men nyutdanna blir også oppmoda om å søkje. 
  • Erfaring frå offentleg forvaltning.

 
Personlege eigenskapar:
  • Du trivst med å arbeide i team og har gode samarbeidsevner, men arbeider og sjølvstendig og tek ansvar for eigne oppgåver. 
  • Du har god rolleforståing og klarer å vurdere faglege problemstillingar i eit heilskapleg perspektiv og å finne gode løysingar. 
  • Du står trygt i dine faglege vurderingar og klarer å stå i krevjande situasjonar. 
  • Du arbeider strukturert og effektivt, har god evne til å prioritere arbeidsoppgåver og er samstundes fleksibel og tilpassar deg endringar. 
  • Du har gode kommunikasjonsevner og kan formidle faglege vurderingar på ein tydeleg og forståeleg måte. 
  • Du bidreg til eit positivt arbeidsmiljø og til trivsel på arbeidsplassen. 

Personleg eignaheit og korleis du passar inn i teamet vil vere ein viktig del av vurderinga. 
 
Vi tilbyr: 
  • Fast stilling som førsteinspektør (stillingskode 1498), med løn etter avtale, avhengig av utdanning, erfaring og kompetanse. Løna for tilsvarande stillingar i Mattilsynet er for tida frå kr 680 000 til kr 780 000. For særleg kvalifiserte søkjarar kan høgare løn og stilling som seniorinspektør (stillingskode 1499) vurderast. 
  • Gode ordningar for arbeidstida (fleksitid og sommar- og vintertid). 
  • Arbeid med eit spennande og viktig samfunnsoppdrag. 
  • Fagleg utvikling – hjå oss får du tilgang til eit breitt kompetansemiljø og moglegheit til å utvikle deg innan akvamedisin, regelverk og risikostyring. 
  • Fine og moderne kontorlokale. 
  • Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med gode pensjons-, låne- og forsikringsordningar. 

 
Kontaktinformasjon 
Har du spørsmål om dei to stillingane, kan du gjerne ta kontakt med leiar for avdelinga Barbo Rimeslaatten Klakegg på telefon 957 31 906 eller e-post barbo.rimeslaatten.klakegg@mattilsynet.no. 
 
Slik søkjer du 
Søknader blir berre tekne imot elektronisk. Vi ber om at du lastar opp vitnemål via Vitnemålsportalen. Dette sikrar ei enkel og trygg overføring av dokumenta dine. For meir informasjon om korleis du brukar Vitnemålsportalen, sjå vitnemalsportalen.no. Søkjarar som ikkje har moglegheit til dette, kan leggje ved attestar og vitnemål som vedlegg til søknaden.
 
Saman tryggjer vi framtida for mennesker, dyr og naturDet er både visjonen vår og eit uttrykk for korleis vi jobbar saman for å løyse det viktige samfunnsoppdraget vårt. Vi utviklar organisasjonen og løysningane vi leverer, med utgangspunkt i behova til brukarane våre. I Mattilsynet er vi over 1 200 kollegaer over heile landet, med kompetanse på mange fagfelt. Vi er blant anna veterinærar, biologar, juristar, teknologar og medarbeidarar med bakgrunn innan næringsmiddelproduksjon og forvaltning. Saman bidreg vi blant anna til trygg mat og trygt drikkevatn, god dyrehelse og dyrevelferd og god plantehelse. 
Mattilsynet er eit statleg forvaltningsorgan og rapporterer til Landbruks- og matdepartementet, Helse- og omsorgsdepartementet og Nærings- og fiskeridepartementet. Du kan lese meir om oss på mattilsynet.no. 
 
Inkludering og mangfald er ei styrke for Mattilsynet. Vi ønskjer medarbeidarar med ulik kompetanse, fagkombinasjonar, livserfaring og perspektiv slik at vi kan løyse oppgåvene på ein endå betre måte. Har du funksjonsnedsetjing, hol i CV-en og/eller innvandrarbakgrunn, oppmodar vi deg til å krysse av for dette når du søkjer jobb hos oss. Vi kallar inn minst éin kvalifisert søkjar i kvar gruppe til intervju. Får du jobben, legg vi til rette for deg dersom du treng det. Vi bruker berre avkryssingane til å velje ut rette kandidatar og til anonymisert statistikk.

jobs.description:
HEMFRID SÖKER DIG SOM VILL ARBETA SOM SERVICETEAMARE I GÖTEBORG/HISINGEN

Hemfrid är Sveriges största företag inom hemstädning. Vi hjälper våra kunder med tjänster i hemmet så som städning, fönsterputs, flyttservice och mycket annat.

HEMSTÄDNING I VÄRLDSKLASS Att jobba med oss på hemfrid innebär att du får ett roligt, varierande jobb inom hemstädning. Som serviceteamare blir du en del av ett sammansvetsat team där du tillsammans med dina kollegor arbetar för att göra våra kunders vardag enklare. Du kommer att arbeta med ett härligt gäng från olika delar av världen, där vi stöttar och hjälper varandra för att skapa bästa möjliga service.

Om rollen:

Som serviceteamare är du en del av vårt kvalitetsteam och arbetar nära Area Manager och Field Lead för att säkerställa hög kvalitet i vår leverans. Rollen innebär att du stöttar nya kollegor på fältet, samtidigt som du själv utför start- och storstädningar, fönsterputs och vikariepass. Du kommer även vid behov att genomföra kvalitetskontroller, följa nya medarbetare i deras introduktion samt avlasta med nyckelhantering.

Du är en viktig del i att skapa nöjda kunder, bidra till teamets utveckling och säkerställa att våra arbetssätt håller hög kvalitet. Rollen innebär också löpande dialog och återkoppling till chef samt deltagande i kvalitetsteamsmöten varje månad.

Vi letar efter dig som:

    

Tycker om att jobba i team med andra kollegor

    

Ha tidigare erfarenhet inom städning

    

Är engagerad och vill utvecklas inom städning

    

Pratar svenska eller engelska

    

Kan arbeta flexibla timmar, där arbetstiderna är kl. 8-17

    

Är flexibel att arbeta utan fasta kunder

    

Har giltigt körkort (B)

Vi erbjuder dig:

    

En tillsvidareanställning med en sysselsättningsgrad på 75-90%

    

Kollektivavtal och bra anställningsvillkor

    

Ansvarsförsäkring, sjukförsäkring, pensionsförsäkring och friskvårdsbidrag

    

Utbildning inom hemstädning med fokus på din utveckling

    

Härliga kollegor från hela världen

jobs.title: Team Manager (Technical information & documentation)
jobs.description:
Position: Team Manager, Technical Information & Documentation

Location: Danderyd, Sweden

Division: Vacuum Automation

Type: Permanent, full-time

About Piab Group:

At Piab Group we improve our customers' productivity, sustainability, and safety through evolving industrial automation and have done so since 1951. We believe in an automated world where no resources are wasted, and no humans are injured. With annual sales of ~3 billion SEK and more than 1400 employees, Piab is a global organization, serving customers in more than 100 countries from a vast network of subsidiaries and channel partners. Since 2018, Piab Group has been owned by Patricia Industries, part of Investor AB. Piab serves a wide range of industries, including e-commerce logistics, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and automotive, providing innovative vacuum automation solutions tailored to each sector.

You can expect the following with us:

    Innovative Culture: Be part of a team that thrives on creativity and innovation.
    Global Impact: Work with a company that is a world leader in vacuum transport solutions.
    Global Presence: Piab has 25+ sales offices and over 900 partners worldwide, ensuring a vast network and global reach.
    Sustainable Vision: Contribute to an automated world, promoting safety and efficiency.
    Professional Growth: Access opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.
    Diverse and Inclusive: Join a workplace that values diversity and fosters an inclusive environment.

Job Mission:

As Team Manager, Technical Information & Documentation, you lead and develop Piab’s Technical Documentation team while working hands-on with our content ecosystem. You ensure that high‑quality, scalable technical information supports our products, digital experiences and customers across channels. You drive transformation towards structured, automated and AI‑assisted documentation, positioning technical information as a strategic business asset for Piab.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead and inspire the team

    Lead, coach and develop Piab's Technical Documentation team.
    Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
    Set priorities while actively contributing to the team's daily work.

Be hands-on

    Create, review and improve technical documentation alongside the team.
    Work directly in our documentation ecosystem, including Paligo, Inriver, Tacton CPQ and related platforms.
    Participate in product launches, Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and New Product Introduction (NPI) projects.
    Support configurable documentation and automated datasheet generation.

Drive transformation

    Challenge existing ways of working and identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve.
    Lead the adoption of AI-assisted authoring, structured content and automated publishing.
    Build reusable, scalable content that supports multiple channels and future digital experiences.
    Continuously improve processes, governance and documentation quality.

REQUIREMENTS:

    Minimum 8 years of experience leading technical documentation, technical communication or product information teams.
    Minimum 5 years of experience creating technical documentation for industrial or engineering products.
    Experience and genuine interest in being both a leader and an active, hands-on contributor.
    Strong drive to improve and transform ways of working, with energy from improving processes rather than simply maintaining them.
    Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Engineering, Product Management, Marketing and IT.
    Strategic mindset with a belief that technical information is a core business asset.
    Excellent communication skills in English and Swedish, both written and spoken (mandatory).
    Curiosity about AI, automation and emerging technologies, and how they can be applied to documentation.
    Experience with structured authoring, APIs and AI-supported documentation workflows is an advantage.
    Experience with the following tools is a plus:
    Paligo
    Inriver
    Tacton CPQ
    Teamcenter
    Smartcat
    Postman

How to Apply:

If you are passionate about innovation and want to make a difference in the world of automation, we would love to hear from you! use the following link to upload your CV.

Please be advised that a valid work permit for the country we offer the open vacancy in is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit cannot be considered.
