jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. You’ll jump straight into the heart of our storytelling, crafting everything from nuanced, emotional facial expressions to epic, high-action combat performances. If you have a passion for mastering complex anatomy and love the challenge of making mythical beasts—whether they walk, fly, or breathe fire—feel completely grounded in reality, this is the place to do it.

  • Collaborate closely with your Animation Lead and Supervisor to produce premium, story-driven animation that elevates the pacing and style of the film.

  • Animate both primary and secondary characters, ensuring every element in the frame possesses authentic motion and soul.

  • Take ownership of your workflow, keeping production schedules transparent and hitting your deadlines consistently.

  • Mentor and support less senior artists, sharing your craft and helping them grow their skills.

  • Actively tackle creative changes and follow through constructively on supervisor notes and technical feedback.

  • A natural grasp of physical motion, weight, balance, and spatial awareness.

  • A strong foundation in human and animal anatomy, which underpins how you animate complex fantasy muscle structures and locomotion.

  • An understanding of character rigs, animation pipelines, and data transfer between production tools.

  • Clear, constructive communication and a genuinely collaborative approach to working across distributed pipeline teams.

  • Adaptability, an open mind for direction, and a calm, reliable focus when deadlines approach.

You might also have

  • Experience working with, clean-up, or editing of motion capture data.

  • A traditional background in sketching, life drawing, or classic 2D animation.

  • A working knowledge of Modelling or basic scripting (Python/MEL) to streamline workflows.

jobs.title: Nauczyciel/ka wychowania przedszkolnego
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: Opracowywanie i prowadzenie zajęć dydaktyczne tak, aby wypełnić ramowe wymagania określone w podstawie programowej przewidzianej dla dzieci w danym wieku. Planowanie i prowadzenie pracy wychowawczo-dydaktycznej.
Organizacja wydarzeń przedszkolnych. Angażowanie się w życie szkoły.
Współpraca z rodzicami dzieci w celu informowania ich o postępach i omawiania ewentualnych problemów. Utrzymywanie porządku w sali przedszkolnej i dbanie o estetykę środowiska przedszkolnego. Prowadzenie dokumentacji wypełnianie dziennika zajęć, prowadzenie arkuszy obserwacji, pisanie opinii i diagnoz pedagogicznych oraz innych niezbędnych dokumentów. Udział w konferencjach, szkoleniach i innych formach doskonalenia zawodowego. Obowiązki nauczyciela i wychowawcy w grupie przedszkolnej zgodnie z przepisami prawa.
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- umiejętności: Rozwój kompetencji interpersonalnych - konieczne; pracowitość, uprzejmość, zaradność, komunikatywność - konieczne; efektywna komunikacja, współpraca w zespole, radzenie sobie ze stresem - konieczne
- pozostałe: zaangażowanie i pasja w pracy z dziećmi, dbanie o bezpieczeństwo i wspieranie rozwoju dzieci
Sposób aplikowania:
- bezpośrednio do pracodawcy
- wymagane dokumenty: Brak danych.
- języki aplikowania: polski

jobs.title:
Staż urzędniczy (6 miesięcy): stażysta
Po stażu urzędniczym:inspektor/specjalista/główny specjalista
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: prowadzenie spraw związanych z działalnością inwestycyjno-remontową, opracowywanie planów inwestycyjno-remontowych, zlecanie opracowania dokumentacji technicznej,
zlecanie oraz nadzorowanie prac remontowych, uczestnictwo w przeglądach stanu technicznego nieruchomości położonych
w obszarze właściwości Sądu Okręgowego w Poznaniu, okresowe prowadzenie analiz wykonania budżetu, sporządzanie
sprawozdań wynikających z obowiązujących przepisów, współpraca z innymi komórkami organizacyjnymi, w
szczególności z Oddziałem Gospodarczym, Oddziałem Finansowo-Rachunkowym oraz Sekcją ds. Zamówień Publicznych.
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: Ukończenie co najmniej studiów pierwszego stopnia (technicznego) i uzyskanie tytułu zawodowego.
Doświadczenie zawodowe: Wymagane w zakresie pracy na stanowisku ds. inwestycji i remontów.
Znajomość technik biurowych oraz praktycznej znajomości środowiska Windows, w tym obsługi Microsoft Word i Excel oraz sprawozdawczości.
Uprawnienia: Posiadanie uprawnień do wykonywania samodzielnych funkcji technicznych w budownictwie w specjalności konstrukcyjno-budowlanej bez ograniczeń.
Oczekiwania mile widziane: Posiadanie, potwierdzonej przez Wojewódzkiego Konserwatora Zabytków, 18  miesięcznej praktyki zawodowej przy robotach budowlanych prowadzonych przy zabytkach nieruchomych  zgodnie z art. 37c Ustawy z dnia 23 lipca 2003 r. o ochronie zabytków i opiece nad zabytkami.

Description de tâches:

Compass Group Luxembourg est le partenaire de référence sur le marché luxembourgeois des services aux entreprises depuis 1982.
Plus de 2.300 collaborateurs s'investissent chaque jour dans nos trois pôles d'activités avec exigence et sens du détail, pour vous garantir une expérience de service haut de gamme.

Historiquement liée à la restauration, l'implantation de Compass Group au Luxembourg s'est enrichie au fil du temps de services associés, guidés par la même exigence de qualité. Nos activités de Food Services, Support Services et Healthcare offrent une approche transversale et une synergie unique pour nos clients souhaitant allier performance et confort sur site.
Nous offrons une relation de confiance durable, fondée sur la proximité d'une entreprise nationale et soutenue par la force d'un groupe de référence mondiale.

Nous incarnons des valeurs fortes: l'humain, la sécurité et la préservation de l'environnement. Nos collaborateurs sont les ambassadeurs de notre hospitalité et le cœur de nos activités.

Notre organisation, engagée dans la responsabilité sociale et environnementale, privilégie l'innovation et la recherche de solutions écoresponsables pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de nos clients.

Notre pôle Food Services regroupe nos services de restauration concédée dans les secteurs B&I, santé et éducation mais aussi nos services de vending et de restauration événementielle. Nous mettons l'accent sur des initiatives responsables et locales afin d'enrichir l'expérience client. Une offre connectée, durable, et compétitive, conçue pour le bien-être de vos salariés. Chaque jour, des plats frais, de saison et issus de circuits courts, pour le plus grand plaisir de vos convives !

Nous recherchons actuellement des Agents de Restauration.

A la fois présent(e) en salle et en cuisine vous assurez des fonctions de production, de vente et d'entretien.

Vous êtes passionné par la restauration et pensez qu'une carrière réussie commence par la passion, la créativité et la positivité ? Alors n'attendez plus et rejoignez Eurest!

Responsabilités

Missions:

• Préparations froides (sandwichs, crudités, assiettes froides, …)
• Préparations chaudes (remise en température, cuisson, cuisson de mets simples)

• Entretien courant des appareils et installations (Lave-vaisselle, machine à café, …)
• Nettoyage du restaurant et des arrières
• Port de la tenue réglementaire selon les règles HACCP
• Station debout, efforts physiques et polyvalence

Divers

• Respect des règles et normes HACCP et de sécurité
• Exposition fréquentes à la chaleur et au froid
• Contacts fréquents avec l'eau
• Utilisation de produits d'entretiens (connaissances des règles d'utilisation)

Compétences requises

Compétences:

• Première expérience en restauration appréciée

• Bonne présentation

Notre raison d'être: agir et innover pour faciliter le quotidien durablement. En tant que membre d'un groupe mondial, notre aspirons à devenir la référence des services au Luxembourg.
Chez Compass Group Luxembourg, nous sommes fiers de créer un environnement où chaque collaborateur contribue à façonner un avenir durable en apportant des solutions innovantes.
Cliquez ici pour en savoir plus et faites partie de cette aventure!

jobs.title: Process Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Description:

Tyvek® is a unique flash-spun nonwoven material renowned for its exceptional combination of lightweight performance,
durability, protection, and versatility. With leading market positions across construction, protective apparel, medical packaging,
and other high-growth industries, Tyvek® continues to shape the future of materials innovation worldwide.
At DuPont, you'll work at the heart of a proprietary technology that combines multiple engineering disciplines, including
chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, polymer science, material science, fluid dynamics, electrostatics, and process
technology.
This is an opportunity to join a company known for its strong safety culture, technological excellence, and commitment to
employee development, while contributing to products that make a real difference in people's lives.
What You'll Do
As a Process Engineer, you will play a critical role in driving operational excellence, innovation, and business growth within our
Tyvek® manufacturing operations.
You will:
• Own and continuously improve manufacturing processes, ensuring the highest standards in process safety, reliability,
quality, and environmental compliance.
• Provide daily technical support to production operations and help optimize line performance.
• Identify, develop, and implement process and technology improvements that enhance productivity, efficiency, and
sustainability.
• Contribute to major capital investment (CAPEX) projects, including process design, engineering calculations, and
technology implementation.
• Lead and participate in Process Hazard Analyses (PHA) and risk management activities.
• Collaborate closely with Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges.
• Manage and maintain critical process technology documentation and standards.
• Support the future evolution of Tyvek® technology through innovation and continuous improvement initiatives.
At DuPont, no two days are the same. Your responsibilities and opportunities will evolve as our technologies, products, and
business continue to grow.
What We Are Looking For
We're looking for curious, driven engineers who are passionate about technology, problem-solving, and continuous learning.
Required Qualifications:
• Master's degree preferred in Chemical, Process, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Bachelor's degree with relevant industrial experience will also be considered.
• Fluent in German and English.
• Strong interest in manufacturing technology, industrial processes, and innovation.
• Ability to quickly learn new technologies and develop new technical competencies.
• Self-starter with strong ownership, initiative, and accountability.
• Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities.
• Team-oriented mindset with the ability to collaborate across multiple disciplines and functions.
• French and/or Luxembourgish language skills are a plus.

jobs.title: Associate professor (promotion track) in Banking Law (m/f)
jobs.description:
Language: English (UK)
Location Luxembourg
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Department of Law

Contract Type: Academic - Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week

Job (internal): Associate professor
Job Level: Monolevel
Functions: Associate / Assistant Professor
Expertise: Professors
Role Type: Open Position


About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance counts over 2,700 students enrolled across four Bachelor programmes, thirteen Master programmes, doctoral studies as well as several continuing education courses. The Faculty hosts the Doctoral School of Law and the Doctoral School in Economics, Finance and Management.
Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre, as well as its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role
The successful candidate will strengthen the Department of Law's research area in Banking, Financial and Commercial Law, which is a cornerstone of the Department's academic profile and a key contributor to the University's reputation. They will pursue research and teaching in this field, focussing on Luxembourg, EU, and comparative transnational perspectives. The position is of particular strategic relevance given the Department's ambition to maintain its leadership in financial law, a domain central to Luxembourg's role as a global financial centre.
The ideal candidate shows potential to:
• Develop an internationally recognized research profile in banking law in a broad sense, e.g., prudential regulation and bank supervision, depositary law, regulation of payments and payment systems, financial technologies, sustainable finance, secured transactions and consumer financial contracts, links to financial markets law
• Publish extensively in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, monographs, or authoritative treatises
• Contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives such as the FutureFinTechNCER and/or collaborate with the Department of Finance in the field of sustainable finance
• Teach in core areas of banking law. The ability to contribute to teaching in related areas of commercial law—such as financial and securities law, company law, insolvency law, the law of commercial contracts and torts - is an asset
• Cover legal frameworks at both EU and Luxembourg levels, adopting a comparative approach that includes neighbouring jurisdictions and other global financial centres
• Engage with Luxembourg and EU regulators (e.g. CSSF, CBL, ECB, ESMA), international organizations, e.g. IOSCO, BIS, FSB, etc., and other stakeholders, e.g. (inter )national law firms, industry and academic associations
• Acquire competitive research funding and establish and lead their own research team
• Show and develop leadership potential
The candidate will join one of Europe's most prominent academic groups in banking and financial law, distinguished by both its intellectual strength and research output. They will actively contribute to the University's “Third Mission” by engaging with Luxembourg and EU financial law, and will be encouraged to develop into a leadership role within the Department. This position offers the opportunity to gain recognition and respect in Luxembourg's legal community, renowned for its emphasis on financial law expertise and its strong integration of academic insight with professional practice. Their doctoral students will benefit from a strong academic environment and excellent career prospects—more than 20 former PhD graduates from the Department have gone on to become professors.

Your profile
• A Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD degree in Law
• Experience and interest in engaging in academic research at the highest level
• Publications in internationally recognized journals, monographs with international publishers or other publications in banking law (or other fields of financial law) indicating potential for excellent research
• Potential and aptitude for teaching and supervising research at the university level
• An excellent academic track record demonstrating both scholarly excellence and leadership potential
• Experience with externally funded research projects and interdisciplinarity is considered to be an asset
• Experience in interdisciplinary research—particularly at the intersection of law, finance, and technology—is a strong asset
The successful candidate must commit to lecturing banking law, as well as related topics in financial and commercial law, at bachelor and master levels.
The successful candidate is also expected to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, prepare grant applications for external funding and actively engage with other research institutions and industry partners to establish research cooperations in Luxembourg and beyond.
Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and French. Knowledge of German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities.
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

How to apply
Online application should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to the Dean, Katalin Ligeti
• CV, including periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks
• Statement of future research, teaching and other activities (max 5 pages)
• Short description of the three most important scholarly achievements (max. 2 pages)
• List of publications, research projects acquired, and PhD theses supervised (if applicable)
• List of teaching activities
• Copy of the PhD diploma
• The names, contact information and present position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. We encourage early application. To ensure full consideration, candidates should apply by of 29/04/2026.
General Information:
• Contract Type: Academic - Permanent. This position is tenured and promotion to Full Professor is possible after 5 years upon positive evaluation
• Work Hours: Full Time 40.0 Hours per Week
• Planned Start Date: 01.09.2026
• Location: Kirchberg Campus

jobs.title: CFO HSBC Investment Funds Luxembourg (m/f)
jobs.description:
CFO HSBC Investment Funds (Luxembourg) S.A.

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our Asset Management business.

What you will do:

Reporting functionally to the Asset Management Continental Europe CFO and locally to the CEO of HSBC Investment Funds Luxembourg (HIFL), you will head the Finance function for HIFL, the HIFL Ireland Branch and the HIFL UAE Branch. You will ensure consistently high standards of financial control, reporting and executive insight. You will be a key member of the HIFL Local Management Committee and a standing attendee at key governance forums, presenting the HIFL's financial position to senior stakeholders.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Head the Finance function across HIFL Luxembourg, HIFL Ireland Branch and HIFL UAE Branch, setting a high bar for financial control, reporting quality and decision support for executive stakeholders.
• Deliver accurate, timely and compliant Group reporting, producing clear, executive-ready MI and ad hoc insight for stakeholders including the AMEU CFO.
• Own end-to-end statutory reporting: prepare IFRS financial statements aligned to Asset Management standards and maintain strong ledger integrity, including oversight of postings to the HIFL ledger.
• Direct the audit cycle end-to-end, coordinating auditors to meet all deliverables on time and to a high standard.
• Drive a robust balance sheet and cost base: ensure reconciliations are complete and well-evidenced; oversee operational budgets for fund ranges; maintain accurate accruals and invoice governance, keeping forecasts aligned to business changes.
• Provide effective financial stewardship and risk oversight: submit local regulatory returns; validate management fee calculations and intercompany payaways to ensure fair revenue allocation across AMG sites; act as TPEM and/or Risk Steward for suppliers where applicable.

You should apply if you have:

• Relevant professional accountancy qualification (e.g., ACA / ACCA / CA / CPA or equivalent).
• Strong experience in asset management, financial services, audit and/or private wealth management, with senior accountability for financial control and reporting.
• Deep knowledge of IFRS and financial statement preparation. Knowledge of Lux GAAP and Luxembourg regulatory reporting requirements is an advantage.
• Strong leadership capability, including oversight of offshore/outsourced teams and delivery through a matrix environment.
• Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical matters to non-specialists and senior stakeholders.
• Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 116,900 – 140,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers  

Discover how ‘We Value Difference'.

international Corporate Tax Associate

Luxembourg
Line of Service Tax
Industry/Sector Not Applicable
Specialism International Tax Services
Management Level Associate
Job ID: 746850WD

Job Description & Summary

Meet your future team

Join the International Corporate Tax team within Tax Product Services. You will work closely with tax specialists across Luxembourg and the PwC network to help international clients assess tax risk, structure investments and navigate cross-border tax challenges
What your role will look like

As an Associate, you will contribute to international tax advisory projects for a diverse portfolio of clients investing in or through Luxembourg. Your work will help clients understand tax risks, apply international tax principles and make informed decisions throughout their business lifecycle. This section focuses on outcomes and impact rather than task execution, in line with PwC's JD guidelines.

• Advise international clients on tax aspects of corporate structures, transactions and business changes including set-ups, mergers, acquisitions and new product launches.
• Analyse Luxembourg and international tax legislation to provide practical, business-focused recommendations.
• Assess the application of domestic rules, double tax treaties and international tax frameworks to support client investments.
• Contribute to the development of investment solutions that help clients manage tax leakage and mitigate tax risk exposure.
• Collaborate with PwC teams across jurisdictions to support multinational clients and coordinate cross-border tax matters.
• Work with specialists from VAT, Transfer Pricing and other disciplines to deliver integrated tax opinions and client solutions.
• Support the continuous improvement of tools, methodologies and processes that respond to evolving tax and regulatory developments.
Your growth and opportunities

Develop expertise in Luxembourg and international corporate tax while working on complex cross-border structures and investment projects. Gain exposure to a broad range of industries and international clients, while building your technical and advisory capabilities through collaboration with specialists across the PwC network. This reflects the focus on growth through responsibility, exposure and learning.

The skills you bring

• Master's degree in Tax Law, Business Law, or Economics with additional education in Tax Law.
• First experience in taxation, law, or a related field is required.
• Strong interest in international corporate taxation.
• Microsoft Excel: Proficient / Independent use.
• English: Fluent English required.

Ways of working

• You analyse information critically, connect tax and business facts, and structure recommendations clearly.
• You collaborate effectively with colleagues across teams and jurisdictions to achieve shared client outcomes.
• You proactively learn, adapt to regulatory changes and continuously develop your expertise.
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation.

Additional skills that would support your success

• French language proficiency.
• German language proficiency.

The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.

Take your next step

Build expertise in international corporate taxation, contribute to meaningful client decisions and work alongside specialists solving complex cross-border challenges. Expand your perspective through international collaboration and gain exposure to projects that shape business decisions across industries. Grow here. Go further.

Travel Requirements Not Specified
Available for Work Visa Sponsorship? Yes
Government Clearance Required? No

Job Posting End Date

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 364,000 people in 136 countries and 137 territories. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting, we help clients build, accelerate, and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

jobs.title: Junior Fund Accountant (m/f)
jobs.description:
Junior Fund Accountant

The role is an entry level accounting-focused and will involve assisting our Fund accounting team in accounting and financial reporting for portfolio of funds and other structures mainly in the private equity and real estate sector. The individual will liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, assistance with periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and other day to day functions. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall senior fund accountants and manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting and bookkeeping of funds and SPVs (posting of invoices, interest and accruals etc.)
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and maintain all supporting documentation
• Respond to client queries and participate in client calls as required
• Assist senior team members in preparation of financial statements, using Lux GAAP and IFRS
• Assist senior team members in populating consolidation workings and intercompany eliminations
• Assist and in some cases in charge of regulatory reporting deliverables such as BCL reporting, CSSF reporting etc.
• Assist in preparation of VAT/CIT returns
• Assisting in the coordination of year-end audits;
• Prepare bank payments in various banking platforms and ensuring necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for an efficient review process
• Assist in the process of calculating equalisation, drawdown and distribution processes and able to refer to the relevant section of the LPA/ Fund document for details of equalisation, drawdown and distribution
• Assist in calculation of management fees

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Graduate in Finance, Economics or Accounting
• Pro-active, motivated and eager to learn and grow in fast paced working environment
• Flexible, excellent team player and have a positive attitude towards problem solving issues
• Fluent in English (French or German would be considered as an advantage)
• Excellent organisational and interpersonal skills and able to work under tight deadlines
• The candidate will receive training and coaching required and it is not expected that the candidate hold any material prior experience, however, basic understanding of Lux GAAP and IFRS

Benefits

Langham Hall takes the development of its employees very seriously and offers sponsorship of a professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA) as part of the package.

About Langham Hall

Langham Hall provides premium quality accounting, fund administration and investor reporting services to Real Estate and Private Equity Fund clients.

Langham Hall invests in people and in developing them professionally.  We are extremely proud of our leadership-focused culture which fosters a dedicated, approachable and collaborative way of working.  We offer the opportunity to progress your career and study professional qualifications; through intensive training and where applicable, full exam tuition and study support.

Langham Hall is a fast-growing company and as such staff experience a variety of responsibilities and inclusion in exciting initiatives beyond their day-to-day role.  Employees are supported and encouraged to deliver a first-class service and opportunities are identified at an early stage for employees to engage with our clients which enables them feel involved and challenged in their work.

We are proud of our positive working culture which is reinforced through our employees and our extremely low staff turnover and we seek out people that believe in our values.

Learn more about Langham Hall by visiting our website: https://www.langhamhall.com/

Apply Now

jobs.title: Research & Development Specialist - Medical Specialisation Programmes (m/f)
jobs.description:

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and environment we live in.
The Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) is dedicated to advancing health and improving quality of life through excellence in research, education, and clinical engagement. Responsive to national health priorities and connected to international networks, our researchers address major challenges in human health - from fundamental discoveries to professional practice. The University of Luxembourg has set a strategic focus on medicine and health and is actively developing the training and research areas in these domains, creating exceptional opportunities in medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The successful candidate will contribute to the strategic development and continuous advancement of the University's Medical Specialisation Programmes. The candidate will assist Directors of Studies in developing research ideas, preparing competitive project proposals and funding applications, analysing scientific and educational developments, and translating research outcomes into programme enhancement and innovation. The candidate will work closely with the Directors of Studies, academic and administrative staff, as well as other internal and external institutional stakeholders.
Main responsibilities:
• Support the Directors of Studies in the development, coordination, and continuous improvement of the Medical Specialisation Programmes through research-informed educational initiatives
• Support curriculum development and the implementation of innovative educational approaches, such as simulation, digital learning and artificial intelligence, patient partnership
• Identify national and international funding opportunities and support the preparation of educational research proposals, grant applications, and collaborative project submissions
• Conduct literature reviews, environmental scans, benchmarking studies, and scientific analyses to inform strategic programme development
• Develop and implement programme evaluation strategies, analyse educational outcomes and generate evidence to support continuous quality improvement
• Contribute to scientific publications, reports, conference presentations, and other dissemination activities
• Monitor developments in healthcare, specialist medical training, research funding, healthcare policy, and relevant regulatory frameworks
• Support quality assurance, programme evaluation and accreditation processes of the Medical Specialisation Programmes
• Foster collaboration with national and international academic institutions, healthcare providers, professional organisations, and research networks

Your profile
• Master's degree in Medicine, Health Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Medical Education, Public Health, Healthcare Management, Education, or another relevant discipline
• 5+ years of experience working in medical education, health sciences, clinical research, or a healthcare environment would be a strong asset
• Experience in research project development, grant writing, project coordination, or higher education administration
• Demonstrated ability to prepare research proposals, funding applications, or strategic project documentation
• Strong analytical skills with experience in literature reviews, data analysis, and evidence synthesis
• Excellent scientific writing, reporting, and communication skills
• Ability to collaborate effectively with academic and administrative stakeholders
Language Requirements: Excellent command (C1) of English and French, and very good command (B2) of German or Luxembourgish is an asset.
Diversity and Gender Equality: The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Curriculum Vitae
• Cover letter
Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.
General information:

• Work Hours: Full Time 40.0 Hours per Week
• Location: Belval Campus
• Internal Title: Research and development specialist
• Job Reference: UOL08374.

Associate Professor or Assistant Professor in Machine Learning and Foundation Models

Country: Luxembourg

Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week

Job (internal): Assistant Professor
Functions: Associate / Assistant Professor
Role Type: Open Position
Expertise: Professors

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Computer Science (DCS) conducts cutting-edge research and offers high-quality education in core areas of computer science, with particular strengths in artificial intelligence, information security, and advanced computing systems. DCS promotes interdisciplinary research and closely cooperates with other high-profile research centers in Luxembourg and beyond, as well as with industry and society. The faculty entertains various successful and growing teaching programs and supports lifelong learning activities.

Your role
As a professor in the Department of Computer Science, you will:
• Lead research in your area of expertise, with a focus on machine learning and foundation models, and have the opportunity to establish and grow your own research group within a collaborative environment
• Collaborate actively with colleagues across the department, the university, and national research institutions, benefiting from Luxembourg's dynamic and well-funded research ecosystem
• Contribute to teaching at all levels - e.g.: Bachelor, Master, and Doctoral -, designing and delivering courses in your field of expertise
• Supervise and mentor PhD and postdoctoral researchers, and support their development through seminars and related activities
• Participate in shaping the department's research and educational agenda

For further information about the role, please contact: Prof. Jean-Sébastien Coron, Head of the Department of Computer Science, Email: jean-sebastien.coron@uni.lu


Your profile
The Faculty of Science, Technology, and Medicine (FSTM) seeks a candidate with:
• A PhD degree in Computer Science or a closely related field
• A research track record in Artificial Intelligence, with an emphasis on machine learning and an openness to interdisciplinary collaboration — both within academia and with industry partners
• Expertise in one or more core areas of machine learning and foundation models, such as deep learning, representation learning, probabilistic modeling, reinforcement learning, optimization for learning, trustworthy and efficient machine learning, or foundation models including large language and multimodal models. We particularly value depth of knowledge, originality, and the potential for cross-disciplinary innovation
• Publications in top-tier computer conferences and journals related to AI and machine learning, including but not limited to NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, JMLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, IJCV, TPAMI, ACL, EMNLP, KDD, AAAI, IJCAI, ECAI, COLT, UAI, AAMAS, AISTATS, TACL, SIGIR, WSDM, Web Conference
• Experience in teaching Computer Science topics at undergraduate, graduate, or postgraduate levels and willingness to contribute to the department's teaching and administrative missions

Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English. Proficiency in French or German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to Pascal Bouvry, Dean of the Faculty
• Curriculum Vitae; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications, projects, teaching expertise and accomplishments in knowledge transfer relevant to this role (1-3 pages)
• Statement of planned research, teaching and other activities at the University of Luxembourg (1–3 pages)
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects
• Names, contact information and current position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
We encourage early application. Applications are only accepted online through the HR system. The position will be unposted on 30th September 2026, after which no further applications can be submitted. Applications will be handled in strict confidence.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

General information:
• Contract Type: Professorial - Permanent This position is offered at the Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level, depending on qualification. Both positions are tenured.
• Work Hours: Full Time 40.0 Hours per Week
• Location: Belval Campus
• Internal Title: Assistant Professor
• Job Reference: UOL08383. The reference should be mentioned in all correspondence
• Starting date: 01.06.2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

jobs.description:

Quality Line Side; Luft- und Raumfahrt; Qualitätssicherung; Lean Management

Stellenbeschreibung:
Quality Line Side (m/w/d) für AIRBUS

________________________________________________________________

Starten Sie als Quality Line Side - Takted FAL A320 Family mit uns in eine gemeinsame und erfolgreiche Zukunft. Als jahrzehntelanger Spezialist und Personallieferant für die Luft- und Raumfahrt Branche sowie in Partnerschaft mit AIRBUS Operations sucht die SimpleXX GmbH für den Standort Finkenwerder einen Quality Line Side - Takted FAL A320 Family zum nächsten möglichen Zeitpunkt im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung mit Übernahmeoption. Sie übernehmen mitunter die Freigabe von Flugzeugbereichen für den weiteren Fertigungsprozess. Des Weiteren sind zuständig Sie für die Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Eingangs-, Funktion-, Haltepunkt- und Endprüfungen. Bei AIRBUS als Luft- und Raumfahrtunternehmen erwarten Sie anspruchsvolle Tätigkeiten in einem innovativen Arbeitsumfeld, das zukunftssicher ist und Ihnen sehr gute Karrierechancen bietet. Sie besitzen eine hohe Eigenmotivation und das entsprechende Engagement? Sie fühlen sich angesprochen? Dann bewerben Sie sich noch gleich heute auf unser Stellenangebot. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Folgende Aufgaben erwarten Sie:

- Freigabe von Flugzeugbereichen für den weiteren Fertigungsprozess
- Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Eingangs-, Funktion-, Haltepunkt- und Endprüfungen
- Dokumentation durchgeführter Prüfungen in relevanten IT-Systemen wie SAP PDA/PEA, ARP, MES
- Erfassung, Nachverfolgung und Schließung von festgestellten Abweichungen zu gültigen Produktions-  und Qualitäts-Standards (Non Conformities), in vorgesehenen Beanstandungstools oder Prozessen
- Überwachung von Fertigungsabläufen, Partner- bzw. Zulieferer-aktivitäten
- Durchführung von operativen Überwachungsaktivitäten (Surveillance) im Rahmen von Customer Protection
- Betreuung von prüfberechtigten Produktionspersonal (Lvl.1,Lvl.2), Abnahme von Arbeits- und Prüfproben, sowie Erteilen von fachlichen Weisungen in QS-Belangen (Qualitätssicherung)

Wir wünschen uns:

- Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich Fluggerätemechanik, Flugzeugbau, Technik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Berufserfahrung im Bereich Flugzeugbau, Industriemechanik, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Qualitätssicherung
- Kenntnisse im Bereich Lean Management und Total Quality Management
- Erforderliche Pakete aus der Vorabqualifikation: 3.1 und 4
- Bereitschaft zur 2-Schichtarbeit sowie zum Arbeiten in engen Räumen
- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- sowie versierte Englischkenntnisse
- Tools: SAP, Google Workspace

Was SimpleXX unter anderem auch ausmacht:

Unser zusätzliches Angebot – was wir Ihnen bieten und was Sie von uns erwarten können

- Generell ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
- Perspektive auf Übernahme durch Kundenbetrieb - Recruiting Strategie: temp 2 perm

- Mitarbeiter-Support: Ein hervorragender Mitarbeitersupport (schnelle Rückmeldung zu administrativen Fragen und bei zusätzlichem Support – menschliche, persönliche und qualifizierte Beratung sowie mehrsprachig)
- Sie erhalten professionelle Schutz- und Arbeitskleidung gemäß Einsatzbedingungen und Einsatztätigkeit
- Sie erhalten eine exzellente medizinische Vorsorge durch unsere Kooperationen mit diversen Betriebsarztzentren (Kostenübernahme für Gesundheitsuntersuchungen)
- Förderung durch Weiterbildungs- und Qualifizierungsmöglichkeiten bei Bedarfssituationen während der Projektlaufzeit im Rahmen Ihrer Tätigkeiten

jobs.description:
Desay SV Automotive Europe GmbH, the European headquarters of Desay SV Automotive, is located in Weimar, Germany. As a technology specialist for advanced hardware, software, and connectivity, we play a key role in transferring Desay SV’s global innovation strength into tailored solutions for the European automotive market. Desay SV Europe is part of Huizhou Desay SV Automotive Co., Ltd. based in China, a leading, stock exchange-listed provider of mobility solutions in the fields of Smart Cabin, Smart Drive and Smart Service. As a top 100 supplier and with its high level of technology expertise, Desay SV supports car manufacturers worldwide in their mobility transformation, making driving safer, more comfortable and more efficient.

Your tasks

- As the onsite technical interface to customers, system architecture engineer shall lead technical proposal of project quotation, including requirement analysis and system design proposal.

1. Study RFI/RFQ documents from customer, analyze and clarify customer's requirement,
2. Leading/support System Concept Design proposal, coordinate R&D and output complete system solutions
3. Onsite TA (Technical Addendum) presentation and concern clarification,
4. Follow up questions raised by customers on technology assessment, and provide quick and professional service to customers, support them for the feasibility evaluation.
- Responsible for the product technology planning of strategic customers
- Act as an on-site technical window to customer for development project to support technical feasibility evaluation and explanation.

Your profile

- Many years of experience as system engineer in the automotive industry, ideally in the supplier industry in Europe,
- Well experienced of providing technical solution during quotation phase.
- Knowledge of the cockpit or ADAS domain controller
- Familiarity with current trends and technologies in the field of smart cockpit and autonomous driving
- Ability to analyze, summarize, coordinate and organize, define and refinerequirements.
- Ability to work in a team and collaborate effectively with stakeholders.
- Customer and solution-oriented thinking
- Excellent communication skills in English (is a must) and German (is a plus), Exceptional presentation and written skills (PowerPoint)
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in systems engineering, electrical engineering, computer science or a related field
- Energetic, passionate, curiousness, open-minded, resilient, and self-drive

Wo Du mit anpacken kannst

- Du entwickelst unsere Desktop-Anwendung für macOS und Windows weiter – keine kleine Neben-App, sondern die Software, mit der medizinisches Personal seinen kompletten Arbeitstag verbringt.

- Du baust Lösungen für Formulardruck, KBV-Formulare, PDF-Erzeugung und Etiketten – also genau die Stellen, an denen Praxissoftware im Alltag wirklich funktionieren muss.
- Du sorgst für stabile Offline-Fähigkeit, lokale Datenhaltung, Mehrplatzbetrieb und zuverlässige Synchronisation mit dem Server.
- Du behältst die Anforderungen eines zertifizierten Medizinprodukts an Nachvollziehbarkeit, Qualitätssicherung und Dokumentation im Blick.
- Du reviewst Code, gibst Dein Wissen im Mentoring weiter und prägst mit, wie wir Flutter bei zollsoft langfristig einsetzen.
- CLI-basierte KI-Programmierung, zum Beispiel mit Claude Code oder Codex, ist bei uns Teil des Arbeitsalltags. Du gestaltest mit, wie wir KI-Coding sinnvoll und qualitätsgesichert nutzen.
- Perspektivisch kannst Du technische Verantwortung für ein Produkt oder Projekt übernehmen, ins Produktmanagement wechseln oder als Senior Individual Contributor weiter wachsen.
- Du arbeitest zu 100 % im Homeoffice von Deinem Lieblingsort in Deutschland aus und suchst einen langfristigen Heimathafen bei mindestens 30 Stunden pro Woche.

Was Du mitbringen solltest

- Du hast mindestens eine Flutter-Anwendung in Produktion gebracht und über mehrere Releases hinweg betreut.
- Du kennst Flutter nicht nur bis zum Launch, sondern weißt auch, was danach kommt: Wartbarkeit, Nutzerfeedback, Qualität und Weiterentwicklung.
- Du kennst State-Management-Ansätze wie Riverpod, Bloc oder Provider aus der Praxis und kannst ihre Vor- und Nachteile sauber einordnen.
- Du hattest bereits Berührungspunkte mit der Grenze zwischen Flutter und Betriebssystem, zum Beispiel über eigene Plugins, Platform Channels, FFI oder plattformspezifische Builds.

- Du denkst in Datenmodellen und Systemzusammenhängen, nicht nur in Widgets, und bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen mit.
- Erfahrung mit Flutter Desktop ist ein klares Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wichtiger ist Deine Lust auf Desktop-Anwendungen, Tastatur- und Mausinteraktion, Fenster, Menüs und Nutzer:innen, die Deine Software den ganzen Tag verwenden.
- Kenntnisse in PostgreSQL/MySQL, Unix-Shells und Scripting sowie Erfahrung in regulierten Umfeldern wie Medizin, Finanzen oder Automotive sind ein Plus.
- Um bei uns richtig Fuß zu fassen, beherrschst Du Deutsch fließend auf mindestens C1-Niveau, da Deutsch unsere interne Sprache für den intensiven Austausch im Team ist.

Warum wir?

Wir sind ein offenes und ambitioniertes Team von über 600 Mitarbeitern, das Kundenorientierung wirklich lebt und gleichzeitig Spaß hat. Bei uns herrscht auch nach über 10 Jahren eine Startup-Atmosphäre, die neben dem legendären Obstkorb auch vielseitige Perks wie eine steuerfreie Shoppingkarte, Dienstrad-Leasing und Gesundheitskurse (z.B. Yoga, Rückentraining und mental Health) anbietet - sowohl online als auch im Büro.

jobs.description:
Happier pets. Happier people.
What you will do with us

- Drive the conceptual direction and strategic evolution of our Identity & Access Management (IAM) landscape.
- Analyze requirements from business departments and IT, develop sustainable solution concepts, and advise stakeholders on functional and procedural topics.
- Optimize core IAM processes and ensure their efficient implementation across our enterprise applications.
- Design technical and functional solution concepts while taking existing architectures, interfaces, and adjacent IT disciplines into account.
- Play a central role in driving complex IAM initiatives forward, working in close collaboration with internal teams and external partners.
- Shape our ongoing IAM transformation by steering the retirement of our existing SAP Identity Management solution and co-designing the future target architecture.
- Bring your expertise into cross-functional discussions, set impulses for best practices, and support the team with complex challenges.

- A university degree with a focus on Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics, Natural Sciences, or a comparable professional qualification forms your theoretical foundation.
- You have several years of hands-on experience in Identity & Access Management as well as requirements management for complex IT and business processes.
- A profound understanding of integrated business processes and their technical mapping in enterprise applications is part of your toolkit.
- Practical experience operating and ideally configuring modern IAM solutions, preferably Microsoft Entra ID, has already been demonstrated by you.
- Proven experience in analyzing, modeling, documenting, and optimizing processes belongs to your core skillset.
- A strong understanding of the alignment between business departments, IT, and overall business strategy brings your profile to a senior level.
- You bring experience in steering complex initiatives as well as collaborating with diverse stakeholders and external partners.
- Strong analytical and conceptual skills paired with a high degree of self-initiative and a solution-oriented mindset belong to your central strengths.
- Very good communication skills and the ability to persuasively represent and advocate functional topics characterize you.
- Fluency in English and German (both written and verbal) is essential to operate effectively in our environment.

- Your freedom: pro rata mobile working and flexible working hours

Für unsere Mitarbeiter sind wir ein zuverlässiger und fairer Partner - gehen Sie mit expertum den Weg zu neuen beruflichen Herausforderungen bei namhaften und wertschätzenden Kunden!

Als international erfolgreiches Technologieunternehmen im Bereich Umwelt- und Recyclingtechnik entwickelt und produziert unser Mandant innovative Maschinen und Anlagen für die Aufbereitung von Abfällen, Biomasse und Wertstoffen. Zur strategischen und technologischen Weiterentwicklung des Bereichs Electrical Engineering suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit für unseren Mandanten als Head of Electrical Engineering (m/w/d) am Standort Frohnleiten.

DIES SIND IHRE AUFGABEN:

- Zu Ihrem Aufgabenbereich gehört die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines Teams aus Elektrokonstrukteuren sowie Softwareentwicklern mit den Schwerpunkten SPS, HMI und EPLAN. Dabei fördern Sie die fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung Ihrer Mitarbeitenden und schaffen die Voraussetzungen für eine erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit.
- Sie definieren und entwickeln die technologische Roadmap im Bereich Electrical Engineering und legen Standards für die Hard- und Softwarearchitektur fest. Dabei stellen Sie eine zukunftsorientierte Ausrichtung der eingesetzten Technologien und Entwicklungsprozesse sicher.
- Darüber hinaus verantworten Sie die termingerechte Planung und Steuerung von Entwicklungs- und Projektierungsaufgaben - von der Konzeptphase über die Umsetzung bis hin zur Serienreife der Produkte und Anlagen.
- Sie arbeiten eng mit den Bereichen Mechanik-Konstruktion, Smart Products, Digital Solutions, Kundenservice und Fertigung zusammen und sorgen für effiziente, modulare sowie skalierbare Lösungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette.
- Außerdem treiben Sie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Maschinensteuerung als zentrales Element unserer Anlagen aktiv voran. Dabei entwickeln Sie innovative Hard- und Softwarekonzepte und schaffen die Voraussetzungen für eine standardisierte Bereitstellung von Maschinendaten für nachgelagerte Systeme.
- Sie identifizieren Optimierungspotenziale in Prozessen, Technologien und Standards und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens.

DAS BRINGEN SIE MIT:

- Sie verfügen über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung beziehungsweise über eine gleichwertige Qualifikation.
- Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Elektro- oder Softwareprojektierung im Maschinen- oder Anlagenbau mit und konnten idealerweise bereits Führungserfahrung in einer leitenden oder stellvertretenden Führungsfunktion sammeln.
- Darüber hinaus verfügen Sie über fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich der Standardisierung technischer Lösungen und Prozesse sowie über Erfahrung in der Umsetzung entsprechender Projekte.
- Sie besitzen einen sicheren Umgang mit gängigen CAE-Systemen wie EPLAN P8 oder CREO sowie mit SAP und bringen ein gutes Verständnis für moderne Engineering-Prozesse mit.
- Außerdem verfügen Sie über grundlegende Kenntnisse in der SPS-Programmierung und Antriebstechnik sowie über einen sicheren Umgang mit relevanten Normen, Richtlinien und regulatorischen Anforderungen.
- Sie haben Kenntnisse oder Weiterbildungen im Bereich Functional Safety absolviert und verfügen idealerweise über ein grundlegendes Verständnis von OT-Security sowie der damit verbundenen Anforderungen, beispielsweise im Kontext des Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).
- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und entscheidungsstarke Arbeitsweise aus und verstehen es, komplexe Sachverhalte zu analysieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und zielgerichtete Entscheidungen zu treffen.
- Darüber hinaus überzeugen Sie durch eine klare und wertschätzende Kommunikation sowie durch Ihre Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder erfolgreich zusammenzubringen und Teams zu motivieren.
- Sie verfügen über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und kommunizieren souverän mit internationalen Kunden, Partnern und Lieferanten.

WIR GARANTIEREN IHNEN:

- Sie erwartet eine direkte Festanstellung bei unserem wertschätzenden Kunden.
- Um Sie bestmöglich bei unserem Kunden zu präsentieren, optimieren wir gemeinsam Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen und bereiten Sie gründlich auf das Vorstellungsgespräch im Unternehmen vor.
- Damit Sie zu den besten Konditionen eingestellt werden, stehen wir Ihnen im Voraus zur Verhandlung Ihres Arbeitsvertrags beratend zur Seite.
- Darüber hinaus beraten wir Sie auch gern kostenfrei zu weiteren passenden Karrieremöglichkeiten.

LEBENSLAUF GENÜGT:
Die Online-Bewerbung bei expertum dauert nur wenige Minuten. Laden Sie einfach Ihren Lebenslauf hoch, überprüfen Sie die übernommenen Daten und schicken Sie die Bewerbung ab - fertig. Alternativ können Sie uns Ihre Bewerbung auch per E-Mail zukommen lassen. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

jobs.title: Staff Product Analyst, Vendor Growth (Product-Lifecycle-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Staff Product Analyst (Vendor Growth) to join our Product Analytics team and drive data strategy for our Vendor Growth business management line. In this role, you will move beyond simple reporting to shape the future of our product through rigorous hypothesis testing and by converting massive datasets into high-impact strategic narratives.

In our Vendor Growth Team, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that empower restaurant partners to operate independently and at scale. Your work will directly improve experiences for vendors and their customers across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize partner operations, support partner autonomy, and strengthen vendor relationships.

As a Staff Analyst, you will champion a core strategic initiative focused on improving partner autonomy and operational efficiency. You will lead analysis and initiatives that help us better understand partner behavior, optimize vendor-facing experiences, and identify opportunities to reduce dependency on support channels. Your work will contribute to improved partner satisfaction, lower operational costs, and more scalable business processes.

You will operate across the product line, partnering with leaders in Product, Tech, Operations and Data to define the strategic direction of analytics for the entire Vendor Growth business. This is your opportunity to leverage deep technical expertise to champion innovation and influence how Delivery Hero empowers vendors at scale.

Strategic Leadership & Product Influence:

- Define the North Star: Develop and refine product metrics and leading indicators that accurately reflect vendor health, partner satisfaction, and business viability. Establish VSSR and related self-service metrics as key performance indicators.
- Influence Roadmap: Use quantitative analysis to look beyond the numbers, providing insights that empower Product Managers and Engineers to decide what to build and why. Provide data-driven recommendations on partner behavior and feature adoption.
- Drive Experimentation: Guide the team on methodology, design, interpretation, and decision-making of A/B tests. Champion vendor-facing experiments to validate self-service feature improvements and operational optimizations.

Technical Excellence & Scalability:

- Build for Scale: Drive the development of scalable analytics infrastructure and self-service capabilities, ensuring data quality and accessibility across the organization.
- Advanced Modeling: Collaborate on vendor behavior analysis and predictive models to understand adoption barriers and optimize feature rollout strategies.

Mentorship & Culture:

- Elevate the Team: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other analysts, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing, rigorous peer review, and technical excellence.
- Evangelize Data: Act as a quality gatekeeper and champion a data-driven mindset across the Product and Tech teams.

Qualifications

** Qualifications**

- 6+ years of experience as a Product Analyst, Data Scientist, or similar role, preferably within fast-paced tech environments or marketplaces.
- Deep understanding of A/B test design and edge cases, causal inference, and statistical analysis.
- High level experience in SQL skills with practical experience on large-scale data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake), solid Python skills for complex analytics, automation, and data visualisation.
- Proven ability to design, build, and optimize data pipelines. You take ownership of data curation to ensure that all business decisions are based on a foundation of reliable, high-quality data, and proven track record of building actionable data-stories and dashboards (Tableau, Looker, or similar) that drive business decisions.
- Demonstrated experience mentoring junior analysts and leading high-impact projects with autonomy. You can influence stakeholders without formal authority.

Nice to have:

- Experience with vendor/partner-centric products.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications will be given preferential consideration.

You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.
