jobs.title: Ohjaaja (ammatillinen tukihenkilö, perhetyöntekijä)
jobs.description:
**Haemme ammatillisia tukihenkilöitä ja perhetyöntekijöitä tekemään merkityksellistä työtä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden tueksi Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueella.**

Haluatko tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden parissa ja samalla kuulua rennon, aidosti välittävän työyhteisön joukkoon? Me Tukiluotsilla etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme sitoutuneita ja kokeneita tuntityöntekijöitä ammatillisen tukihenkilötoiminnan ja tehostetun perhetyön tehtäviin Keski-Uudenmaan alueelle. (Hyvinkää-Tuusula-Järvenpää-Nurmijärvi-Mäntsälä).

**Keitä me olemme?**

Tukiluotsi on vuonna 2024 perustettu kotimainen sosiaalialan yritys, joka tarjoaa yksilöllisiä ja vaikuttavia lastensuojelun avopalveluita. Toimimme lähellä asiakkaita ja yhteistyössä perheiden, verkostojen ja tilaajien kanssa. Meille on tärkeää tehdä työtä kohdaten asiakkaamme inhimillisesti, ammattitaitoisesti ja asiakaslähtöisesti. Toimitilamme sijaitsee Nurmijärvellä.

**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?**

**Ammatillinen tukihenkilötyö**

Ammatillisen tukihenkilön työssä kuljet 12-17-vuotiaan nuoren rinnalla hänen arjessaan ja autat häntä löytämään omia vahvuuksiaan ja suuntaa tulevaisuuteen. Työ on tavoitteellista ja suunnitelmallista, mutta samalla joustavaa ja nuoren yksilöllisistä tarpeista lähtevää, ja siihen voi sisältyä esimerkiksi harrastuksiin osallistumista, koulunkäynnin tukemista ja yhdessä tekemistä. Tukihenkilönä olet tärkeä turvallinen aikuinen, joka kuuntelee, keskustelee ja tarjoaa nuorelle myönteisiä kokemuksia arjen keskellä.

**Tehostettu perhetyö**

Tehostetussa perhetyössä työskentelet tiiviisti koko perheen kanssa heidän arjessaan ja tuet heitä löytämään uusia voimavaroja ja ratkaisuja. Työ on tavoitteellista ja muutokseen tähtäävää, mutta samalla inhimillistä ja perheen yksilöllisestä tilanteesta lähtevää. Käytännössä se voi tarkoittaa vanhemmuuden tukemista, arjen hallinnan vahvistamista ja perheen sisäisen vuorovaikutuksen kehittämistä. Olet rinnalla kulkeva ammattilainen, joka tarjoaa perheelle apua sekä pienissä arjen asioissa että haastavissa muutosvaiheissa. Työskentelyssä painottuu läheinen yhteistyö perheen verkostojen, kuten koulun, varhaiskasvatuksen ja muiden toimijoiden kanssa. Tärkeintä on, että perhe ei jää yksin vaan saa rinnalleen välittävän ja luotettavan ammattilaisen. Tehostettua perhetyötä tehdään työparin kanssa

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

- Vähintään 2 vuoden työkokemusta lastensuojelutyöstä

- Mahdollisuutta työskentelyyn iltapäivisin / iltapainotteisesti

- Mahdollisuus työskennellä vähintään 20 tuntia viikossa (tuntimäärää voi myös kasvattaa halutessaan)

- Sosiaali- tai terveysalan tutkintoa (esim. sosionomi AMK)

- Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta (kilometrikorvaus 0,55 €/km)

- Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa (suullinen ja kirjallinen)

- Rikosrekisteriotteen esittäminen (lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelyä varten)

- Rekisteröintiä Valviran JulkiTerhikki/JulkiSuosikki-rekisteriin


**Luemme eduksi:**

- Kokemuksen avopalveluista- tai liikkuvasta tehtävästä työstä

- Kanta-verkkokoulujen suoritukset


**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- Palkkaus yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisesti, palkkaluokka G25e (+ ilta- ja viikonloppulisät sekä lomakorvaus)

- Kilometrikorvaukset työajoista

- Ennaltaehkäisevän työterveyden ja etälääkäripalvelut

- Perehdytyksen ja esihenkilön tuen, et jää yksin haastavissakaan tilanteissa

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omiin työaikoihisi ja työn sisältöön

- Rennon ja välittömän työyhteisön, jossa huumori ja aitous kuuluvat arkeen


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos haluat olla mukana rakentamassa merkityksellistä ja vaikuttavaa työtä lasten ja perheiden parhaaksi, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme! Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana joten jätä hakemuksesi pian!

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si sähköpostitse osoitteeseen **rekrytointi@tukiluotsi.fi**

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa

Tiia-Tuulia Peltola

jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our creative team part-time (25 hours per week), with the potential to grow into a full-time opportunity.

Since 1988, Miranda Creative has partnered with more than 6,000 clients across finance, hospitality, healthcare, manufacturing, tourism, and government. We're a full-service, award-winning, New England-based creative and strategic agency. We pride ourselves on being a highly inclusive, collaborative community built on creativity, trust, and joy. We welcome you to Miranda Creative and look forward to learning more about you.

This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys bringing brands to life through thoughtful design, understands the importance of consistency, and has experience creating both static and motion-based content. The primary focus of this position will be supporting production needs, ensuring brand standards are implemented accurately, and helping deliver high-quality creative work across print, digital, social, and web platforms.

The right candidate is organized, collaborative, detail-focused, and comfortable working within established brand systems while applying strong design judgment. We are seeking someone who is consistently available 5 hours per day ( 9 to 2 EST), and who is located in the Eastern Standard time zone in order to coordinate internal and external meetings and deadlines. All candidates will be asked to provide a link to their portfolio, professional references, and confirmation of their scheduling availability. We look forward to hearing from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the creative team with ongoing production design needs
  • Accurately implement brand guidelines across print, digital, social media, and marketing materials
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and attention to detail across all deliverables
  • Prepare production-ready files for print and digital applications
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into multiple formats and platforms
  • Manage design updates, revisions, and ongoing brand-related projects
  • Create motion graphics, animations, and video edits for digital content
  • Support the development of social media assets, including short-form video and animated content
  • Assist with website and digital design projects using Figma
  • Collaborate with creative leadership and project teams to meet deadlines and maintain quality standards
  • Maintain organized files and follow established creative workflows

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional graphic design experience
  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, color, composition, and visual hierarchy
  • Ability to work within established brand guidelines with accuracy and consistency
  • Strong production skills and excellent attention to detail
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, including:
    • Adobe Illustrator
    • Adobe Photoshop
    • Adobe InDesign
    • Adobe After Effects and/or Premiere Pro
  • Experience creating motion graphics, animations, and video edits
  • Proficiency in Figma for digital design, collaboration, and presentation
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a remote environment
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with a remote team

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in an agency or fast-paced creative environment
  • Experience supporting established brands and large-scale marketing campaigns
  • Understanding of digital design systems and responsive web design
  • Experience preparing files for print production
  • Knowledge of animation principles and video storytelling
  • Ability to identify design or production issues before they impact timelines

Benefits

This part time role is eligible for pro-rated paid time off benefits. The part-time salary range for this position is $35,000 to $40,000, with salary commensurate with skills and experience.

jobs.title: Consultant expérimenté, Managers et Senior Manager en Stratégie, Finance et Transformation ESG H/F
jobs.description:
Au sein des équipes « Finance durable et Risques ESG » d'EY France, votre rôle sera d'aider nos clients du secteur financier sur une large palette de missions dont :



Stratégie ESG et planification de la transition

Cadrage et mise en œuvre de plans stratégiques climat et de modèle d'affaire « durable »

Définition d'une stratégie de décarbonation et opérationnalisation du cycle de vie du crédit

Conception de plan de transition climatique ou lié à la biodiversité

Intégration des risques de ESG dans le cadre d'appétence pour les risques



Modèles opérationnels et Gouvernance ESG

Définition et mise en œuvre de modèles opérationnels cibles ESG pour les métiers et les fonctions transverses et régaliennes

Conception et déploiement d'un cadre de gouvernance ESG (rôles et responsabilités des lignes de défense, comitologie, processus d'escalade.) ou d'un cadre de gestion des risques climatiques et ESG (gouvernance, identification, mesure, contrôle, suivi.)

Accompagner les entreprises dans leur passage société à mission (définition de la raison d'être et des engagements, déclinaison opérationnelle, sécurisation du dispositif de reporting .)



Opérationnalisation de l'ESG dans le pilotage stratégique et financier

Analyse et prise en considération de la sensibilité des différentes dimensions ESG au sein des différentes composantes de planification financière et de gestion de la solvabilité

Evaluation des différents impacts des composantes ESG au sein de la gestion ALM (écoulement, modélisation, tarification, gestion.)



Intégration de l'ESG dans les processus métiers

Opérationnalisation de méthodologie d'évaluation de l'empreinte carbone, de score ESG, de score de transition ou de risque physique (avis client, chargé d'affaire.)

Refonte et adaptation des processus front-to-back-to-risk (processus, gouvernance, données, SI)



Données ESG

Liste de l'ensemble des cas d'usage (métiers, réglementaire, risques.) et construction de la cartographie des données ESG (externes, internes.)

Définition du dictionnaire de données ESG, sourcing des données et du processus de collecte

Identification des impacts sur les processus opérationnels front to back et sur le SI

Analyse de couverture et de qualité des providers externes de données ESG (CDP, Bloomberg, Vigeo, Sustainalytics , Refinitiv.)





Gestion de programme de transformation ESG

Projets de transformation ESG et plans d'optimisation des processus, des organisations et des outils

Conduite et pilotage des projets de transformation métiers et fonctions





Vous évoluerez au sein d'un département dédié aux problématiques du secteur financier, alliant forte expertise, esprit d'initiative, adaptabilité et qualités relationnelles, notamment dans un contexte de contacts permanents ave nos clients.

jobs.title: Legal Receptionist Fully
jobs.description:
Adams & Martin Group is working with a boutique family law and civil litigation firm to identify an experienced Legal Receptionist to join their team. This fully remote direct hire opportunity is ideal for a highly organized, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced legal environment, enjoys client interaction, and can effectively manage high call volume while supporting attorneys and legal staff.

Responsibilities



Reception & Client Communication

* Answer high-volume inbound phone calls across multiple lines and route calls appropriately
* Take detailed notes and messages while ensuring accurate communication with attorneys and staff
* Professionally communicate with prospective and existing clients regarding their legal matters
* Conduct initial client screening and gather relevant information
* Serve as the primary point of contact for callers and provide exceptional client service
* Make outbound calls on behalf of attorneys as needed

Calendar & Administrative Support

* Schedule consultations, appointments, and meetings while maintaining multiple calendars
* Enter and track important court dates, deadlines, appointments, and client communications
* Provide timely reminders to attorneys and staff regarding upcoming deadlines and events
* Maintain accurate contact records and client information databases
* Assist with general administrative and office support functions

Legal Documentation & Case Support

* Assist with document preparation, correspondence, and client communications
* Scan, organize, label, and file legal and administrative documents
* Preserve and maintain updated case records and filing systems
* Assist with legal filings and e-filings as needed
* Summarize documents and draft basic correspondence for attorney review
* Conduct documentary and statistical research when requested

Records Management & Data Entry

* Maintain organized digital client files and records
* Input information into Excel spreadsheets, billing systems, and case management software
* Source and verify important case information and documentation
* Ensure confidentiality and accuracy when handling sensitive client information
* Support attorneys and staff with case-related administrative projects

Qualifications

* Minimum of 2 years of receptionist experience required, preferably within a law firm
* Legal receptionist experience strongly preferred
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to manage high call volume while maintaining professionalism and accuracy
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong calendaring and scheduling experience
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite required
* Experience with legal technology, court-filing systems, or case management software preferred
* Experience with MyCase, RingCentral, Microsoft Word, and Excel is a plus
* Outstanding time management and multitasking abilities
* High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred
* Mandarin proficiency is a plus
* Cantonese proficiency is a plus









Compensation & Benefits

* $20.00-$40.00 per hour DOE
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Life insurance
* 401(k)
* Paid time off
* Paid sick leave
* Birthday off
* Quarterly half-days
* Work-from-home stipend
* Health and wellness stipend
* Flexible scheduling
* Travel reimbursement



Please submit your resume for confidential consideration.

jobs.title: Mining, manufacturing and construction supervisors
jobs.description: Per conto di una realtà industriale strutturata, operante in ambito Alimentare, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Head of Quality (QHSE). La posizione riveste un ruolo strategico all'interno dell'organizzazione e prevede la responsabilità complessiva della definizione, implementazione e governo dei sistemi di qualità, sicurezza e conformità lungo l'intera catena del valore. Il contesto è caratterizzato da processi produttivi complessi, elevati standard operativi e un'interazione costante con stakeholder interni ed esterni, tra cui clienti, enti certificatori e autorità competenti. La figura contribuirà in modo diretto al presidio e all'evoluzione del Sistema di Gestione Qualità (SGQ/QMS), assicurando il rispetto degli standard normativi e delle best practice di settore e promuovendo una cultura diffusa orientata al miglioramento continuo (CI). In questo ambito, avrà la responsabilità di definire la strategia qualità, supportando il top management nell'individuazione e nella gestione dei rischi legati a qualità, sicurezza e compliance. Tra le principali responsabilità rientrano la gestione e il continuo aggiornamento dei sistemi di qualità, con riferimento ai principali standard, tra cui HACCP, IFS e ISO, nonché la supervisione delle policy aziendali e della documentazione tecnica. La risorsa sarà responsabile della gestione strutturata delle non conformità e dei reclami, attraverso l'implementazione di processi CAPA e attività di root cause analysis, e guiderà il monitoraggio dei KPI di qualità e performance, contribuendo allo sviluppo di iniziative di miglioramento continuo. Il ruolo prevede inoltre la supervisione degli audit interni, delle verifiche da parte dei clienti e degli enti certificatori, nonché la gestione delle relazioni con organismi di controllo e fornitori. Sarà inoltre responsabile del mantenimento e dello sviluppo delle certificazioni aziendali e del presidio dei processi di qualifica e monitoraggio dei fornitori. Dal punto di vista organizzativo, la figura guiderà il team qualità, coordinando risorse tecniche e laboratori, e rappresenterà un punto di riferimento trasversale per le principali funzioni aziendali, tra cui Produzione, Supply Chain, Acquisti e Manutenzione. Avrà inoltre un ruolo chiave nel garantire la coerenza tra gli standard definiti e la loro applicazione operativa nei processi produttivi, con particolare attenzione agli aspetti di sicurezza, igiene, tracciabilità e conformità documentale. Il profilo ideale ha maturato un'esperienza consolidata in ruoli di responsabilità nella funzione qualità, all'interno di contesti produttivi strutturati, e possiede una solida conoscenza dei sistemi SGQ/QMS e dei principali standard normativi e di certificazione. Completano il profilo una spiccata leadership, capacità di operare in contesti complessi, forte orientamento al risultato e al miglioramento continuo, nonché eccellenti capacità relazionali e di gestione degli stakeholder. La posizione si inserisce in un contesto dinamico e in evoluzione, offrendo la possibilità di contribuire in maniera significativa allo sviluppo dei processi e al rafforzamento del sistema qualità aziendale. #LI-CP Wyser è il brand globale che si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive di Gi Group Holding, la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro e una tra le principali realtà che offrono servizi e consulenza HR a livello globale. jobs.description:
Oula delivers maternity care built around our patientsâoffering comprehensive support before, during, and after pregnancy. With fewer C-sections and higher VBAC success rates, our research-backed approach is delivering better outcomes. Our team of trusted midwives, OBGYNs, and dedicated care navigators ensure our patients get the type of care they need in the moments that matter most.

Since launching in 2021, weâve expanded to include Preconception and Miscarriage Care, Pregnancy Care, Postpartum Support, and Gynecology. We currently have 4 clinics in the tri-state area, with three new clinics opening in 2026! Come join our team of clinicians, innovators, operators, and technologists passionate about setting a new standard in maternity care.

OULA HEALTH

Product Manager

Full-Time

  • New York, Chicago or Charlotte
  • Reports to VP, Central Operations

About Oula

Oula Health is a venture-backed, midwifery-led maternity and GYN care company building the next generation of women's healthcare. We partner exclusively with major health systems â including Mount Sinai, Stamford Health, and Novant Health â to embed our collaborative OB-GYN and midwifery model directly inside their networks. We're a team of ~100 people at Series B stage, with 4 clinics today and three more opening in 2026.

The Role

At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR â it integrates directly into it. Every product and engineering decision has downstream consequences for how our EHRs are configured, and every EHR configuration decision shapes what's possible on the product side. Someone has to hold both at once.

We're looking for a technically-minded Product Manager to own and evolve our core technology stack â including our EHR, patient portal, and care management platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and health system integration, serving as the internal and external subject matter expert on our EMR and the primary lead for health system EHR integrations.

You'll manage the day-to-day health of our tech stack, partnering closely with both internal teams and external health system stakeholders to ensure our systems run smoothly and our integrations deliver. You can sit with a midwife and understand why a clinical template matters, then turn around and write a bug ticket that engineering can actually action, then build the SOP so the next market launch doesn't require you to be in the room. When things are ambiguous (and they often are), you'll lean in rather than wait for clarity.

What You'll Own

EHR Configuration & Clinical Systems

  • Own day-to-day management of our core tech stack: the EHR, patient portal, and care management platform
  • Own Athena and Epic configuration end to end: clinical templates, order sets, lab configurations, payer connectivity, and access management for clinical and ops staff
  • Lead EHR integration efforts as the internal and external subject matter expert â FHIR/HL7 data exchange, health system IT coordination and committed go-live timelines
  • Own and accelerate Epic integration timelines as we onboard additional health system partners
  • Maintain configuration integrity as new markets launch and care model workflows evolve
  • Partner with our IT team on infrastructure; own the clinical systems layer they don't touch

Product Operations & Launch

  • Own bug intake and prioritization from Market Operations â standardize how Engineering receives, scopes, and resolves issues and communicates status back to the field
  • Build structured launch toolkits and training materials so clinic teams are prepared for new feature rollouts on day one
  • Coordinate end-to-end launches across Product, Engineering, and Operations
  • Identify where AI and automation can reduce manual administrative burden in product operations workflows

Standards & Knowledge Management

  • Build and maintain the clinical systems SOP library so new market setup is repeatable â documented well enough that a new hire can execute without you in the room
  • Develop onboarding materials for clinic managers and clinical staff on EHR workflows and tooling
  • Drive feature parity efforts so patients and clinicians experience a consistent standard of care across markets

Data & Reporting

  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking feature adoption, issue resolution, and rollout health across clinics
  • Develop quarterly reporting for Product, leadership, and health system partners on platform performance
  • Ensure data infrastructure is in place to measure the impact of every feature rollout

What You Bring

  • 3+ years with product operations, technical program management, or PM-adjacent work â ideally at a growth-stage digital health or services company
  • Strong problem-solving instincts and genuine curiosity â you like figuring out how things work and making them work better
  • Ease with ambiguity and a bias toward action; this role requires you to create the playbook, not execute someone else's
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and drive aggressive timelines â ideally with client-facing or health system-facing experience
  • Ability to speak âmultiple languagesâ â comfort going deep on technical details while communicating clearly to non-technical audiences; you can write a bug ticket, an SOP, and a launch plan that people actually follow; hands-on EHR configuration and integration experience strongly preferred
  • Analytical enough to build a dashboard and identify a pattern, even if you're not a SQL expert

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you've audited our current Athena configuration, identified gaps, and have a remediation plan. You understand the bug triage process well enough to have improved it. You've met your counterparts at every health system partner and know what's coming for the next Epic integration.

At six months, new market launches have a repeatable systems and product checklist. Clinic teams know what to expect before a feature goes live. Bug resolution time is measurably faster and the field is no longer sending issues into a black hole.

At one year, the SOP library is comprehensive, clinical systems configuration is stable and documented, and you've successfully navigated at least one new health system EHR environment. The product team has a reliable partner and the ops team isn't dependent on any single person for systems knowledge.

Compensation & Details

Salary: $110,000 â $140,000 depending on experience and location

Equity: Options commensurate with level

Location: Preference for New York/New Jersey/Connecticut, Chicago or Charlotte Remote-flexible with periodic travel to clinic locations and health system partners

Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision; 401(k); generous PTO

Oula offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, and comprehensive benefits. Exact compensation inclusive of salary and any bonuses is determined based on a number of factors including experience and skill level, location, and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Oula is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone's contributions are valued.

Salary Range: $110,000 USD - $140,000 USD

If that's you, don't hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself (especially in your cover letter â this is where you can really state your case for *why you*). We are committed to fostering diversity in our organization and building an equitable and inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and experiences. jobs.title: Senior Sales Director (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Sales Director

Luxembourg

Sonata One is a rapidly scaling, regulated fund services and technology (fintech) business.  We're The Private Funds Clearinghouse, connecting more than 53,000 investors with 6,500 funds and 180 fund managers around the globe. Our vision is to change the paradigm of private markets investing through harmonising the end-to-end investment process within one platform. Investors benefit from a seamless, one & done experience across the fund lifecycle (from fund selection and subscription through to settlement and reporting) underpinned by a globally compliant KYC passport and 24/5 support. Fund managers can raise capital faster at a lower cost from a wider pool of pre-approved investors.  Founded in 2015, Sonata One has a presence in eight locations worldwide including the US, UK and Luxembourg, Guernsey, South Africa and Mauritius.    

We operate as #OneGlobalThread in line with our values: We challenge the norm, we change the way we think and work, by connecting systems and people, while committing to our vision and each other. We are now looking to recruit a Senior Sales Director to join our global team.

Position Overview:

We are hiring a senior, network-led commercial professional to acquire new logos across the global private markets ecosystem.
While the primary focus will be on top-tier General Partners, this role also spans a broader client base including private credit platforms, real asset managers, venture capital firms, secondaries investors, and fund-of-funds.

This is not a traditional sales role. You will operate as a strategic hunter, leveraging an existing network across private markets to engage both economic and technical buyers including Group Financial Controllers, CFOs, Finance Directors, Heads of Operations, Head of Compliance, Investor Relations and Finance Transformation leaders.
You will play a critical role in shaping how private markets participants across fund managers and adjacent structures, adopt next-generation infrastructure, driving standardisation, efficiency, and liquidity across the ecosystem.
 
Responsibilities 

Proven track record selling into the private market's ecosystem, including but not limited to:  

• General Partners (GPs) across private equity, private credit, real assets, and venture capital  
• Mid-market and emerging managers  
• Secondaries investors and platforms  
• Fund-of-funds and multi-manager platforms  
• Institutional investors (LPs) including pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and asset managers (where relevant to fund operations and infrastructure)  
• Private markets service providers, including fund administrators, custodians, and outsourced finance providers  
Established network across senior stakeholders within private markets, with demonstrable access to decision-makers across both fund managers and the wider ecosystem  

Demonstrated ability to engage and close with:  

• Technical buyers (Fund Operations, Finance Transformation, Middle Office, Fund Accounting, and Systems/Technology stakeholders)  
• Economic buyers (CFO, Group Financial Controller, Finance Director, Operating Partner level)  
• Experience selling complex, high-value solutions such as financial infrastructure, fund administration, data platforms, or fintech solutions into sophisticated financial institutions  
• Strong understanding of how different participants across private markets interact operationally (GP–LP relationships, fund administrators, intermediaries), and where inefficiencies or friction points exist

Commercial Profile

• True “hunter” mentality with a relationship-first approach  
• Established track record in selling to economic buyers across private markets
• Strong commercial judgement and experience structuring enterprise-level deals

jobs.title: JUNIOR ENGINEER IN NETWORK ARCHITECTURE AND DISTRIBUTED SENSING (m/f)

jobs.description:
SD-26130-JUNIOR ENGINEER IN NETWORK ARCHITECTURE AND DISTRIBUTED SENSING
Fixed term contract | Belval | 12 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

Describe the main responsibilities of the position.

As a Junior R&T Engineer in the NETCOM group, you will contribute to cutting-edge research on wireless network architectures and distributed communication systems, with applications spanning aerial and space platforms. Under the supervision of experienced researchers and engineers, your main responsibilities will include:
• Network architecture design: Contribute to the definition and modelling of communication network architectures for multi-node distributed systems, including the specification of inter-node link technologies, bandwidth and latency requirements, and Quality of Service (QoS) classes.
• Protocol development: Assist in the design and implementation of cross-layer communication protocols, covering message prioritization, timing constraints, synchronization logic, and fault-tolerant fallback mechanisms for degraded link conditions.
• System integration: Support the definition of data formats and interface specifications required for the integration of communication layers with onboard sensing, processing, and command chain components.
• Simulation and performance evaluation: Develop and run simulation models to evaluate network performance under realistic operational conditions, contributing to the validation and benchmarking of proposed architectural solutions.
• Prototyping and testing: Assist in the implementation and laboratory testing of communication modules, including SDR-based platforms and protocol stacks, contributing to the validation of prototypes in controlled environments.
• Documentation and reporting: Contribute to the drafting of technical deliverables, scientific publications, and presentations at project meetings or conferences.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

• Master's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.
• Studies covering one or more of the following topics: wireless communication systems and protocols, network architecture and design, distributed systems, artificial intelligence, software-defined networking, or embedded systems.

Experience and skills

• 0 to 2 years of relevant professional or research experience (including internships and Master's thesis work) in wireless networks, communication protocol design, or distributed time-sensitive systems.
• Good understanding of network architecture design principles, including protocol stack design, Quality of Service (QoS), and link management.
• Familiarity with inter-node communication and coordination protocols for distributed or multi-agent systems.
• Knowledge of wireless communication technologies and standards.
• Programming skills in Python, C/C++, or MATLAB for simulation, performance evaluation, and protocol implementation.
• Familiarity with network simulation tools (e.g., ns-3, OMNET++, or equivalent).
• Ability to work under supervision while progressively developing autonomy.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to interpret results and formulate conclusions.
• Collaborative mindset, comfortable working in a multidisciplinary and international consortium environment.

Language skills
• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square meters, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfill their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:

• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
• A CV with contact details

Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.

Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.

As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.

Due to the requirements of the project, we can only consider applications from nationals of a NATO Member Country, from an EU EEA/EFTA Country or from one of the following NATO Indo-Pacific Partners, Australia, Japan, Republic of South Korea and New Zealand.
This position offers a gross monthly salary between €5043 and €5527, paid over 13 months (€65559–€71851 annually) based on full time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience .

For part time employment, the salary is adjusted pro rata.

It is to be noted that LIST also offers real opportunities for career growth, both in terms of responsibilities and salary progression, as employees develop within LIST.

Zahvaljujući njihovu zalaganju i kvaliteti te vrijednostima koje dijele s kompanijom, PIK ima vodeću poziciju na tržištu.

•Praćenje parametara rada uređaja, vođenje dnevnika

Položen ispit Strojar kompresorske stanice ili Strojar kotlovskog postrojenja je prednost.

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About HiredBuddy

At HiredBuddy, we connect domain specialists and subject-matter experts with leading AI research labs to shape and train the next generation of artificial intelligence. We focus on high-quality data annotation, RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), and model evaluation across various domains, ranging from STEM and software engineering to linguistics and data science.

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Junior Data Analyst based in the United States to join our growing remote team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in monitoring dataset quality, analyzing annotator performance metrics, optimizing labeling pipelines, and delivering insights that improve our AI training data pipelines.

This is an ideal role for an early-career analyst passionate about the intersection of data, machine learning, and AI operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Quality Assurance: Audit, clean, and validate large datasets generated by our network of AI trainers and domain experts to ensure high precision and adherence to guidelines.
  • Performance & Metrics Tracking: Analyze annotator accuracy, turnaround times, and throughput using SQL, Python, and BI dashboards to help optimize operations.
  • Pipeline Optimization: Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Operations, AI Specialists, and Product) to identify bottlenecks in data labeling pipelines and recommend data-driven solutions.
  • Reporting & Dashboards: Build, maintain, and update daily/weekly operational reports and dashboards for internal stakeholders and client leads.
  • Guideline Calibration: Analyze edge cases and error patterns in dataset outputs to help refine project annotation instructions and rubrics.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Education: Bachelorâs degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficiency with SQL for data querying, aggregation, and analysis.
  • Practical knowledge of Python or R for data manipulation (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experience with visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills (Pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, complex formulas).
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a high degree of attention to detail when working with complex datasets.
  • Communication: Ability to clearly translate data findings into actionable insights for non-technical team members.
  • Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, data annotation workflows, or RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback).
  • Prior experience or internship experience in an operations-focused analyst role.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the US.
  • Cutting-Edge Industry Exposure: Gain hands-on experience at the forefront of AI model training and evaluation.
  • Growth Opportunities: Direct mentorship and opportunities to advance within a fast-growing tech environment.
  • Competitive Compensation: Hourly/Salaried rate commensurate with experience.

jobs.title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

jobs.title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
jobs.description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

OSI Europe is a leading company in the food industry, specializing in the production of high-quality food products. With several production sites in Europe and a global distribution network, we offer first-class solutions for customers worldwide.

jobs.title: Kok søges til Couloir
jobs.description:
KOK SØGES TIL COULOIR // AMAGER STRAND

Couloir er et lille, ambitiøst og personligt spisested tæt på Amager Strand. Vi laver mad med udgangspunkt i det nordiske køkken – med et legende og uformelt twist – og vi lægger vægt på smag, stemning og sammenhold.

Vi søger en dygtig og passioneret kok, som har lyst til at blive en del af et lille team med højt til loftet og stort engagement. Du skal have lyst til at tage ansvar, bidrage med idéer og være med til at skabe en arbejdsplads, hvor vi har det godt – og laver noget, vi er stolte af.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra a la carte-køkkener og kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Trives i et køkken, hvor tempo og detaljer går hånd i hånd

  • Har lyst til at være med til at udvikle menuen og dagligdagen

  • Er en holdspiller og bidrager positivt til stemningen i huset

Vi tilbyder:

  • Gode arbejdstider med fokus på work-life balance

  • Et køkken hvor idéer og smag prioriteres over dogmer

  • Et lille team med høj faglighed og en uformel tone

  • Mulighed for ansvar og medindflydelse

Stillingen er fuldtid og ønskes besat snarest muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette.

Lyder det som noget for dig – eller kender du nogen, vi bør tale med – så send en ansøgning til kasper@couloir.dk eller kig forbi og sig hej.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

    Develop high-quality bidding documents, ensuring alignment with strategies and customer expectations
    Take responsibility for document quality and timely submission

    Ensure that bidding processes and standards are consistently followed
    Coordinate resources, develop bidding plans, and manage tasks across the bidding team

    Maintain and archive bidding documentation in a structured and accurate manner

    Solid understanding of at least one of the following areas: wireless, core network, datacom, access network, IT, or data storage

Location: Stockholm

jobs.title: Gestionnaire de Parc - Régisseur Technique Événementiel (H/F)
jobs.description:
Gestionnaire de parc - Régisseur Technique Événementiel:
Type de contrat
CDI temps plein 35h
Lieu de travail
Conflans-Sainte-Honorine (78)
Salaire
2 000 à 2 300 euros brut par mois selon profil et expérience

Description de l'entreprise
We Rise est une société spécialisée dans la prestation technique événementielle basée en Ile-de-France. Nous accompagnons nos clients sur des événements professionnels, institutionnels, culturels et privés grâce à nos expertises en sonorisation, éclairage, vidéo, captation, murs LED et location de matériel.
Description du poste
Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recrutons un Assistant Chargé de Production Technique & Gestionnaire de Dépôt. Ce poste est central dans l'organisation des prestations de l'entreprise.
Le titulaire du poste assurera la gestion du dépôt et du parc matériel, participera à la préparation technique des événements, coordonnera les ressources nécessaires à la bonne réalisation des prestations et assurera le suivi des sous-locations et fournisseurs.
Ce recrutement peut faire l'objet d'une POEI (Préparation Opérationnelle à l'Emploi Individuelle) en partenariat avec France Travail pour les candidats éligibles.

Missions principales
Gestion du dépôt et du parc matériel : suivi des entrées et sorties, organisation du dépôt, préparation des commandes, contrôle des retours, inventaires, suivi SAV et réparations, maintenances préventives, gestion des consommables.
Préparation technique des prestations : analyse des besoins techniques, construction des listes de matériel dans Rentman, vérification des disponibilités, identification des besoins en sous-location, préparation des dossiers techniques et briefs équipes, rédaction des feuilles de route.
Coordination opérationnelle : planification des équipes techniques, organisation des chargements et déchargements, suivi opérationnel des projets, circulation des informations entre les intervenants.
Gestion des sous-locations et fournisseurs : identification des besoins, consultation des fournisseurs, suivi des devis, organisation des retraits et retours de matériel sous-loué.

Profil recherché
Expérience indispensable dans la prestation technique événementielle, acquise chez un prestataire technique audiovisuel ou une structure événementielle. Une expérience en préparation de matériel, exploitation, régie, sonorisation, éclairage ou vidéo constitue un atout.
Formation souhaitée : BTS Métiers de l'Audiovisuel, BTS Techniques du Spectacle, Licence Professionnelle ou formation équivalente dans les métiers de l'événementiel.

Compétences requises
Bonne connaissance de l'environnement de la prestation technique événementielle. Bonne culture générale des métiers du son, de l'éclairage et de la vidéo. Excellente aisance informatique et appétence pour les logiciels métiers. La connaissance de Rentman constitue un plus. Organisation, rigueur, sens des responsabilités, esprit d'équipe et capacité d'apprentissage.
Evolution du poste
Selon les compétences et l'autonomie acquises, des évolutions vers les fonctions de Chargé de Production Technique, Coordinateur Technique ou Responsable Exploitation Technique sont envisagées.

Avantages
Heures supplémentaires rémunérées ou récupérées. Formation et accompagnement à la prise de poste.

Candidature
Merci de lire cette annonce jusqu'au bout avant de postuler.
Pour que votre candidature soit étudiée, vous devez impérativement remplir le formulaire de candidature à l'adresse suivante :
https://forms.gle/63tGZx4rHBMD3SQm8
Les candidatures transmises sans formulaire complété ne seront pas traitées.

jobs.title: Head of Demand Engine
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is looking for a Head of Demand Engine to build the engine that turns our best product stories, customer proof, and market opportunities into scaled pipeline. You’ll lead demand programs across campaigns, digital, paid strategy, webinars, email, web, and emerging channels. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing on audience and offer strategy, with Performance Marketing on paid execution, and with Field Marketing & Events on the moments that benefit from in-person activation.




This is a senior leadership role with both AMER and global scope. You’ll help set the global standard for how Notion plans, runs, tests, and measures demand programs, while learning from strong regional teams and making the best ideas repeatable across markets. You’ll lead a growing team spanning demand programs and digital demand, with room to expand into areas like partner marketing over time.




This is a build job as much as a run job. We’re looking for someone with real taste who can spot a strong idea, turn it into a sharp program, and build a repeatable engine around what works. You should care about quality and craft, but also love testing, data, systems, and execution. The opportunity is to modernize demand generation at one of the companies defining how teams work with AI.




This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the demand programs strategy, calendar, and operating rhythm across priority audiences, segments, and offers.

 - Turn strong product stories, content, customer proof, and market opportunities into integrated programs that can scale across channels and regions.

 - Build a high-velocity testing practice. Set a high bar for creative and execution, learn quickly, and put more weight behind what works.

 - Serve as the global point person for paid digital demand strategy. Define the audiences, offers, creative, programs, and goals, then partner closely with Performance Marketing on execution and optimization.

 - Lead digital demand across webinars, email, web, review sites, nurture, and new formats, creating new programs where the strategy calls for them.

 - Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps to build a trusted global approach to marketing ROI, attribution, forecasting, MQA/MQL methodology, and campaign reporting.

 - Work closely with Enterprise Product Marketing on audience, offer, and campaign strategy, and with Field Marketing & Events on coordinated execution.

 - Help build our muscle in account-based marketing and partner marketing as those motions develop.

 - Be a trusted partner to Sales and executive leadership. Bring a clear point of view, make the numbers legible, and advocate for what will have the most impact.

 - Hire, coach, and lead a strong team across demand programs and digital demand.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - A track record of building and scaling B2B demand programs that create qualified pipeline.

 - Strong judgment and taste. You can point to specific programs that worked because the audience, offer, creative, and execution were sharp.

 - Deep digital demand experience across paid strategy, email, web, webinars, nurture, and integrated campaigns.

 - A testing mindset and the operating discipline to turn learnings into repeatable programs, systems, and investment decisions.

 - Comfort with data. You can work closely with Marketing Ops and RevOps on attribution, reporting, forecasting, and ROI, and translate the numbers into clear action.

 - Executive presence. You earn trust with Sales and company leaders, hold a strong point of view, and are comfortable making hard calls.

 - Experience leading and developing strong teams in a fast-moving environment.

 - Experience operating across regions, or genuine curiosity and appetite to build globally.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. This model is still being written, and you’ll help write it.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building account-based marketing programs.

 - Experience with partner or ecosystem marketing.

 - Experience working across both product-led and sales-assisted growth motions.




WHY THIS ROLE

This is one of the most visible, highest-impact seats in Notion’s marketing org. You’ll have the mandate to build the demand engine, shape how we measure marketing ROI globally, and work directly with Sales, RevOps, company leaders, and regional marketing teams.



The playbook for B2B demand generation is changing. Buyers expect better content and experiences, AI is reshaping how programs get built, and old attribution models are under pressure. If you want to apply what already works, challenge what doesn’t, and help define a more modern model, this is the job.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $245,000 – $275,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Video Editor Reacts
jobs.description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

About the Role

MrBeast is looking for a data-driven, creative, and fast-paced Video Editor to join our Content & Post-Production team working on the MrBeast Reacts channel. This role is for a master-level editor who lives and breathes YouTube culture, capable of transforming raw multi-cam reaction feeds into hyper-engaging content that keeps millions of viewers locked in. You will thrive in a high-feedback environment, balancing aggressive production schedules with a relentless obsession for frame-by-frame pacing and audience retention.

What You'll Do
  • Cut and assemble raw multi-cam reaction footage, seamlessly balancing primary talent commentary, PIP source media, and visual punch-ins.
  • Engineer high-retention video intros and hooks that immediately fulfill title and thumbnail promises within the first 30 seconds.
  • Execute hyper-fast pacing, comedic timing, and visual pop-ups, including kinetic typography, memes, and custom tracking graphics.
  • Perform high-quality sound design, including impactful SFX, dynamic music ducking, and precise audio balancing for voice clarity.
  • Collaborate closely with Lead Editors and creative teams to incorporate rapid turnaround notes and feedback loops.
  • Analyze YouTube retention curves alongside lead editors to pinpoint drop-off moments and refine pacing rules for subsequent edits.
  • Maintain clean, highly organized timeline projects in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, adhering to internal post-production standards.
  • Coordinate with the thumbnail team to ensure visual assets and key video climaxes align perfectly with channel creative strategy.
  • Stay ahead of internet culture and viral editing meta to continuously inject fresh humor and visual variety into channel content.
What We're Looking For
  • 3+ years of professional video editing experience focused on high-pacing YouTube, commentary, or viral digital content.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects, specifically with keyframing, motion tracking, masking, and dynamic linking.
  • Deep structural understanding of YouTube algorithm dynamics, Average View Duration (AVD), CTR, and retention curve analysis.
  • Mastery of dynamic sound design, audio leveling, and music curation to enhance comedic and emotional shifts.
  • A data-driven mindset that prioritizes viewer retention evidence over personal creative assumptions.
  • High feedback sensitivity, with the ability to handle rapid creative criticism constructively and pivot quickly.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, maintaining frame-by-frame precision in pacing and visual overlays.
  • Proven ability to manage high-volume workflows, including file compression, color correction, and final exports optimized for YouTube.
  • Extreme ownership over end-to-end video performance, production deadlines, and technical accuracy.
BenefitsThe Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

  • 401k Plan with Safe Harbor company-matching
  • Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
  • Company-provided technology packageÂ

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Area Sales Manager

Reports to:       

Director of Sales- East

Location:         

Remote- New York Metro

Status:              

FT/Exempt

Compensation:

$70,000 â $80,000 annual base salary, plus a competitive bonus opportunity. Final compensation will be commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications.


ABOUT THE COMPANY

ROAR is redefining hydration for a new generation. In a category that has become overly serious and hardcore performance obsessed, ROAR stands for something different: hydration that is expressive, effortless, and rooted in real life. Built for people who move, connect, and live life out loud, ROAR delivers complete hydration with vitamins, antioxidants, and electrolytes - all with just 20 calories and 3g of sugar or less per bottle.


More than a beverage, ROAR is a cultural signal - bright, approachable, and fun. It rejects the intensity and rules of traditional hydration in favor of something more human: joy, spontaneity, and the kind of movement that doesnât need a scoreboard. This positioning has resonated with consumers and retailers alike driving strong momentum across both natural and conventional retail, where ROAR continues to expand rapidly and now ranks as the #2 brand in the natural channel within the enhanced water category.

 

ROLE OVERVIEW

ROAR Organic is seeking a hands-on Sales Leader to drive profitable growth in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This role is responsible for leading all sales activities across grocery customers in the New York Metro area, including new business development, key account management, and executing data-driven strategies to expand market share and increase brand awareness.


The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of scaling high-growth brands profitably, with experience managing both established and emerging grocery retailers, as well as partners. They are highly relationship-driven, resourceful, and action-oriented, with strong communication and organizational skills. This leader excels at building and implementing the strategies, tools, and processes needed to support sustained growth.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Deliver against Annual Operating Plan targets, including gross/net sales and trade spend objectives.
  • Grow distribution and topline revenue with a focus on regional and independent retailers.
  • Execute customer sales strategies, promotional calendars, and account plans.
  • Leverage distributer incentive programs and independent retailer promotional opportunities to drive sales.
  • Conduct weekly route rides with distributor sales representatives to support execution and identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop and own a field execution strategy based on weekly trend reports, promotional planners, and merchandising opportunities.
  • Manage and execute trade spend programs to drive profitable growth and promotional effectiveness.
  • Leverage syndicated data (IRI, SPINS) to communicate compelling, retailer-specific presentations.
  • Track, measure, and analyze performance metrics, including ROI.
  • Represent the brand at regional and national trade shows, customer meetings, and industry events.

 

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 2 years of CPG sales experience.
  • Strong understanding of the beverage and grocery landscape, including retailers and distributors.
  • Experience executing sales planning initiatives.
  • Creative, solutions-oriented problem solver with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Thrives in a hands-on, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with syndicated data tools (SPINS, IRI) preferred.
  • Ability to travel extensively as needed.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift up to 30 pounds.
  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.

jobs.title: Yötyöpainotteinen Lähihoitaja
jobs.description:
**Oletko parhaimmillasi silloin, kun muu maailma nukkuu?**

Me etsimme **lähihoitajaa yötyö painotteiseen työhön** yhteisöllisen asumisen yksikköömme Raadelmaan Piikkiöön.

Yövuorossa työsi on paljon enemmän kuin valvomista. Olet turvallinen läsnäolija, ammattilainen, joka pitää huolen siitä, että asukkaamme voivat nukkua yönsä levollisin mielin. Sinulla on mahdollisuus tehdä työsi rauhassa, käyttää ammattitaitoasi monipuolisesti ja vaikuttaa aidosti ihmisten hyvinvointiin.

**Sinä voit olla etsimämme, jos**

- työskentelet luontevasti itsenäisesti ja osaat johtaa omaa työtäsi

- tartut asioihin oma-aloitteisesti

- olet luotettava, vastuullinen ja rauhallinen myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa

- haluat kohdata ihmiset arvostavasti ja inhimillisesti

- olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja

- yöpainotteinen työ sopii sinulle


**Meillä saat**

Työn, jossa sinuun luotetaan ja osaamistasi arvostetaan. Mahdollisuuden tehdä itsenäistä työtä ilman, että jäät yksin. Mukavan, osaavan ja helposti lähestyttävän työyhteisön. Huolellisen perehdytyksen ja tuen onnistumiseesi. Merkityksellisen työn, jossa jokainen työvuoro on tärkeä.

Meille tärkeintä ei ole vain se, mitä osaat tänään – vaan myös halusi kehittää osaamistasi ja tehdä työsi sydämellä.

**Kuulostaako omalta?** Lähetä hakemuksesi meille. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Voit tehdä 100% työaikaa tai halutessasi myös 80% työaika on sovittavissa.

**Yölläkin tehdään arvokasta työtä – tule tekemään sitä kanssamme.**

jobs.title: ⭐️Bedemand søges til vores afdelinger i Nordjylland⭐️
jobs.description:
Vi søger nu en bedemand, som har lyst til at blive en del af Min afsked. En kollega, som har lyst til at gøre en forskel for andre mennesker. Hvis du ser dig selv som kreativ, empatisk og respektfuld, har vi måske jobbet til dig.

Vi tilbyder et yderst interessant job med stor variation af opgaver, stor selvstændighed og frihed under ansvar.

Du får selvfølgelig grundig introduktion til vores virksomhed og jobbet som bedemand.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. bestå af:

- Samtaler med familier

- Administrative opgaver i forbindelse med begravelser og bisættelser

- Kørsel i rustvogn

- Afholdelse af højtideligheder

- Iklædning og istandgørelse af de afdøde

Du er god til at arbejde selvstændigt, fremstår respektfuld og empatisk. Du er kreativ og løsningsorienteret - både ift. dine kollegaer og ift. de pårørende. Du trives i et job, hvor det til tider er hektisk, med mange bolde i luften og hvor to dage ikke er ens.

Følgende kvalifikationer er en fordel men ikke et krav:

- Du er - eller har været - ansat som bedemand

- Du er erfaren bilist

- Du besidder basale IT-færdigheder

- Du er dygtig til at formulere dig på skrift

Stillingen er på gennemsnitligt 37 timer, og du kommer til at indgå i en vagtplan, hvor der også er aften- og weekendarbejde.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Send dit CV og ansøgning til Else på else@minafsked.dk

Spørgsmål vedr. jobbet rettes ligeledes til denne mail.

Tiltrædelse er hurtigst muligt og vi ansætter, når vi finder den rette til jobbet. Vi behandler derfor alle ansøgninger løbende.

jobs.description:
Are you a talented Senior Designer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

 

What we offer:

  • The rate depends on your skills and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers & designers.
  • No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — let us handle the business side of things so you can focus on what you do best.
  • Choose a schedule that works best for you. It’s possible to communicate async or minimally overlap within team working hours.
  • We respect your seniority so you can expect no micromanagement or screen trackers.
  • Communicate directly with the clients. Sounds good, yeah?
  • Most of our projects involve working in a fast-paced startup environment. We hope you like it as much as we do.

 

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in Graphic Design
  • 5+ years of commercial experience with Adobe Creative Suite & Adobe Illustrator

 

Other requirements:

  • Strong design craft — as a Senior Designer, you're expected to build polished, production-ready work from scratch, with a solid grasp of design systems, component architecture, and how your decisions translate into real product or brand outcomes.
  • Clear and confident communication in English — advanced ability to discuss creative briefs, defend design decisions, and flag blockers early. Strong self-presentation is essential, particularly on client calls.
  • High ownership, zero hand-holding — you thrive working full-time remotely, manage your own time, and consistently hit deadlines without being chased.
  • Reliability — we need to trust you completely. If you commit to something, you deliver it. If something changes, you communicate early.
  • Fast ramp-up — you can absorb project context quickly, align with existing style guides or brand directions, and start producing valuable work within the first days, not weeks.
