jobs.title: Sales & Marketing Director
jobs.description:
The main purpose of the Sales & Marketing Director is to own and lead the company's entire revenue generation function by overseeing both Sales and Marketing as one unified department. You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing strategies that generate qualified leads, improve sales performance, and drive sustainable revenue growth for Hustler Marketing.

This includes taking full ownership of the sales and marketing funnel, from generating the first client touchpoint to closing new business, while ensuring that every initiative, campaign, and sales process contributes to predictable and scalable growth. You will oversee lead generation, sales strategy, marketing channels, pipeline management, conversion optimization, team development, and departmental performance.

During your first phase in the role, you will audit our existing sales and marketing operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and personally lead key initiatives to rebuild and strengthen our growth engine. As the function matures, you will recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Sales and Marketing team while delegating execution and maintaining strategic oversight.

The Sales & Marketing Director will report directly to Company Leadership while working collaboratively with the Service Department and other cross-functional teams.

About The Role

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.

As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.

General Responsibilities

  • Owning the entire sales and marketing funnel from lead generation through to signed contracts and new client acquisition
  • Developing and executing the company's overall sales and marketing strategy in alignment with business growth objectives
  • Auditing existing sales and marketing processes, identifying operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implementing effective solutions
  • Building predictable and scalable lead generation systems across multiple acquisition channels, including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, paid acquisition, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Ensuring a consistent flow of qualified leads that supports the company's revenue targets
  • Improving sales performance by optimizing lead qualification, sales processes, pipeline management, and conversion rates
  • Personally leading strategic sales initiatives and key opportunities during the initial rebuild phase while remaining actively involved in high-value deals when required
  • Building, recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams as the departments continue to scale
  • Managing departmental budgets, hiring plans, resource allocation, and channel investment decisions to maximize return on investment
  • Establishing clear KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems across both Sales and Marketing functions
  • Monitoring pipeline health, lead generation performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, revenue forecasting, and overall commercial performance
  • Presenting regular performance reports, strategic recommendations, and revenue forecasts to Company Leadership
  • Working closely with the Service Department to ensure alignment between client expectations, sales commitments, and service delivery
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders to continuously improve client acquisition, onboarding, and long-term client success
  • Identifying new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, and innovative growth initiatives that contribute to the company's long-term expansion
  • Continuously researching industry trends, competitor activity, ecommerce developments, and emerging marketing strategies to maintain Hustler Marketing's competitive advantage
  • Developing scalable processes, documentation, and operational frameworks that improve departmental efficiency and long-term growth
  • Creating a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence across both Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participating in leadership meetings and contributing to the overall strategic direction of the company
  • Supporting other departments with commercial insights and strategic initiatives whenever required
  • Directly reporting to Company Leadership

Position Specs

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD, with uncapped performance-based commission tied to closed revenue
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months
  • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
  • Senior leadership position with direct ownership of Sales and Marketing strategy, budget, channels, and hiring

Requirements

About You

Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven leader with extensive experience building, leading, and scaling both sales and marketing functions. You have successfully owned revenue targets, developed high-performing teams, and implemented systems that generate predictable business growth.

You are equally comfortable developing long-term commercial strategy and personally executing critical initiatives when necessary. You understand that during periods of growth or transformation, leadership means rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and establishing the systems that others will later scale.

You have significant experience working within a digital agency or SaaS business serving ecommerce brands and understand the unique challenges of selling performance-based marketing services. You are highly analytical, data-driven, and focused on measurable business outcomes, using performance metrics to continuously optimize every stage of the customer acquisition funnel.

The right person is entrepreneurial, accountable, decisive, and capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Key Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience leading Sales, Marketing, or Revenue functions with direct ownership of commercial results
  • Proven experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams
  • Demonstrated ability to personally drive revenue growth while also developing scalable commercial systems and processes
  • Significant experience working within a digital marketing agency or SaaS company serving ecommerce businesses (required)
  • Proven success generating qualified leads through multiple acquisition channels including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Strong sales experience with a proven track record of personally closing new business and managing high-value sales opportunities
  • Excellent understanding of sales pipeline management, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and revenue forecasting
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure funnel performance, interpret commercial data, and make data-driven decisions
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, hiring, resource planning, and operational performance
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing remote teams
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote environment
  • Experience selling retention marketing services such as Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, or UGC services is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo, ecommerce marketing technology, and the broader ecommerce ecosystem is highly desirable
  • Existing relationships or network within the ecommerce or DTC industry is considered a strong advantage
  • Must possess excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (approximately 140 hours per month)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or desktop computer capable of attending virtual meetings
  • Must be open to receiving constructive feedback while also providing effective coaching and feedback to team members

Apprentices will work alongside experienced commercial and project teams, gaining exposure to cost management, procurement, contract administration, valuations, and project financial reporting. Apprentices are required to attend ATU Sligo during the first week of each semester and once per month thereafter to complete workshops and practical learning activities. Lectures are delivered online one day per week. Upon successful completion of all programme requirements, apprentices will be awarded a Bachelor of Science (Honours) Degree in Quantity Surveying (Level 8) on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ). jobs.title: Personlig assistent till ärende i centrala Jönköping
jobs.description:
Jönköpings kommun är en stor arbetsgivare med hundratals olika yrkesroller. Vi växer i takt med att kommunen utvecklas med fler invånare, fler bostäder och större utbud. Vi är alltid på jakt efter ny kompetens - medarbetare med olika bakgrunder och erfarenheter, med den gemensamma drivkraften att vilja skapa en bättre kommun att besöka, leva, verka och bo i.

Vill du arbeta stödjande för att underlätta någon annans vardag? Har du kanske intresse för hundar och trädgårdar? Då är det dig vi söker till ett av våra nya ärenden där relation, lyhördhet och respekt går hand i hand - Läs vidare för att veta mer!



Ditt nya jobb

Du kommer arbeta med en kvinna med en fysisk funktionsnedsättning som är i behov av personlig assisstans i vardagens alla moment. Du arbetar i medborgarens hem och närmiljö i Jönköping, och i hemmet finns två små glada sällskapshundar som du också kommer att vårda om. Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat socialt stöd, personlig omvårdnad, förflyttning och hushållsarbete så som städ, tvätt och matlagning. Medborgaren har en hörselnedsättning, så viktigt med tydlig kommunikation. Arbetet utgår alltid från medborgarens behov, dagsform men också önskemål med rätt till självbestämmande. Integritet, sekretess och ett professionellt bemötande är också avgörande i alla situationer.

Som personlig assistent är du ett stöd i vardagen genom att skapa struktur, delta i aktiviteter och bygga en förtroendefull relation. Arbetet formas efter individen och kan innebära allt från lugna stunder i hemmet till trädgårdsarbete och promenader av hundar, vi ser därmed gärna att du har intresse för växter och djur. Arbetet bygger på att skapa en långsiktig, trygg och förtroendefull relation med medborgaren där lyhördhet, respekt och kontinuitet är viktiga delar.

Din kompetens

    Vi ser gärna att du är utbildad personlig assistent, undersköterska eller barnskötare alternativt har annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig, men inget krav
    Meriterande med erfarenhet av arbete som personlig assistent eller inom vård och omsorg
    Meriterande med grundläggande kunskaper om personlig assistans och självbestämmande, samt hygien och säker förflyttning
    Viktigt att du tål och är van vid hundar, eftersom det ingår i arbetet
    Du har goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal, skrift och läsförståelse samt god datorvana
    Du har god fysisk rörlighet då arbetet kan vara fysiskt krävande
    Du har B-körkort och tillgång till egen bil

Du som söker är lyhörd, respektfull och inkännande för medborgarens behov och vilja. Det är viktigt att du kan strukturera, ta ansvar och prioritera dagliga arbetsuppgifter, samtidigt som du följer givna instruktioner bra. Du hanterar både planerade och oförutsedda situationer ansvarsfullt med ett lugnt och gott omdöme. Du har god kommunikation och samverkan med både medborgare, anhöriga och andra aktörer där en bra och ömsesidig dialog är avgörande.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet!

Vi erbjuder dig

Som personlig assistent får du ett flexibelt och meningsfullt arbete där du gör verklig skillnad i andras liv. Under ett tillitsbaserat ledarskap får du förutsättningar att ta ansvar och bidra till utvecklingen av verksamheten. Som medarbetare i Jönköpings kommun erbjuds du en trygg anställning och avtalsenligt lön, samt förmåner som friskvårdsbidrag och betald semester från första anställningsåret.

Läs mer om vad vi erbjuder här: https://www.jonkoping.se/jobba-hos-oss/jonkopings-kommun-som-arbetsgivare

Välkommen till oss

Område personlig assistans ger stöd till barn och vuxna med intellektuella, neuropsykiatriska eller

fysiska funktionsnedsättningar. Vårt mål är att stärka individens egna förmågor och skapa förutsättningar för ett så självständigt liv som möjligt. Hos oss blir du en del av en mindre arbetsgrupp där flexibilitet, samarbete och ett prestigelöst förhållningssätt är viktigt - varje dag hos oss innebär nya möjligheter att skapa en positiv påverkan!  

Bra att veta

Rekryteringen avser två tillsvidaretjänster på heltid som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Medborgaren ser gärna kvinnliga sökanden. Arbetet är förlagt till dag, kväll och journatt, vardag som helg. Vi erbjuder alltid 100 % sysselsättningsgrad och arbetar med samplanering där arbete hos annan medborgare kan förekomma.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande under annonseringstiden. Observera att återkopplingen i rekryteringsprocessen kan dröja något under semesterperioden.



Den här befattningen är arbetsvärderad. Personlig assistent utbildad återfinns i basgrupp D och personlig assistent (outbildad) återfinns i basgrupp B. För mer information om befattningens löneintervall se: https://www.jonkoping.se/jobba-hos-oss/jonkopings-kommun-som-arbetsgivare-/lon-och-lonestatistik

Vill du veta mer?

Kontakta rekryterande Enhetschef Josefin Natzén via 036-10 22 05 (åter från semester 24/8) eller chefskollega Fredrik Glader via 036-10 79 38

Fackliga representanter: Fackliga företrädare för socialförvaltningen

Tillsammans gör vi Jönköpings kommun bättre – för alla. Kom och jobba med oss. Välkommen att söka tjänsten som personlig assistent!

Jönköpings kommun strävar efter att erbjuda en attraktiv arbetsplats som är fri från diskriminering och ger lika möjligheter för alla.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför vänligt men bestämt alla samtal om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.

Vil du være med til at lægge fundamentet for hele Danmark?  

Er du hærdet til at blande frisk beton? Og vil du være en del af et helstøbt og solidt arbejdsmiljø hos Danmarks førende betonproducent? Hvis du samtidig kan lide at håndtere tekniske udfordringer og arbejde med analyser og prøver i vores laboratorium, så er du måske vores nye produktionsassistent. 

Fremtidens støbninger kræver, at DU er af den rette støbning 

Som produktionsassistent hos Unicon er du noget helt specielt. Gjort af et særligt stof; og med passion for det job, du udfører sammen med dine mange dygtige kollegaer. Og det er nødvendigt, for DU er personen i centrum af maskinrummet. Det er dig, det står og falder med, at teknikernes recepter bliver til præcis den beton, kunderne efterspørger; dig, der har ansvaret for, at alting kører på skinner. Det kræver overblik, foruden tekniske kompetencer, snilde, viden om cement, sand, sten, vand og additiver, og det kræver en sikker hånd på vores avancerede udstyr.  

Du bliver tilknyttet fabrikken i Skejby, hvor du vil indgå i vores team af produktionsassistenter, der også vil hjælpe med din oplæring. Du vil også skulle afløse på andre fabrikker i området. 

Der er flere gode grunde til at blive produktionsassistent hos Unicon: 

  • Vi har branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold 

  • En aktiv og spændende arbejdsdag med mange varierende arbejdsopgaver 

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning, hvor vi også vasker tøjet for dig 

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder både fagligt og personligt og spændende karrieremuligheder 

  • Fleksibilitet for dig i forhold til vagter og arbejdssted 

  • En helt unik holdånd 

  • Grundig introduktion og oplæring i jobbet 

At være en del af holdet hos Unicon er noget ganske særligt, og kræver, at du også er det  

Har du hvad der skal til for at blive produktionsassistent hos Unicon, så er det nu, du har chancen.  

For at være af den rette støbning, kræver det at, 

  • Du har erfaring med planlægning af produktionsprocesser og leverancer – og er vant til at arbejde med forskellige IT-systemer i forbindelse med planlægning 

  • Du har gode samarbejdsevner og er serviceminded – både overfor kunder og kollegaer 

  • Du har en teknisk og mekanisk forståelse 

  • Du har hænderne rigtigt skruet på og er ikke bange for at tage fat  

Vi har ingen krav til en specifik uddannelse, men er du tidligere uddannet smed, mekaniker eller elektriker, vil det være en fordel, ligesom erfaring fra bygge-/entreprenørbranchen også vil være et plus.

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: Ready to take ownership of the German market? Stock Group A/S is looking for a Key Account Manager.
jobs.description:
About this role

Stock Group is a Danish FMCG distributor with a growing portfolio of celebrity chef brands across Northern Europe. We are expanding into Germany and are looking for a Key Account Manager to build and own our commercial presence in the market.

Our flagship brand in Germany is a product line developed, owned and distributed by Stock Group — built around one of Germany's most recognised celebrity chef profiles. The brand has strong TV heritage, wide consumer recognition, and a product range that speaks directly to the everyday home cook. Full brand details are shared with candidates during the interview process.

You will be based at our headquarters in Vejle, Denmark, with regular travel to Germany. We are open to candidates based in Germany if the profile is right, but our strong preference is for someone based in Vejle with experience managing international markets from Denmark.

Reporting directly to the Head of Sales, you will work closely with a tight-knit KAM team that has built this model from the ground up.

What you will be doing

  • Building and managing key account relationships with retail chains, grocery buyers, and trade partners in Germany

  • Driving sell-in of our brand portfolio — presenting ranges, negotiating listings, and following up on performance

  • Planning and executing in-store activations, promotions, and trade marketing initiatives

  • Tracking market dynamics, competitor activity, and customer needs — feeding insights back to the team in Vejle

  • Travelling regularly to Germany to meet buyers, visit stores, and attend relevant trade events

  • Working closely with colleagues across sales, marketing, and supply chain in Denmark

The brands you will work with

In Germany, you will be selling a Stock Group brand built around a leading celebrity chef — one of the strongest commercial chef profiles in the German-speaking market. The product range covers cookware, knives, and kitchen essentials with proven consumer appeal. Further details are shared confidentially during the hiring process.

Our chef brands are built on strong TV personalities, high consumer recognition, and product ranges covering hybrid cookware, knives, airfryers, kitchen appliances and accessories. Your job is to get them listed, activated, and selling.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a commercially driven KAM with genuine FMCG experience — someone who knows how to open doors, build relationships with buyers, and drive sell-through on the shelf.

  • FMCG/retail experience. You have worked in sales, KAM, or trade marketing — ideally with exposure to grocery, electronics retail, or housewares.

  • Strong communicator. You are confident presenting to buyers, negotiating terms, and building rapport at all levels of a retail organisation.

  • Self-starter. You take ownership of your market without needing daily supervision — but you know when to bring the team in.

  • Language skills. English. Germany language skills are a significant advantage.

  • Comfortable with travel. The role involves regular visits to Germany to meet buyers, visit stores, and attend relevant trade events.

A brand with proven demand — before you walk in the door

Behind every brand in our portfolio sits Stock Group's full commercial engine — product development, logistics, content production, and dedicated direct-to-consumer ecom shops running in each chef's name across our active markets.

While our German ecom presence is in preparation, we enter the market fully ready: a complete product range, professional content and marketing assets, and documented consumer and sales data from our established markets that removes the guesswork from day one.

You will not be pioneering in the dark. You will be bringing a model that already works — into one of Europe's largest retail markets.

What we offer

  • A strong and growing portfolio of celebrity chef brands with genuine consumer pull

  • A Denmark-based role — work from our Vejle HQ with a team that has three years of market experience to draw on

  • Full support from marketing, supply chain, and finance — you sell, we back you up

  • Real ownership of your market from day one

  • Competitive salary, travel budget, and benefits package

 

How to apply

Send your CV and a brief cover note. Tell us why you are the right person to build our presence in Germany. For questions, contact Head of Sales Steffan Voss at: steffan@stockgroup.dk or +45 81 37 67 47

We review applications on a rolling basis — don't wait.

jobs.title: Nat med mening- vi søger dig, der vil gøre en forskel, når andre sover!
jobs.description:
Brænder du for at gøre en forskel om natten? Trives du med ansvar, selvstændighed og høj faglighed? Så er du måske vores nye kollega på det udekørende nathold i Svendborg Kommune.

 

Har du lyst til at bruge dine kompetencer og blive fagligt udfordret?

 

Vi søger en fast vikar til en tidsbegrænset ansættelse fra 1. oktober 2026 til og med 31. januar 2027.

 

Vi hører meget gerne fra dig, uanset om du er ufaglært med erfaring fra plejen, social- og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent.

 

Om jobbet:

Vi søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst kollega til vores udekørende nathold. Du bliver en del af en velfungerende sektion med 12 dygtige og dedikerede medarbejdere, som hver nat arbejder for at skabe tryghed, kvalitet og nærvær for borgerne i Svendborg Kommune.

 

Du får et tæt samarbejde med sygeplejerskerne i den udekørende sygepleje og akutfunktionen, som også er på arbejde om natten. Samtidig har du en synlig leder og en planlægger tæt på, som du altid kan sparre med.

 

Hos os er arbejdsmiljøet lige så vigtigt som fagligheden. Vi tror på, at høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen skabes gennem psykologisk tryghed, gensidig respekt og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab. Derfor søger vi en kollega, der både vil bidrage fagligt og være med til at passe på den kultur, vi er stolte af.

 

Vi søger en kollega, der:

  • Er ufaglært med erfaring fra plejen, social- og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent.
  • Har kørekort.
  • Er engageret, udviklingsorienteret og tager initiativ.
  • Tager ansvar og kan argumentere fagligt for sine beslutninger.
  • Arbejder med udgangspunkt i borgerens ressourcer og med fokus på rehabilitering.
  • Bevarer roen og overblikket i pressede situationer – og tør række ud efter hjælp.
  • Er mødestabil og en positiv rollemodel.
  • Er nysgerrig og anerkendende i samarbejdet med borgere, pårørende, kolleger, ledelse og samarbejdspartnere.
  • Bidrager til en kultur præget af psykologisk tryghed, respekt og samarbejde, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og lærer af hinanden.
  • Har lyst til at være en del af en dynamisk kollegagruppe, hvor vi spiller hinanden gode og værner om det stærke fællesskab.

 

Om dig:

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har høj faglighed og trives med selvstændigt ansvar.
  • Kan bevare roen og træffe gode beslutninger – også når tempoet er højt.
  • Er kreativ og løsningsorienteret i din tilgang til opgaverne.
  • Kommunikerer tydeligt og respektfuldt.
  • Har flair for dokumentation og IT.
  • Bidrager aktivt til et godt arbejdsmiljø og et stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde.

 

Om os:

Hos os bliver du en del af et nathold, hvor faglighed og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd. Vi prioriterer psykologisk tryghed, en synlig ledelse, tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og en kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og spiller hinanden gode. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes sammen, og at et godt arbejdsmiljø er fundamentet for god pleje.

 

Vi tilbyder

  • En grundig introduktion med mentorordning og oplæring ved erfarne kolleger.
  • En sektion med god struktur, planlægning og et sundt arbejdsmiljø.
  • Et dynamisk arbejdssted med spændende og afvekslende opgaver.
  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling.
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde.
  • En planlagt vagtdækning, hvor den rette faglighed altid er til stede, når der er brug for den. 

 

Ældreområdet
Når du arbejder på ældreområdet, møder du bag hver enkelt dør et unikt menneske. Et menneske, du gør en forskel for. Hos os har du frihed til at møde netop dét menneske – måske i en lille snak, i en svær stund eller med en hjælpende hånd.

 

Vi har ikke én færdig opskrift på det gode ældre liv, fordi vi hylder forskelligheden. Til gengæld gør vi os umage med altid at møde det enkelte menneske med værdighed, respekt og høj faglighed.

 

Vi skaber de bedste rammer for, at du kan udføre dit arbejde godt og meningsfuldt, og vi har samtidig høje forventninger til din faglighed. Hos os får du mulighed for at bruge dine kompetencer og udvikle dem yderligere.

 

Om Svendborg Kommune
Svendborg Kommune er i vores øjne en arbejdsplads af en helt perfekt størrelse: Vi er små nok til at være tæt på hinanden i et varmt uhøjtideligt fællesskab med korte kommandoveje og uden skjulte dagsordner. Og vi er store nok til at have god plads til ambitioner, høj faglighed og rige muligheder for udvikling.

 

Vi holder af hverdagen og insisterer på, at det skal være rart at gå på arbejde. Vi har travlt, men ikke for travlt til at hjælpe hinanden.

 

Vores værdier findes ikke kun på papiret, vi bruger dem faktisk som kompas hver dag. Vi møder hinanden i øjenhøjde, i dialog og med tillid, og sammen skaber vi en tryg ramme, hvor vi alle kan løse vores opgaver selvstændigt, fleksibelt og ansvarligt.


Løn og ansættelse:
Stillingen er en tidsbegrænset ansættelse som fast vikar fra 1. oktober 2026 til og med 31. januar 2027 .

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer om ugen, men vi er fleksible og vil så vidt muligt imødekomme dine ønsker til timetal.

Arbejdsstedet er; Fåborgvej 64, 5700 Svendborg

 

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling typisk mellem disse intervaller pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse.

Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

 

Der skal afleveres en privat straffeattest ved ansættelse i stillingen.

 

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

 

Ansøgningsfrist: 

 

Ansøgningsfristen er den 9. august 2026

 

Der planlægges ansættelsessamtaler mandag den 17. august. 

 

For yderligere information er du velkommen til at kontakte Sektionsleder Anne Hasseltoft på telefon 2479 6103.

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

   

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Human Performance and Situational Awareness in Multi-UxV Remote Operations
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the project

Norway is facing an increasingly complex maritime security environment. Effective responses to threats against coastal and underwater infrastructure are becoming critically dependent on unmanned vehicles (UxV) — UAVs, USVs, and UUVs — operated from Remote Operation Centers (ROC). A key knowledge gap is our limited understanding of what is required for the humans operating these systems to function reliably under defence and preparedness pressure.

Research consistently shows that human cognitive capacity is the binding constraint in multi-vehicle remote operations. Managing two to four UxV systems simultaneously pushes operators toward and beyond their cognitive limits, with consequences for situational awareness, decision quality, and authority sharing. Yet the human factors of ROC-based multi-UxV supervision remain largely unstudied in maritime contexts.

NTNU Ålesund is developing state-of-the-art Remote Operation Center (ROC) infrastructure as part of Fjordlab — a unique outdoor maritime test environment with multi-sensor infrastructure including hydrophones, land-based radars, oceanographic sensors, and an UxV fleet. Through the MIND & SHELL project, a deployable ROC will be developed, combining high-fidelity simulation with full-scale testing to provide an exceptional basis for empirical research on ROC operator performance.

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the position

The PhD candidate will investigate how ROC operators construct situational awareness — understood as skilled sensework across cognitive, strategic, and organisational axes — when managing multiple UxV systems simultaneously in defence and preparedness scenarios. The research will examine how cognitive load, autonomy level, authority sharing, and interface design affect decision quality as vehicle count and scenario complexity increase. A second and complementary focus is the extent to which sustained screen-based multi-UxV supervision suppresses operators' awareness of their immediate physical environment — a phenomenon with direct implications for ROC survivability in contested settings where the operating crew must remain alert to threats beyond the screen.

The candidate will design and execute simulator-based experiments and full-scale field studies at Fjordlab, using established human factors methods such as SAGAT, NASA-TLX, and eye-tracking. The research will draw on and extend Endsley's situational awareness model, Haavik's sensework framework, and Parasuraman's taxonomy of automation, applying these to the emerging domain of maritime ROC operations.

The candidate will work in a multidisciplinary research environment at NTNU Ålesund, and collaborating closely with another PhD candidate — who develops the physical design and for deployable, survivable ROC units — as well as defence and preparedness stakeholders and technology partners. Findings are expected to contribute to design principles for ROC interfaces, operational guidelines for multi-UxV supervision, and serve as a foundation for future European-scale research initiatives.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in research group activities
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in maritime operations, the maritime industry, aviation, defence operations, or similar high-stakes operational environments or equivalent. Your education must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than 1st of October 2026.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you maybe considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme Engineering
  • You must have high proficiency in both written and oral English

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • You hold a master's degree in human factors and ergonomics, maritime studies, cognitive science, organizational studies, or other related fields with relevance to the research challenges described
  • You have experience with experimental methods, both quantitative and qualitative approaches to human performance evaluation (and team collaboration)
  • You have experience with field work / etnographic approaches
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Engage across disciplines and with operational audiences
  • Look at  the real-world relevance of research, not only academic contribution
  • Combine theoretical rigour with pragmatism
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 550 800,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

The application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

PLEASE NOTE: The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Please note that the person hired will work with critical infrastructure and areas affected by controls on the export of strategic goods, services and technology.

Candidates who do not meet the requirements for the necessary security clearance, access clearance and authorization as described in the National Security Act, and the Act on the Implementation of International Sanctions (Sanctions Act) cannot be considered (e.g., candidates from, among others, Russia, Iran, North Korea, China). Relevant countries are listed as examples and as such the list is not exhaustive (as a result of any changes in the world situation, other countries may be added at short notice).


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Andreas Madsen, email: andreas.madsen@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact PhD Coordinator Lara Bromann, email: lara.bromann@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 30.08.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 
 

Ålesund, known for its unique Art Nouveau architecture and spectacular nature, is a gem on Norway's west coast. The city offers a vibrant cultural life, modern facilities, and a dynamic business environment. With its strategic location by the sea, Ålesund provides a perfect balance between urban living and natural experiences. Here, you will find excellent schools, top-notch healthcare services, and a wide range of recreational activities. Ålesund is an ideal place for both career and family life, with a safe and inclusive community.

jobs.title: Associate Professor in theoretical or computational quantum technology
jobs.description:
About the position

A permanent position as Associate Professor in theoretical or computational quantum science and technology is available at the Department of Physics, under the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences.


More information about the position 

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences and the Department of Physics have a strategic goal of strengthening research and educational activities in quantum science and -technology (QST). The successful applicant is expected to take a leading role in realizing this vision.

QST activities in the department are growing and presently span both experimental and theoretical research, as well as quantum physics education research. On the experimental side, our main focus is on semiconductor materials for quantum sensing, and fundamental studies of quantum material properties. Theoretical activities include research on quantum information theory, quantum algorithms, quantum engineering, many-body theories for quantum technologies, quantum machine learning, and fundamental quantum science. There are strong ties to related activities in the Department of Mathematics and at the Hylleraas Center for quantum chemistry. 

Two newly established research centers in quantum technology, the Centre for Defects in Semiconductors for Quantum Sensing (link) and the Centre for Quantum Computing and Applications (link), serve as important catalysts for increasing collaboration across departments and with research institutes and industry. There is also growing national, Nordic, and international collaboration in both quantum research and education.

This position is focused on strengthening research and education within theoretical and/or computational QST in the department. 


Job description/ main tasks 

The successful candidate is expected to strengthen the department’s strategic effort in quantum science and -technology, with particular focus on theoretical and computational approaches. Relevant research background includes, but is not limited to, quantum algorithms, quantum optimization, quantum simulation, quantum engineering, theoretical and computational many-body physics, quantum sensing, quantum materials, and fundamental aspects of quantum science relevant to quantum technology. 

The candidate’s expertise should align with and complement our existing research strengths, with the potential to deepen interaction across research sections and departments within the faculty. It is an advantage if the candidate’s research activities have relevance to strategic initiatives at UiO.

The successful candidate is expected to establish and lead an outstanding independent research program, participate in and coordinate collaborative networks and projects, supervise students and post-doctoral researchers, actively pursue national and international research funding, contribute to teaching at all levels within the Department, and promote productive interaction between academia and society.

The appointed person is expected to play an important role in strengthening the new Bachelor’s program in quantum technology, and the new Master’s program in quantum science and -technology. This includes teaching relevant courses and supervising students for their master’s and PhD degrees. Moreover, the candidate should be able to teach general physics courses at the bachelor’s level. 

The position will also involve administrative duties according to current regulations by the Department or Faculty. 


What skills are important in this role?

Required qualifications:

  • The successful applicant must have completed a Master’s degree in physics and a PhD in physics or a related field central for the position.
  • Postdoctoral experience.
  • Documented high quality research in a relevant field, demonstrating ability for independent and significant scientific production after the PhD. The main emphasis will be on the candidate’s scientific production from the last five years.
  • Experience with attracting external research funding and leading scientific research projects
  • Experience with scientific programming and the use of numerical methods in research and education
  • Documented teaching experience and ability to take active part in teaching and supervising students at all levels. The applicant should describe her/his qualifications in view of the Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL) framework which includes:
    • Focus on student learning
    • A clear development over time
    • A researching approach
    • A collegial attitude and practice
       
  • The successful candidate who at the time of appointment cannot document sufficient teaching qualifications (minimum formal requirement is a 200 hours pedagogical programme) will be required to obtain such qualifications within a two-year period.
  • The successful candidate must demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages, in order to be able to teach and otherwise be able to participate in all functions the position may involve. If the successful candidate does not have sufficient mastery of a Scandinavian language, B2 level, the candidate will be required to learn sufficient Norwegian within three years of employment.

The following desired qualifications will be prioritized in the assessment: 

  • Potential to align with existing strategic initiatives in QST and to promote collaboration between sections and departments.
  • Ability to teach courses on quantum computing, computational physics, many-body physics, quantum machine learning or similar topics, in addition to basic physics courses.
  • Proven track record of attracting external funding from the most competitive funding schemes (ERC or similar).
  • Motivation for development and redesign of courses and teaching methods, and motivation to take part in developing and improving study programs.
  • Experience with communicating university level research and education to a wider (non-scientific) audience.

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to create and contribute to a well-functioning, inclusive and productive research environment
  • Organizational and networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
  • Positive and enthusiastic attitude

The successful candidate should have an international profile with respect to the above criteria. The candidate for this position will be selected based on excellence and fit with the section’s research profile.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Associate Professor (position code 1011) in salary range NOK from 700 000 - 850 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, two % is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

Inclusive work life and diversity at UiO

Inclusion and diversity are a strength. The University of Oslo has a personnel policy objective of achieving a balanced gender composition. Furthermore, we want employees with diverse professional expertise, life experience and perspectives.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, employment gaps or immigrant background, we will invite at least one applicant from each of these categories to an interview.

We especially encourage women to apply. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.  


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Application letter with a statement of motivation and research interests
  • A detailed CV, including a complete list of education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience, project acquisition and coordination experience, and other qualifying activities
  • A research plan (max. 5 pages) including possible synergies with relevant research sections at the Department of Physics and other departments at the University of Oslo
  • Copies of educational certificates, PhD diploma and transcript of records 
  • A complete list of publications and academic merits and awards (if not included in the CV)
  • Summary of up to three selected scientific publications the applicant wishes to include in the evaluation describing their significance and impact. A copy of these publications (or an open access link to these) must be provided.
  • Educational portfolio of 3–6 pages documenting educational competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own teaching practice and view of learning is anchored in the SoTL framework (focus on student learning, development over time, a researching approach and a collegial attitude and practice) 
  • List of reference persons: 2–3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

As a general rule an interview will be used in the appointment process, usually supplemented with a trial teaching session. The basis for assessment will be the scientific production of the applicant, the teaching portfolio, pedagogical and educational qualifications, the applicant’s qualifications within leadership and administration, other qualifications as well as general personal suitability for the position. In ranking the competent applicants, the full range of qualifications will be considered and explicitly assessed.

Rules for appointments to associate professorships. 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-appointment-professor.html

Rules for the assessment and weighting of pedagogical competence for appointments to permanent academic posts which include teaching duties: 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-basic-pedagogical-competence.html

Guide for applicants for Professor and Associate professor positions - University of Oslo https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/guide-applicants.html

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova), information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results, see: http://www.uio.no/english/for-employees/employment/work-results/


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The research at the Department of Physics covers a broad range of subfields within physics and technology: From space research to medical physics. A good proportion of the research is interdisciplinary, and conducted in close cooperation with collaborators in Norway and abroad. Education and teaching are other essential activities. We offer a broad range of courses, and the Department is involved in several study programmes at bachelor’s and master’s level. Some of the best lecturers in Norway are amongst our employees, and we are proud of our prizewinning teaching and learning environment. The Department has 200 employees, of which 50 are permanent scientific positions. On a yearly basis 20 students complete their Ph.D. and 50 finish their M.Sc. degree.

Haemme osa-aikaista (70 %) lähihoitajaa Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueelle, alkusijoituspaikka on kotihoito pohjoinen alue 4, tiimi 7, Pietarsaari. Työ alkaa 3.8.2026.

Oletko sinä hakemamme osaava ja innostunut lähihoitaja?

Oletpa sitten kokenut konkari tai ensiaskeleita uralla ottava lähihoitaja, niin tule tekemään ja kehittämään kanssamme monipuolista ja ihmisläheistä työtä. Suhtaudumme asiakkaisiimme kunnioittaen ja arvostaen. Tuemme asiakkaiden omatoimisuutta ja kotona pärjäämistä kuntouttavan työotteen avulla. Asiakkaillamme on myös käytössä etähoivateknologiaa, kuten lääkeautomaatteja sekä etäkäyntejä.

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä itsenäisesti, osana moniammatillista ja työhönsä sitoutunutta työyhteisöä. Kotihoidossa jokainen työpäiväsi on erilainen ja luvassa on vauhdikasta työarkea. Tukenasi ovat mukavat työkaverit, yhteen hiilen puhaltava tiimi sekä hyvä ja innostava työilmapiiri ja esihenkilöiden tuki.

Tuemme uusien työntekijöidemme töiden aloittamista perehdyttämisohjelmalla. Nimeämme uusille tulijoille aina ohjaajan. Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue tarjoaa erilaisia työpaikkaetuja sekä hyvät koulutusmahdollisuudet.

Jos tunnistit itsesi, niin jätä hakemus mahdollisimman pian.

Kutsumme hakijoita haastatteluun jo hakuaikana, joten pidäthän puhelimen lähelläsi.

Mikäli haluat lisätietoja, olethan reippaasti yhteydessä.
Toivomme kuulevamme sinusta pian!

Lähihoitajan tutkinto tai terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun asetuksen (564/1994) tai valtioneuvoston sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä antaman asetuksen (153/2016) mukainen tutkinto.
Tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito maamme molemmissa kansalliskielissä.

Lähihoitajatutkinnon suorittaneilta edellytetään rekisteröitymistä Valviran molempiin ammattihenkilörekistereihin, Terhikkiin ja Suosikkiin.

Lisäksi valitulla tulee olla voimassa tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 § mukainen rokotussuoja sekä rikosrekisteriote kuten rikosrekisterilain 6§ 2 mom. on mainittu.

jobs.title: AI Product Engineer (PropTech)
jobs.description:
**Takaovi Oy · Takaovi Palvelut Oy – etätyö mahdollista**

Oletko uutta kehittäjäsukupolvea, jolle AI ei ole lisäosa vaan työtapa? Haluatko rakentaa asuntosijoittamisen ensimmäistä AI-natiivia tuotetta, jolla luodaan sijoittajille ennen näkemätöntä lisäarvoa — ja omistaa työsi ideasta tuotantoon asti?

**Takaovi Oy** / **Takaovi Palvelut Oy** on noin 30 hengen konserni, joka palvelee asunto- ja kiinteistösijoittajia koko Suomessa. Löydämme parhaat sijoituskohteet ja hoidamme kohteet vuokravälityksestä vuokrasuhteen hallinnointiin. Hallinnoinnissamme on noin 3 000 asuntoa. Olemme panostaneet teknologiakehitykseen lähes 10 vuoden ajan, ja rakennamme alustaa, joka automatisoi kiinteistösijoittamisen arkea — sitä, mitä maailmalla kutsutaan PropTechiksi. Emme ole kiinteistöfirma, jolla on IT-osasto: teknologia on kilpailuetumme ydin.

**Mitä pääset tekemään**

- **Rakennat ominaisuuksia tuotantoon asti**— full-stack, AI-avusteisesti (Claude, Copilot tai vastaavat ovat meillä arkipäivää, ja odotamme että osaat johtaa AI:ta, et vain käyttää sitä)

- **Pyörität kehitysprojektia itsenäisesti**: valmistelet, esität, vakuutat ja toteutat — et odota valmiiksi pureskeltuja tikettejä

- **Ohjaat offshore-kehittäjämme työtä**Intiassa: speksaat, priorisoit ja reviewaat englanniksi

- **Kasvat kohti teknisen kehityksen vetovastuuta**— roolisi laajenee jokaisella onnistumisella, ja saat suoran mentoroinnin yrityksen teknologiajohdolta

- Pääset lähelle bisnestä: opit ymmärtämään asuntosijoittajan arkea ja näet, miten koodisi muuttuu asiakkaan hyödyksi


**Mitä odotamme**

- Riittävää ymmärrystä teknologioista, jotta pidät AI:n hanskassa. Meillä koodia ei kirjoiteta käsin rutiinina — AI kirjoittaa, sinä johdat, luet ja varmistat.

- Näyttöjä siitä, että saat ohjelmistoja valmiiksi ja tuotantoon — muodollista tutkintoa kiinnostavampaa on, mitä olet rakentanut.

- Modernin web-kehityksen ymmärrystä / osaamista.

- Aitoa AI-natiivia työtapaa: osaat pilkkoa ongelman, ohjata AI-työkaluja ja tunnistaa, milloin tuotos on väärin.

- Kykyä ja halua ottaa vastuuta kokonaisuudesta: projektinhallinta ei ole sinulle kirosana vaan keino saada asioita valmiiksi.

- Sujuvaa suomea ja työkielen tasoista englantia (säännöllinen yhteistyö offshore-kehittäjän kanssa).

- Plussaa, muttei edellytys: kiinnostus asunto- tai kiinteistösijoittamiseen — jos olet sitä joskus harkinnut tai jo harrastat, tämä rooli vie sinut aitiopaikalle!


**Mitä tarjoamme**

- Poikkeuksellisen ison vapauden ja vastuun heti alusta — ja selkeän kasvupolun kohti tech lead -roolia

- Suoran mentorointisuhteen: et jää yksin, mutta sinua ei myöskään mikromanageerata

- Vakaan yrityksen, joka on investoinut teknologiaan lähes vuosikymmenen — startup-vapaus ilman startup-riskiä

- Täyden etätyömahdollisuuden mistä päin Suomea tahansa

- Modernit työkalut ja aidosti AI-first-kulttuurin: täällä ei tarvitse pyytää lupaa käyttää parhaita työkaluja

- Palkka 3 600 – 4 600 €/kk kokemuksesi mukaan — kokemuksen ja roolin kasvaessa myös ansiotaso nousee

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled Project Manager to our client, to lead a project related to product data management. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the projects progress and will work in close collaboration with various stakeholders.

About the role:
In this versatile Project Manager role, you will track project status and budget progress while ensuring everything stays on schedule. You will drive the product data concept forward all the way from governance to the factories. It is also essential to understand the product concept across different use cases, such as sales and production, as well as product variant management in various contexts. You will facilitate meetings, monitor the progress of the technical execution, and communicate closely with various stakeholders.

Work tasks:
- Tracking project status and budget process
- Driving the product data concept forward from governance to the factories
- Facilitating meetings - Monitoring the progress of the technical execution
- Communicating with various stakeholders

We are looking for:
- Previous experience in Product Data Management (PDM) projects (ideally with proven experience as a project lead/manager)
- A relevant educational background for the position
- Fluency in English; proficiency in Finnish and/or Swedish is considered as an advantage
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills
- A proactive and hands-on approach to work

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Have you led a Product Data Management (PDM) or Product Information Management (PIM) project?*
- Do you have experience working with product data governance, master data, or product lifecycle processes across multiple business functions?*
- Have you managed project budgets, timelines, and stakeholder reporting in a project with multiple departments involved?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with product variant management, configurable products, or complex product structures?*
- Have you coordinated technical implementation teams while simultaneously managing business stakeholders and end users?*

Please apply with your CV in English, clearly showing how you match the requirements and answer to the questions above. The client is continously reviewing candidates and we ask you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Location: Helsinki (Katajanokka) 
Start and end date: The planned start date for this position is during September, and the contract duration is 9 months.
Other: The role offers a hybrid work model (up to 50/50), and the role may involve occasional travel.
Allocation: 50-100%, to be agreed 
Language: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Finnish and/or Swedish a plus.

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi

jobs.title: Myyjä, Prisma Kirkkonummi / Försäljare, Prisma Kyrkslätt
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KIRKKONUMMI

MYYJÄ, PRISMA KIRKKONUMMI, 25 H/VK, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Tässä tehtävässä päiväsi koostuvat monipuolisista myyjän työtehtävistä myymälän eri osa-alueilla. Työ painottuu tuorepuolen hyllytykseen, joten toivomme että pidät aktiivisesta ja fyysisestä työstä. Tehtävään kuuluu myös kassatyöskentelyä, minkä vuoksi hyvä asiakaspalveluasenne ja sujuva työskentely erilaisissa tilanteissa ovat tärkeitä. Monipuolisten työtehtävien ansiosta päivät ovat vaihtelevia, eikä askelia päivän aikana ainakaan puutu.

Me Prisma Kirkkonummella teemme ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta juuri nyt elämme myös erityisen innostavaa vaihetta: Prismaa laajennetaan parhaillaan, ja pääset mukaan kokemaan myymälämme kehityksen aivan eturivistä.

Tässä tehtävässä:
- Kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Tarvitaan reipasta ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä asennetta sekä halua oppia uutta.
- Otetaan vastuuta omasta työstä ja yhteisten asioiden edistämisestä osana tiimiä
- Tehdään yhteistyötä muun työryhmän kanssa hyvässä hengessä ja pidetään omalta osalta huolta osaston toimivuudesta
- Liikutaan paljon, nostellaan tavaraa ja tehdään töitä ripeässä tahdissa, joten hyvä peruskunto on työssä hyödyksi
- Tehdään töitä vaihtelevissa vuoroissa kaupan aukioloaikoina klo 5-24 välillä, myös juhlapyhinä
- Suomen kielen taitoa ja ruotsin kieli katsotaan eduksi


Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikkaa, johon on kiva tulla ja josta on kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Mahdollisuutta kehittyä ja kouluttautua.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista – ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja paljon muusta.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.

Palkkaus
- Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta (10,89 €/h – 14,57 €/h), johon vaikuttavat kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi.
- 5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Mahdollisuuden koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen jopa 1,70 €/ tehty työtunti tulospalkkioon yrityksen tuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittareiden perusteella.

Jos ihan tavallinen työelämä houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan!

Jätä hakemuksesi ihan viimeistään sunnuntaina 9.8.2026 – mutta älä turhaan aikaile, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi jo ennen hakuajan umpeutumista. Tarkempia tietoja tehtävästä antaa Myyntipäällikkö Agneta Lundell (agneta.lundell@sok.fi ja p.0107626661) .Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

**

FÖRSÄLJARE, PRISMA KYRKSLÄTT, 25 H/VECKA, FAST ANSTÄLLNING

I den här rollen består dina dagar av mångsidiga säljaruppgifter inom butikens olika områden. Arbetet fokuserar på varuplock på färskvarusidan, så vi hoppas att du trivs med ett aktivt och fysiskt arbete. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår också kassaarbete, därför är en god serviceattityd och förmåga att arbeta smidigt i olika situationer viktiga. Tack vare de mångsidiga arbetsuppgifterna är dagarna varierande, och steg lär det inte saknas under dagen.

Vi på Prisma Kyrkslätt gör helt vanliga jobb, men just nu befinner vi oss också i en särskilt spännande fas: Prisma byggs ut som bäst, och du får vara med och uppleva vår butiks utveckling från första parkett.

I den här rollen
- Möter du kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe <3
- Har du en glad och kundserviceinriktad attityd och vilja att lära dig nytt
- Tar du ansvar för ditt eget arbete och för att driva gemensamma saker framåt som en del av teamet
- Arbetar du tillsammans med resten av teamet i god anda och bidrar till att avdelningen fungerar väl
- Rör du på dig mycket, lyfter varor och arbetar i rask takt, så en god grundkondition är till nytta i jobbet
- Arbetar du i varierande skift under butikens öppettider mellan kl. 5 och 24, även under helgdagar
- Goda kunskaper i finska och kunskaper i svenska ses som en merit.

Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
- Ett jobb som får dig på gott humör både före och efter arbetsdagen.
- Ett team där man inte lämnar kollegorna i sticket och där cheferna jobbar sida vid sida med teamet.
- Möjlighet att utvecklas och utbilda dig.
- Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, smink, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.
- Kultur-, välbefinnande- och motionsförmån.

Lön
- Lön enligt handelns kollektivavtal (10,89 - 14,57 €/h), beroende på din erfarenhet och utbildning.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 procent om du kan betjäna kunder på båda finska och svenska.
- Möjlighet till hela personalens gemensamma resultatpremie på upp till 1,70 euro per arbetad timme, baserat på företagets resultat och branschvisa mätare.

Om ett helt vanligt arbetsliv lockar, skicka in din ansökan!

Skicka in din ansökan helt senast söndag 9.8.2026 – men vänta inte i onödan, vi går igenom ansökningar redan innan ansökningstiden går ut. Närmare uppgifter om uppgiften får du av försäljningschef Agneta Lundell (agneta.lundell@sok.fi och tfn 0107626661). Anställningen börjar enligt överenskommelse.

**Glass Resort** on uniikki, korkeatasoinen majoituskohde Joulupukin Pajakylässä Rovaniemellä. Hotelli tunnetaan **tyylikkäistä lasihuoneistoistaan**, yksilöllisestä palvelustaan ja tunnelmallisesta **Ravintola Galliksesta**, jossa lappilainen luonto kohtaa klassisen keittiön.

Vastaanottovirkailijana olet olennainen osa asiakkaan majoituskokemusta – toivotat vieraat lämpimästi tervetulleiksi, varmistat sujuvan sisään- ja uloskirjautumisen sekä huolehdit asiakaspalvelusta koko vierailun ajan. Työtehtäviin kuuluu myös varausjärjestelmän käyttö, sähköposti- ja puhelinviestintä sekä monipuoliset hotellin vastaanoton päivittäiset tehtävät. Toimit resortin päivittäisen toiminnan eräänlaisena hermokeskuksena tietäen missä mennään ja mitä tapahtuu.

**Etsimme henkilöä, joka:**

- On asiakaspalveluhenkinen, kohtelias ja ammattimainen

- Nauttii työstä kansainvälisten asiakkaiden parissa

- Toimii itsenäisesti ja oma-aloitteisesti myös kiireessä

- Hallitsee suomen ja englannin kielen sujuvasti – muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi

- On motivoitunut oppimaan uutta ja kehittämään työyhteisöä

- Aiempi kokemus hotellityöstä ja varausjärjestelmistä (esim. MEWS) katsotaan eduksi


**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Kokoaikaisen ja määräaikaisen työsuhteen n. 10.4.2027 asti

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan ja hyvinvointiedun

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä kansainvälisessä ja ainutlaatuisessa ympäristössä

- Mukavan ja sitoutuneen tiimin tuen

- Arvokasta kokemusta korkeatasoisen palvelun parissa


**Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, viimeistään lokakuun alussa.** Ravintola ja vastaanotto palvelevat päivittäin syyskuun puolesta välistä huhtikuun puoleenväliin, käytössä on työaikapankki. Työsopimus solmitaan **Glass Resortin** ja valitun henkilön välille.

_Tampereen Datapiste Oy (TDP) on vuonna 2007 perustettu pirkanmaalainen IT-palvelukumppani, joka hoitaa yritysten koko IT-arjen yhdeltä luukulta._

_Ydinosaamistamme on toimittaa, asentaa ja edelleen kehittää yritysten todellisia tarpeita vastaavia IT-järjestelmiä kokonaisvaltaisesti. Autamme asiakkaitamme niin uusien laitteiden asennuksissa, vikatilanteissa kuin käyttötukenakin. Näiden lisäksi palveluihimme kuuluvat ohjelmistot, huollot sekä tietoturvapalvelut._

_Lue lisää meistä: www.tdp.fi!_

TDP toivottaa nyt riveihinsä tervetulleeksi Nokialle

**PALVELIN/INFRA-ASIANTUNTIJAN!**

Palvelinasiantuntijana toimit asiakkaidemme pilvi- ja käyttäjäympäristöjen parissa sekä asiakaskontaktihenkilönä. Huolehdit asiakkaiden palvelin- ja verkkoinfran ylläpidosta ja autat häiriötilanteiden ratkaisemisessa. Olet vastuussa ympäristöjen kehittämisestä ja pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten asiakkaiden infraa voisi modernisoida pidemmällä aikajänteellä. Toimialamme menee vauhdilla eteenpäin koko ajan, joten arvostamme halukkuutta kehittää myös omaa osaamistasi esimerkiksi tekoälytyökalujen suhteen.

Työssäsi keskityt pääasiassa teollisuuden puolen asiakkaiden infran hallintaan. Työnkuvat ovat kuitenkin pienessä tiimissämme laajoja, joten toivomme, että nautit monipuolisista työtehtävistä: satunnaisesti saatat hoitaa myös työasemapuolen ongelmatilanteita tai tehdä käyttäjähallinnan tehtäviä.

Käytännössä työpäivän aikana saatat esimerkiksi:

\- Hallinnoida IT-infraa ja palvelimia: monitorointi, varmuuskopioiden valvonta, kehittäminen, verkkoylläpito ja dokumentointi

\- Ratkaista käyttäjätuen tikettejä (L1–L2): työasemat ja arkiset käyttöongelmat

\- Hallinnoida Microsoft 365- ja Google Workspace -ympäristöjä

\- Asentaa laitteita ja sovelluksia käyttökuntoon ja tarjota tarvittaessa lähitukea

**Sinulta toivomme:**

\- Vähintään muutaman vuoden työkokemusta IT-infran puolelta

\- Kokemusta sekä Windows- että Linux-palvelimien, mahdollisesti myös pilvipalvelimien (Hetzner/Amazon) ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä

\- Kokemusta virtualisoinnista (Proxmox tai vastaava)

\- Kokemusta AI-työkalujen hyödyntämisestä tai vähintään suurta innostusta niiden opetteluun

\- Erinomaista suomen ja englannin kielitaitoa (asiakkaat pääosin suomenkielisiä)

\- B-ajokorttia

Eduksi katsomme verkkopuolen syvällisemmän tuntemuksen.

**Tarjoamme:**

\- Kiinteän kuukausipalkan, joka on välillä 3000-3600€ kokemuksestasi ja osaamisestasi riippuen

\- Kattavat työterveyspalvelut

\- Monipuolisen työnkuvan, jota voidaan räätälöidä osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan

\- Mahdollisuuden kouluttautua ja laajentaa osaamistasi

\- Mukavat, avoimet työkaverit ja tiimin, jossa asiat viedään maaliin yhdessä

Kyseessä on vakituinen arkityö klo 8-16 välillä. Työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti Nokian toimipisteellämme.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Hienoa! Hae tehtävään viimeistään 15.8.2026 osoitteessa www.valianthr.teamtailor.com . Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuajan aikana, joten kannattaa toimia nopeasti.

Rekrytointi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Valiant HR:n kanssa. Työsuhde solmitaan suoraan TDP:n kanssa.

Mikäli haluat lisätietoja paikasta, voit olla matalalla kynnyksellä yhteydessä rekrytointikumppaniimme Ulla Kauppiin, ulla@valianthr.fi / 050 466 1062.
