jobs.title: Vil du også være på den grønne gren?
jobs.description:
Er du uddannet pædagog, kan levere varmt nærvær i børnehøjde og være fagligt reflekterende i dit arbejde, er det dig vi leder efter

Om os

Akvariefisk, ulveskov og hverdagspædagogik er nogle af de ting, som findes i Børnehuset Derudá, hvor vi leder efter en pædagog til vores vuggestue nærmere bestemt Den Grønne Gren.

Her vil blandt andet David og Lene være dine nærmeste kollegaer. De er blandt meget andet 100 meter mestre i organisering, og har godt styr på overblikket. De er også meget åbne for dine idéer, hvis du har noget, som du brænder for pædagogisk.

Vi er et stort hus med med mulighed for åbne døre, men også med plads til ro og fordybelse bag en lukket dør til små grupper og større fællesskaber. Vi er både fælles og hver for sig.

Vi har en meget stor legeplads, hvor vuggestuen og børnehaven færdes frit. Her er svævebane, bålplads og et utal af krat, træer og gemmesteder til børnene.

Husets hjerte er køkkenfællesrummet, der binder vuggestuen og børnehaven sammen. Hver afdeling har også eget fællesrum, som vi i vuggestuen bruger til leg, musik og bevægelse.

Vuggestuen består af tre stuer (Orange Scene, Blåhvalen og Den Grønne Gren) med 11 børn på hver stue. Der går en hæk ned gennem vores legeplads, og ud fra hver vuggestue er der en lille gårdhave, hvor man bedre kan lave en afgrænset pædagogisk aktivitet. 

Vi tilbyder 

  • En arbejdsplads der vægter høj faglighed og sætter kerneopgaven i fokus. 
  • Tid til faglig sparring, refleksion og udvikling.
  • En medarbejdergruppe som er optaget af at evaluere på egen praksis og skabe endnu bedre lege- og læringsmiljøer.
  • En vuggestue, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på strukturen og aktiviteter og være med til at udvikle praksis. 
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af huset. 
  • En masse dejlige børn og familier.
  • Koncentration i arbejdet med dagtilbud for alle og fokus på refleksion og evalueringskultur.
  • En fastansat sprogkonsulent i dagtilbuddet, som vi sparrer meget med.
  • Mulighed for at skifte stue eller afdeling, hvis opgaven kalder på det, eller man har ønske om det.
  • Opbakning til kurser og efteruddannelser.

Vi synes, det er fedt hvis du:

  • Formår at skabe gode læringsmiljøer og deltagelsesmuligheder for børnene og altid har fokus på kerneopgaven og barnets perspektiv – både det enkelte barn og fællesskabet.
  • Interesserer dig for børnenes intentioner og møder dem anerkendende og åbent samt er nysgerrig på, hvad der ligger bag deres handlinger.
  • Aktivt medvirker til udvikling, planlægning, gennemføring, evaluering og dokumentering af pædagogiske forløb.
  • Kan bringe dig selv i spil, gå forrest og give følgeskab, i dagligdagen og i samarbejdet med kollegaer og forældre.
  • Kan lide at lege og forstår vigtigheden af voksen indlevelse og deltagelse i børns leg.
  • Kan kommunikere professionelt med forældre, kollegaer og ledelse og ønsker at sparre, så vi sikrer god kvalitet.  
  • Er smilende og imødekommende, og at du er bevidst om, at du er en vigtig rollemodel i mange forskellige sammenhænge.

Ansøgning

Vi er ikke så vilde med traditionelle ansøgninger, og måske er du heller ikke. Derfor ønsker vi, at du sender et dokument, hvor du svarer på disse 5 spørgsmål. Svarene vil give os et bedre indblik i dig som pædagog og din faglighed.

  1. Fortæl om et barn, du havde svært ved at skabe relation til. Hvad gjorde du? Og hvad lærte du?
  2. Hvad er god pædagogik i en vuggestue efter din mening?
  3. Hvordan balancerer du omsorg og tydelige rammer?
  4. Hvilken rolle mener du, den voksen skal have i børns leg?
  5. Fortæl om noget, du har ændret mening om i dit pædagogiske arbejde gennem tiden og hvorfor. 

Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansættelsen er pr. 1. oktober 2026 men også gerne før.

Ansøgningsfrist:  14. august 2026
 
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen
  
Ugentligt timetal: 37

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Kan du se dig selv i noget af ovenstående, eller har du nogle spørgsmål? Så er du velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Mette Hornemann på 23 37 20 27 eller på hornemann@aarhus.dk. Du kan også kontakte David – der er pædagog på Den Grønne Gren på 21266592.

Se mere om os på vores hjemmeside Børnehuset Derudá

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.   

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Academic Partnerships and Research Networks
jobs.description:
Are you interested in strengthening LUT Universitys international research standing and building partnerships that support the universitys impact and growth?

We are seeking an experienced leader to oversee the strategic development of LUT University's academic partnerships and research networks. The position plays a key role in strengthening LUT University's international standing in research and establishing new strategic collaborations with leading universities, research funding agencies, and companies worldwide.

In this role, you will advance LUT University's research impact, competitiveness, and growth in research funding. Your work will promote the goals of the university's System Earth 2030 strategy: the regenerative use of natural resources, building resilient businesses, industry, and communities, utilising data and digital technology to benefit society, and clean energy solutions for industry and society.

What you will do

You will be responsible for the strategic development of LUT University's academic partnerships and research networks. You will strengthen the universitys international research standing in the long term by developing high-level partnerships and enhancing LUTs institutional impact in international research networks.

A key part of your role is to promote the growth of research funding and to create the conditions that enable the development of significant international research projects. In your work, you will identify and promote collaboration opportunities that support LUT Universitys strategic priorities.

You will be part of the rectors management team and work in close collaboration with the rector, provost, and other senior management. In this role, you will influence how LUT University is positioned internationally in both research and industry collaboration and how strategic partnerships and research networks support the universitys long-term goals.

You will work actively with international partners, stakeholder groups, and research networks. The role involves a significant amount of international travel and active presence in LUT University's key collaboration networks.

Your role is primarily strategic, but you are also able to take strategic targets to a practical level and ensure their implementation within the organisation to strengthen international collaboration at LUT in practice. This is a new position, and you will have an opportunity to develop it.

What we are looking for

The ideal candidate has a relevant doctoral degree and a strong academic background. You have experience in leadership roles and a proven track record of effective strategic development. You also have extensive experience in international research collaboration and network building.

We are looking for someone who can identify and develop partnerships of strategic importance to LUT University and build them over the long term at an institutional level. You have a solid understanding of European research funding and research policy, and you are comfortable working with research organisations, funding agencies, and industry partners.

The role calls for excellent communication and negotiation skills and the ability to operate effectively in an international environment. You are able to build trust with a range of stakeholders and move initiatives forward in a goal-oriented way.

Excellent written and spoken English is essential in our international work environment.

Prior experience as a professor, proficiency in Finnish, and experience working in a multinational company are all considered advantages but are not required for success in the role.

What we offer

We offer you a key role in developing LUT Universitys international position as a research institution. You will be able to influence strategic partnerships, research networks, and growth in research funding and work in close collaboration with university management.

Your work may be based in either Lahti or Lappeenranta. The position requires on-site presence and frequent travel between the two campuses and abroad. The LUT Universities group applies a hybrid approach to work.

Your monthly starting salary may range from 8,500 to 10,000 euros, depending on prior experience and expertise. In addition, you will be eligible for a management performance bonus. A six-month trial period applies.

Your start date is flexible, but we are looking to fill the position as soon as possible, ideally by early 2027.

In addition to interviews, our hiring process includes an aptitude assessment and reference checks as part of the final selection.

Apply now and join us in strengthening LUT University's international partnerships and research networks!

Interested? Please submit your application through the link below by 30 August 2026 at 23:59 Finnish local time. We will review applications on a rolling basis and fill the position as soon as we find a suitable candidate.

For more information on the position, please call Rector Juha-Matti Saksa (+358 400 166 659) on 3 August from 15:00 to 16:00, 5 August from 08:00 to 09:00, 12 August from 08:00 to 09:00, 20 August from 08:00 to 09:00 or 27 August from 15:00 to 16:00.

Read more about [LUT as an employer](https://www.lut.fi/en/about-us/come-work-us/lut-employer).

LUT University | LUT University seeks solutions to global issues with its expertise in technology, business, and social sciences. LUT is a trailblazer in promoting the energy transition and the regenerative use of natural resources and helps build resilient communities, industry, and businesses through data, research, and education. LUT's campuses are in Lappeenranta and Lahti, Finland, but its impact is global. [Lut.fi/en](https://www.lut.fi/en)

Technical support for using the recruitment system: recruitment@lut.fi.

jobs.title: Lounaskokki, Kuopio
jobs.description:
Etsimme nyt Kuopioon vakituista ruoanlaitosta nauttivaa lounaskokkia!

Tämä paikka on tunnettu herkullisesta kotiruokalounaasta ja laajasta salaattibuffasta.

Työnkuva on monipuolinen ja päivät erilaisia. Aamulla työt alkavat maittavan kotiruokalounaan valmistamisella ja päivän aikana työhön kuuluvat esimerkiksi yhteistyössä tiimin kanssa lounaslinjaston ylläpito, astiahuolto sekä muut ravintolan yleiset tehtävät. Tarvittaessa työhön kuuluu myös kassan käyttöä ja asiakaspalvelua. Vaikka töissä on aina työkavereitakin, työ on myös hyvin itsenäistä. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan elo-syyskuussa ja tunteja on tarjolla kokoaikaisesti. Työtä tehdään maanantaista perjantaihin, jolloin viikonloput jäävät mukavasti vapaaksi. Työaika sijoittuu vaihdellen klo 6-16 välille. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi aikaisten aamuvuorojen vuoksi.

Etsimällämme henkilöllä on kokemusta kokin työtehtävistä sekä voimassa oleva hygieniapassi. Alan koulutuksen katsomme eduksi, muttei se ole välttämätöntä, jos osaamista on kerryttetty muutoin. Ravintola on ympäristönä tyypillisesti nopeatempoinen, joten hyvä paineensietokyky ja organisointitaidot varmistavat työssä onnistumisen. Etsimäämme henkilöä kuvaavat adjektiivit ammattitaitoinen ja rempseä. Toivomme hyvää työmotivaatiota, mutta myös hyvää huumorintajua, sillä töissä pitää olla myös hauskaa!

Työsuhteeseen sovelletaan matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevaa työehtosopimusta.

Mitä odotamme hakijoilta?

* Aiempaa kokemusta keittiötyöstä ja/tai alan koulutusta
* Oma-aloitteisuutta sekä joustavuutta
* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa (Fluent Finnish language skills)

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

* Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn
* Mukavat työkaverit ja rennon työympäristön työskentelyyn
* Totalin henkilöstön avun ja tuen työsuhteesi kaikissa vaiheissa

Miten prosessi etenee?

Jos tunnistit itsesi kuvauksesta, kerro osaamisestasi lisää jättämällä hakemuksesi ja cv. Olemme sinuun yhteydessä haastatteluiden merkeissä.

Jos mieleesi heräsi kysymyksiä, niin ole rohkeasti yhteydessä Jaanaan, arkisin klo 8-16, 040 5155 497, jaana@totalhenkilostopalvelut.fi



* Jätä työnhaku meidän huoleksemme*

Total-Henkilöstöpalvelut on henkilöstötalo, joka pyrkii edistämään ja lisäämään pidempikestoisia työsuhteita. Olemme keskittyneet laadukkaaseen ja pitkäjänteiseen yhteistyöhön asiakasyritystemme kanssa, mikä mahdollistaa pidempiaikaisten työsuhteiden tarjonnan ja usein vakinaistumisen mahdollisuuden työnhakijoillemme. Työllistämme vuosittain satoja osaajia asiakkaillemme, useille eri aloille.

jobs.title: Human Resources Benefits Coordinator
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced HR Benefits Lead to own and enhance our employee benefits function while helping build the infrastructure for a scalable, high-performing benefits team. This individual will serve as the subject matter expert for all aspects of benefits administration, ensuring compliance, improving employee experience, and partnering closely with internal stakeholders and external vendors.


This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex programs, improving existing processes, and creating a best-in-class benefits function.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end administration of employee benefits programs across a multi-state workforce spanning more than 30 states.
  • Manage all health and welfare programs, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and voluntary benefits.
  • Own the administration of the company's 401(k) plan, ensuring timely and accurate retirement plan administration, non-discrimination testing, audits, and regulatory compliance.
  • Partner closely with payroll to ensure accurate deductions, benefit enrollments, qualifying life events, and reconciliation of benefit data.
  • Oversee leave administration, including FMLA, ADA accommodations, short-term disability, long-term disability, and applicable state leave program
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations governing employee benefits across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Build strong relationships with insurance brokers, retirement plan advisors, and third-party administrators to negotiate plan design, control costs, and improve service levels.
  • Analyze benefit utilization, market trends, and employee feedback to recommend enhancements to benefit offerings.
  • Translate complex benefit plans into clear, employee-friendly communications that help employees make informed enrollment decisions.
  • Develop scalable processes, documentation, and internal controls to support future team growth.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employee benefit questions and escalated issues.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive HR benefits experience with ownership of end-to-end benefits administration.
  • Experience supporting a multi-state employee population across 30 or more states.
  • Deep knowledge of medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and voluntary benefit plans.
  • Strong expertise in 401(k) administration, including retirement plan compliance, non-discrimination testing, annual reporting, and vendor management.
  • Demonstrated experience administering FMLA, ADA, short-term disability, long-term disability, and state leave progra
  • Strong understanding of ERISA, COBRA, HIPAA, ACA, and other applicable benefits regulations.
  • Experience partnering closely with payroll to ensure accurate benefit processing and compliance.
  • Proven ability to establish and manage strategic relationships with insurance brokers and benefit providers while evaluating plan design and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex benefits information for employees and leadership.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.


Preferred Background

  • Experience stepping into an environment where benefits programs required stabilization and operational improvement.
  • Takes ownership of critical programs, particularly the company's 401(k), ensuring every aspect of retirement administration is accurate and compliant rather than simply processing transactions.
  • Comfortable bringing structure to under-managed programs and implementing sustainable processes.
  • Proven ability to influence brokers and insurance carriers on pricing, plan design, and service expectations.
  • Experience building or expanding an internal benefits function and mentoring future team members.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Evio Overview

Evio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions.

In 2020, a group of five amazing Blue Cross Blue Shield health plans that in total serve more than 20 million members recognized that the way medications get to patients needs significant reformârapidly rising costs and massive system complexities are detrimental to patients and the entire industry. In 2025, Wellmark joined as Evio's first non-founding investor and sixth owner health plan. Each company made, and continues to make, significant investments to establish Evio as an independent entity to lead this transformation. â¨

Evio has advancedâ¯analytics and contracting capabilities at scale, and a suite of digital tools, to power our high-cost medication solutions. Our solutions act as a self-reinforcing âflywheelâ where each element strengthens and feeds into the next, and support an âOnly Evio can do that,â mindset and prioritization.

Evio is also a company that has invested heavily in and been highly intentional about people, team and culture. We believe we have created a very special place to work and encourage candidates to observe and ask us about our culture and decide for themselves.

Evio's Values

  • Empathy â The people our business serves always come first. We care for our teammates and put ourselves in the shoes of our health plan customers and the patients and clinicians our solutions benefit.
  • Diversity â We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone belongs and is valued for their background, experience and insights â one that encourages diversity of ideas, and is a nurturing, trusting, and accepting place for all.
  • Adventure â We are flexible, thrive in ambiguity, fail fast, and pivot quickly to get to a better answer. We celebrate wins and pivots with equal intensity.
  • Relentless â Guided by evidence and data, we are creative, curious, and unwavering in our pursuit of challenging the status quo and each other.
  • Transparency â Just as we seek to bring transparency to the pharmacy supply chain, authenticity and integrity are core to the way we communicate.
  • Excellence â We strive to raise the bar in all we do by hiring and developing exceptional talent and holding ourselves and our thinking to the highest standard.

People Operations Manager

About The Role

As People Operations Manager, you'll execute the operational foundation of the teammate experience at Evio. Reporting to the Head of Evio Experience, you'll help ensure every stage of the teammate experience is thoughtful, well-executed, and compliant. Evio is a growing company with increasing teammate support needs. This is a hands-on role where you'll serve as Evio's subject matter expert on benefits, administer people operations, manage our people systems and vendor relationships, and ensure teammates receive timely, knowledgeable support throughout their time at Evio.

We're looking for someone with a service-oriented mindset who takes pride in delivering an exceptional teammate experience through operational excellence, responsiveness, and continuous improvement. Success in this role means teammates know they can count on you for accurate answers, thoughtful support, and reliable execution, while managers trust you to keep logistics running smoothly behind the scenes.

What You'll Do

Administer benefits and support teammates

  • Administer Evio's benefits programs, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), disability, COBRA, and other benefit offerings.
  • Become Evio's internal expert on benefit programs, providing timely, knowledgeable support to teammates and helping them navigate questions and life events.
  • Resolve benefit issues by partnering closely with teammates, brokers, carriers, and vendors.
  • Administer leaves of absence and workplace accommodations.
  • Manage relationships with benefits brokers, vendors, and other external partners.
  • Recommend improvements to benefits and people policies based on teammate feedback, operational insights, and evolving business needs.

Own people systems and operational excellence

  • Own the day-to-day administration of people systems, including Justworks and future people technology platforms.
  • Ensure people systems, teammate records, workflows, and documentation remain accurate, organized, and up to date.
  • Document, maintain, and continuously improve people processes to support consistency and scale.
  • Maintain SOC-related people operations controls and documentation.
  • Identify practical opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational processes.

Support policies and compliance

  • Help maintain the teammate handbook and people policies.
  • Ensure required employment notices and documentation remain current.
  • Partner with Legal and the Head of Evio Experience to support employment law compliance.
  • Maintain documentation standards and consistent employment practices.
  • Help ensure leave, accommodation, and employment practices are administered consistently and compliantly.

Coordinate onboarding and offboarding

  • Execute the operational aspects of the teammate journey from pre-boarding through offboarding.
  • Coordinate pre-boarding logistics to ensure new teammates have a seamless start.
  • Manage offboarding processes, documentation, and logistics.
  • Administer company calendars, and recurring people operations processes.

Your Skills And Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in people operations, human resources, teammate experience, benefits administration, HR compliance, or a closely related operational role. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from a variety of backgrounds, provided they've demonstrated ownership of core people responsibilities such as benefits administration, people systems, HR compliance, and supporting the teammate lifecycle in a growing organization.
  • Strong experience administering employee benefits and supporting teammates through benefit questions, life events, and leave administration.
  • Experience managing people systems and maintaining accurate teammate records and workflows.
  • Experience managing relationships with external vendors, brokers, and service providers.
  • Working knowledge of human resources practices, employment law, HR compliance, accommodations, documentation standards, and leave administration.
  • Experience documenting and improving operational processes in a growing organization.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to explain complex information clearly and compassionately.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism.
  • A service-oriented mindset with a genuine desire to support teammates and help create a company and culture we're all proud to be part of.

Salary considerations

The anticipated salary range for this position is $100,000â$130,000 annually plus additional variable compensation.

Atâ¯Evio,â¯weâreâ¯committed to building a competitive compensation package to honor the value our teammates bring as well as attract andâ¯retainâ¯top talent that is aligned with our culture,â¯missionâ¯and values. Compensation includes base pay (range shown) and could include other variable compensation opportunitiesâ¯depending on job seniority, location, and date of hire.

Please note that the base pay information shown is a general guideline for the job responsibilities and qualifications listed. Salary decisions are based on candidateâ¯experience, andâ¯market and business considerations.â¯

Evio Benefits

Evio offers a number of attractive benefits to eligible teammates including health insurance, retirement savings, life and disability insurance, paid and unpaid time off, and other benefits to make sure Evio teammates and families are well supported.

  • Great Health Insurance The company pays 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for teammates, and 50% for dependents.
  • 401K Match Evio matches 100% of teammate contribution up to 5% of salary, subject to IRS limits.
  • Time Off We have a flexible vacation policy for teammates to unplug and recharge when you need it. There is no minimum or maximum amount of vacation allowed per year, and there is no payment in consideration for unused vacation. Vacation is to be used at your discretion, with approval of leadership.
  • Parental Leave Generous paid leave for new parents (includes birth and non-birth parents).

Fraud Notice

Weâve Recently Learned Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Falsely Claiming To Represent Evio. Protecting Our Candidates Is Incredibly Important To Us, And We Want To Share a Few Reminders

  • All official communication will come from an email ending in @evio.com.
  • We will never conduct text-only interviews (Teams, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, etc.).
  • We will never ask for payment, gift cards, fees, or purchases of any kind.
  • We will never request sensitive financial information during the recruiting process.
  • Our open roles are posted only on our official website, LinkedIn, and Greenhouse job board.

If you believe youâve encountered a scam, you can also report it to the Federal Trade Commission or the Internet Crime Complaint Center. Thank you for your care and vigilance â weâre grateful to everyone who helps keep our community safe.

Information Disclosure

We value transparency in our hiring process and want applicants to understand how your information is used.

We collect and use personal information you provide during the application process such as your resume, employment history, education, interview responses, and other job-related information, to evaluate your qualifications for employment. This may also include limited technical and interaction data, such as IP address and device or browser information.

We may use automated or AI-assisted tools to help review applications, identify qualified candidates, and detect or investigate potentially fraudulent or deceptive activity. Human reviewers remain involved, and these tools support, not replace, human judgment.

These measures support a fair and secure hiring process for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please inform us when invited to interview.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:
About Symbiotic

Symbiotic is the infrastructure beneath collateral markets, where capital can secure financial obligations, remain productive, and be enforced by code.

By changing the economics of onchain collateral, Symbiotic enables new categories of neofinance applications that were previously impossible to build - including credit, insurance, RWA liquidity, and more.

As institutional capital increasingly moves onchain, Symbiotic is positioned to become the coordination layer connecting capital and risk across the onchain economy.

Backed by Paradigm, Pantera, Cyber.fund, and Coinbase Ventures, we power 80+ vaults, 74,000+ active stakers, and 111 operators - with Chainlink, Nexus Mutual, and Cap Labs among the teams live in production.

See how Symbiotic is powering the next generation of onchain finance: symbiotic.fi

Our People

Weâre a tight-knit team of experienced builders working at the forefront of financial infrastructure. Our backgrounds span high-growth tech start-ups, leading crypto companies, major banks, insurers, and financial institutions. We work with ownership, a high bar for craft, and the urgency of an early-stage company - in an environment where people are trusted to take initiative and supported to do their best work.

Weâre looking for talented professionals to join us at a defining moment, as Symbiotic helps shape the next generation of onchain finance.

What You'll Do

  • Own visual output across brand, campaigns, web, social, and launch moments, from concept to shipped asset.
  • Turn complex financial infrastructure and products into things people can actually see and understand.
  • Set and hold the visual system as we scale, not just as a guideline doc, but as consistent, recognisable output across everything we ship.
  • Support event and content collateral: Prepares high-impact visuals for Web3 conferences, whitepaper illustrations, and blog graphics .
  • Optimize assets for Web3 platforms: Ensures designs are responsive for web3 wallets, mobile apps, and animated formats, while adhering to crypto-specific trends.
  • Produce motion and 3D work where it earns its place: product explainers, launch films, conference presence.

Who You Are

  • Fast and good, not one or the other. Most designers have one. You have both and you can walk us through the timeline on specific pieces in your portfolio: how long it took, what the deadline was, what you cut.
  • Deep in one or two areas, competent across the rest. Strong in brand or motion or 3D, able to hold your own in the others.
  • Self-directed. You've scoped, sequenced, and driven real projects without someone telling you the next step and made the calls yourself when the brief was ambiguous.
  • Someone who pitches rather than asks permission. You bring a direction and argue for it.
  • Unbothered by direct feedback. We're small, fast, and radically transparent with each other.
  • Sitting on a portfolio with real range. You shipped work, not concepts, ideally something you took from nothing to live under time pressure.

Nice to have

  • Crypto, fintech experience â enough that you're not learning what a protocol is on the job.
  • In-house experience at an early-stage company.
  • 3D or motion as a genuine strength rather than a passing familiarity.

jobs.title: Ingénieur DevOps/SRE senior (h/f)
jobs.description:
RESPONSABILITÉS :

LA MISSION
L'équipe a vocation à rester de taille limitée, misant à travers l'approche SRE sur l'efficacité, l'automatisation et la co-responsabilité. La personne qui nous rejoindra aura pour principales responsabilités de:
- Contribuer au RUN, à la fiabilisation, la sécurisation et à l'évolution de la plateforme Kubernetes et des composants associés ;
- Participer à la définition, à la maintenance et à l'adoption des standards DevOps, CI/CD et de déploiement ;
- Améliorer les dispositifs d'observabilité, d'alerting, de diagnostic et de réponse aux incidents ;
- Intégrer les exigences de sécurité opérationnelle dans les pipelines, les workloads, les accès, les secrets et les pratiques d'exploitation
- Contribuer à la maîtrise opérationnelle des bases de données, notamment sur les sujets de disponibilité, performance, réplication, sauvegarde et restauration ;
- Identifier les irritants récurrents et contribuer à leur réduction par l'automatisation, la documentation, les templates et les pratiques de self-service ;
- Accompagner les équipes produit dans l'adoption des standards DevOps/SRE, tout en maintenant une cohérence globale de plateforme.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ :

PROFIL RECHERCHE
Nous recherchons un profil senior ayant 7 à 10 ans d'expérience et à l'aise sur les sujets suivants :
- Kubernetes / Containers : administration, troubleshooting, sécurité (K8s, Helm)
- Expérience sur kubernetes: KaaS chez un Cloud provider : Azure, Scaleway
- CI/CD : rédaction, maintenance, sécurisation de pipelines (Azure DevOps, Github action)
- IaC et outils de GitOps (Terraform, Ansible, Argo)
- Linux : diagnostic système, scripting, réseau, stockage, certificats, logs.
- Observabilité : alerting, dashboards, définition de SLI/SLO. (Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Application Insight)
- Sécurité : OIDC, RBAC, moindre privilège, gestion des secrets, durcissement workloads.
- Base de données :exploitation production, réplication, sauvegarde/restauration, performance, HA. PostgreSQL, SQLServer en bonus
- Réseau applicatif : ingress controller, DNS, TLS, WAF, firewalling, diagnostic HTTP/TCP.
- Service Mesh: idéalement Dapr
- Connaissance de langages de programmation (Python, nodejs, c# et/ou Go)
- Utilisation et appétence pour les techniques et outils d'intelligence artificielle
EVOLUTIONS
La politique RH vous garantit un accompagnement régulier pour vous faire progresser et évoluer vers de nouvelles missions en fonction de votre projet. Rejoindre notre Groupe, c'est la garantie d'une formation initiale et continue, d'un plan de carrière personnalisé et d'un management de proximité.

CONDITIONS PROPOSEES
- Poste ouvert sur toute la France, à pourvoir dès que possible.
- Rémunération : Fixe + Intéressement et participation
- Télétravail possible jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine ou 100% télétravail (en fonction du lieu de résidence)

Dans le cadre de sa politique RH, NEOS étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.

Junior Fund Controller F/M - Asset Management Firm

Reference: LU877162
Luxembourg
Permanent
Financial Services

We are currently supporting a renowned and fast-growing asset management firm in the recruitment of a Junior Fund Controller to join its dynamic Luxembourg office.

This opportunity is ideal for a motivated professional looking to develop strong expertise within fund control and gain exposure to alternative investments in an international and collaborative environment.

Working closely with experienced professionals, you will be involved in a variety of fund administration and controlling activities, with a key focus on reviewing capital calls and distributions.

Primary duties and responsibilities:

• Assist Fund Controllers in reviewing and processing capital calls and distributions.

• Support the computation and review of management fees.
• Prepare and maintain detailed records and documentation for all capital call and distribution activities.
• Collaborate with the accounting team to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.
• Assist in the preparation of periodic financial statements and investor reports.
• Participate in reviewing and improving internal processes and controls related to fund administration.
• Respond to inquiries from investors and internal stakeholders regarding capital calls and distributions.
• Assist in the annual audit process and liaise with external auditors.

Qualifications :

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• At least 2-3 years of fund administration experience in a Luxembourg service provider.
• Experience dealing with real estate funds or private debt funds mandatory.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and high level of accuracy in work.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

• Team Building.
• Recognition and Career Advancement: You will be recognized and rewarded for your work and dedication. Your contribution will not go unnoticed.

jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belval | Up to 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

Describe the main responsibilities of the position.

Refrigeration and air conditioning account for ~17% of global energy consumption, a figure expected to triple by 2050, while contributing over 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions. Conventional vapor-compression cooling relies on high–global-warming-potential refrigerants, creating an urgent need for energy-efficient and environmentally friendly alternatives. Electrocaloric cooling is a promising solid-state technology that can be up to 20% more efficient than vapor-compression systems. It uses ferroelectric materials that undergo a reversible temperature change under an applied electric field. The materials heats upon application and cools upon removal of an electric field. LIST has been working on the topic for some years, specifically developing electrocaloric prototypes based on ceramics and polymers. LIST is recognized as one of the leading institutes in the field.

The role played by materials thermal conductivity on the behaviour of electrocaloric coolers is central to enable a proper understanding of the system. Therefore, this post doc is about studying the thermal conductivity of electrocaloric materials in the context of cooling devices. More specifically, one part will be devoted to the design and fabrication of heat exchangers integrated in electrocaloric coolers. The impact of materials and their thickness will be assessed in specific devices. Another part of this post doc will be devoted to the study of heat switches associated with electrocaloric materials, enabling the design of fluid-free cooling devices.

Other tasks include:
•              Conference/group meetings participation

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

As post-doctoral researcher, you will work in the frame of the SUPHA project funded by the Luxembourg National Research Fund (FNR) through the TREK research program. SUPHA goal is to develop and optimise a membrane based process that recovers humic substances directly from anaerobic digestate. The postdoctoral researcher will drive the scale-up of an innovative membrane-based process for the extraction and valorisation of humic substances from digestate, advancing the technology from bench to pilot scale (TRL 4–5).

HUOMIOI

Em. kokemus on siis ehdottoman välttämätön, koska ilmoituksia täytyy pystyä laatimaan itsenäisesti ilman jatkuvaa työnjohtoa. Mahdollisuutta kouluttamiseen ei ole.

Ilmoituksia voi tehdä 1-5 kpl/päivä ja niin halutessaan myös iltaisin / viikonloppuisin. Yhden ilmoituksen tekoon varataan vähintään tunti.

60-70 % kuvista ja teksteistä tulee valmiina. On osattava muokata kuvia ja tuottaa tekstiä itsekin. Virheetön kielitaito ja 100 %:n huolellisuus ovat välttämättömiä. Voi sanoa, että tämä työ on pikkutarkkaa.

Lähetä yhteydenotto, jossa kerrot itsestäsi ja kokemuksestasi autojen myynti-ilmoitusten tekijänä. Liitä mukaan CV + tekstinäyte luomastasi auton myyntitekstistä (esim. jostain Nettiautossa olevasta yksityishenkilön ilmoituksesta). Ota mallia sivujemme ilmoituksista. MUISTA! Ilman edellä mainittuja hakemusta ei voida käsitellä.

Harjoittelijalle tai autoliikkeiden myynti-ilmoitusten teosta vain vähäisen kokemuksen omaavalle meillä ei valitettavasti ole paikkaa.

Kannattaa katsoa esimerkkejä sivuiltamme välilehdeltä Automyynti (esim. Toyota RAV4 2.0 Valvematic 4WD Active Multidrive S Autom).

Ilmoitusten sisältö on paljon laajempi kuin useimmilla muilla saman alan toimijoilla.

jobs.title: Global Mobility Vendor Management Professional (w/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Global Mobility Vendor Management Professional (w/m/d) und verstärken Sie unser Center of Excellence. In dieser Funktion übernehmen Sie die operative Steuerung, Governance und Optimierung von externen Dienstleistern, die internationale Mitarbeitereinsätze und globale Mobilitätsservices unterstützen.

Die Rolle kombiniert die direkte Verantwortung für ausgewählte Dienstleister und Servicebereiche (z. B. Relocation, Umzugs- und Destination Services) mit der operativen Steuerung und Governance von Dienstleistern in Leistungsbereichen, die von globalen Fachexperten (Subject Matter Experts) verantwortet werden (z. B. Steuern, Immigration/Aufenthaltsrecht, Sozialversicherung usw.).

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Bevorzugte Standorte für diese Position sind Deutschland, Portugal und Polen. Bewerbungen aus anderen Ländern der EMEA-Region (Europa, Naher Osten und Afrika) können ebenfalls berücksichtigt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sie stellen einheitliche Governance-Standards über das gesamte Dienstleisterportfolio hinweg sicher.- Sie steuern die täglichen Beziehungen zu den Ihnen zugeordneten Service Providern und stellen sicher, dass die Leistungserbringung den geschäftlichen Anforderungen entspricht.- Sie übernehmen die Rolle des primären fachlichen Verantwortlichen für ausgewählte Dienstleisterkategorien (z. B. Relocation-, Umzugs- und Destination-Services).- Sie definieren und überwachen die Leistung der Dienstleister anhand vertraglicher Verpflichtungen durch SLAs, KPIs und Scorecards und führen regelmäßige operative Reviews sowie Leistungsgespräche durch.- Sie fungieren als Eskalationsinstanz für dienstleisterbezogene Service-Themen und treiben die Lösung von Problemen, Ursachenanalysen (Root-Cause-Analysen) sowie Korrekturmaßnahmen voran.- Sie treiben Initiativen zur Konsolidierung und Rationalisierung von Dienstleistern voran, um die Lieferantenlandschaft zu vereinfachen, Effizienzsteigerungen zu erzielen, Kosten zu senken und die Employee Experience zu verbessern.- Sie unterstützen die Implementierung von Verträgen und stellen sicher, dass vertragliche Vereinbarungen operativ umgesetzt werden, einschließlich der Einrichtung von Abrechnungsstrukturen, Bestellprozessen, Kostenallokationen und der Rechnungsprüfung.- Sie erhöhen die finanzielle Transparenz innerhalb des Global-Mobility-Portfolios.- Sie arbeiten eng mit Einkauf, Finanzen, Recht, HR und weiteren Stakeholdern in Bezug auf Dienstleisterperformance, Rechnungsgenauigkeit, Vertragsverlängerungen und Beschaffungsentscheidungen zusammen.- Sie unterstützen Compliance-, Risikomanagement- und Audit-Anforderungen und gewährleisten die Kontinuität der Dienstleisterleistungen in Veränderungsphasen.- Sie identifizieren Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Vendor-Management-Prozessen, Governance-Rahmenwerken, Reporting-Strukturen und der Servicebereitstellung.

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.- Sie bringen mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Vendor Management, in HR Operations, Shared Services, Global Mobility oder im Professional-Services-Umfeld mit.- Bewerberinnen und Bewerber mit einem Bachelorabschluss und zusätzlicher einschlägiger Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich sind ebenfalls herzlich willkommen.- Sie verfügen über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung und dem Management ausgelagerter Dienstleister in einem komplexen internationalen Umfeld.- Sie besitzen ein fundiertes Verständnis von Service Delivery, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Governance-Strukturen und Performance Management.- Sie haben Erfahrung in der bereichsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit mit Teams aus Einkauf, Finanzen, Recht, HR, IT, Risiko- und Compliance-Management.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlich langjähriger Berufserfahrung und weiteren Qualifikationen in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.- Sie besitzen ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie eine starke Kompetenz in den Bereichen Problemlösung, Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikation.- Sie sind in der Lage, operative Detailarbeit mit strategischem Überblick zu verbinden und dabei kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist Klaus Kouril.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

Mēs piedāvājam:

•  Elastīgu darba grafiku;

jobs.title: Mid-Market Solutions Consultant, New York
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how enterprise software is sold and the Solutions Consultant is the cornerstone of that model. As a SC, you’ll own the full customer journey: from first meeting through workflow design, commercial close, workflow implementation, expansion & renewal planning. You are the single owner of your accounts, accountable for ensuring what you sell actually gets realized. You’ll build live in front of customers, translate workflow designs into commercial outcomes, and be a trusted partner with genuine continuity across the entire relationship. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed

 - Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer

 - Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline

 - Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path

 - Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion

 - Partner with Outcomes Architects (OA) on onboarding, adoption plans, expansion strategies, and renewal execution—owning the commercial arc while OAs drive day-to-day workflow adoption




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 4-7+ years of experience selling technical products to technical buyers

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room

 - Strong discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans

 - Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles

 - You can own the room - you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools & learning new ways of working




NICE TO HAVES

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new logo acquisition and expansion motions
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or CS team as part of an integrated customer motion



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is $216,000 - $276,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21#LI-Onsite






A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

More than 20,000 associates in bakeries, sales centers, offices and on sales routes work to ensure our consumers have the freshest products at every meal. In addition to competitive pay and benefits, we provide a safe and inclusive work environment that appreciates diversity, promotes development and allows our associates to be their authentic selves.

## LI-NP1

Come join the largest baking company in the world and our family of 20,000 associates nationwide!

Top Reasons To Work At Bimbo Bakeries USA

Annual Bonus Eligibility

Comprehensive Benefits Package

Position Summary:

The Transportation Analyst supports transportation planning, daily shipment execution, customer service, and performance reporting across the transportation network. This role combines analytical problem solving with service-oriented communication to improve shipment visibility, monitor on-time performance, support track-and-trace activity, identify trends and exceptions, and provide timely reporting and follow-up to carriers, internal stakeholders, and operations teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support transportation planning activities by reviewing shipment demand, routing requirements, carrier capacity, delivery schedules, and operational constraints.
  • Monitor shipment execution through track-and-trace activity, providing timely updates on shipment status, delivery expectations, appointment changes, and potential service risks.
  • Provide customer service support to carriers, internal teams, and business partners by responding to transportation inquiries, resolving shipment issues, and coordinating follow-up on exceptions.
  • Track, analyze, and report transportation KPIs including on-time pickup, on-time delivery, appointment adherence, shipment visibility, exception resolution time, carrier response time, and service issue trends.
  • Prepare on-time performance reporting and provide analysis on delays, missed appointments, late deliveries, root causes, and opportunities to improve service performance.
  • Analyze transportation data to identify trends, cost impacts, service gaps, network inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve planning, execution, and carrier performance.
  • Partner with Transportation, Planning, Logistics, Operations, Sales, Customer Service, and carrier partners to support daily execution, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Request, validate, and maintain accurate shipment, carrier, and transportation data to support reporting, performance analysis, and operational decision-making.
  • Review transportation reports and data for inconsistencies, missing information, shipment exceptions, and documentation gaps; seek clarification as needed to ensure accurate reporting and follow-up.
  • Assist with business cases, savings projections, operating budgets, and project start-ups by providing transportation data, KPI insights, and performance analysis.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying process gaps, recommending improvements, and helping standardize transportation planning, reporting, and communication processes.
  • Serve as cross-functional support for transportation planning and execution activities as needed to ensure operational continuity and consistent service levels.

Leadership Competencies

Education and Work History:

  • 3-5 yearsâ experience in Supply Chain/Transportation Analysis in CPG, Food Beverage or Third Party Logistics company.
  • Understanding of the North American transportation industry including dedicated/private fleet, TL, LTL (domestic and cross border), intermodal.
  • Highly proficient / advanced working knowledge in Microsoft Office (ie: Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, PowerPoint).
  • Experience/Exposure with logistics optimization tools (routing, transportation planning software) such as Appian, Paragon, JDA/Bule Yonder is a definite asset.
  • Working knowledge of TMS (Specially Oracle TMS) is an asset.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly.
  • Strong customer service mindset with the ability to support carrier partners, internal stakeholders, and operations teams by proactively addressing service issues, communicating changes, and coordinating resolution of transportation exceptions.
  • Ability to work with and support all team members, management and shareholders.

Er du grundig, mødestabil og sætter en ære i at levere et godt stykke arbejde? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Vi er et ægtepar, der driver en mindre, lokal rengøringsvirksomhed. Gennem mange år har vi opbygget en fast kundekreds, som værdsætter kvalitet, stabilitet og personlig service. Derfor søger vi en medarbejder, der har lyst til at blive en del af vores lille virksomhed og indgå i et længerevarende samarbejde.

Du kommer til at udføre rengøring hos vores faste erhvervskunder.

Nogle opgaver løser du selvstændigt, mens du på andre arbejder sammen med en kollega. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du både trives med at arbejde alene og er en god samarbejdspartner.

  • Enkelte opgaver kan ligge tidligt om morgenen efter aftale

  • Arbejdsstederne ligger fra Aarhus Midtby til Søften

Vi forventer, at du

  • Taler og forstår dansk.

  • Selv kan transportere dig mellem de forskellige arbejdssteder.

  • Er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst.

  • Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med en kollega.

  • Er grundig og har øje for detaljerne.

  • Er ærlig, loyal og sætter en ære i at levere en god service.

Erfaring med rengøring er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling – vi sørger for en grundig oplæring.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et godt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø.

  • En arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje og tæt kontakt til os som ejere.

  • Gode og loyale kunder.

  • Frihed under ansvar.

  • Grundig oplæring.

Vi søger en medarbejder, der ønsker et fast og længerevarende arbejde. Derfor er stillingen ikke den rette, hvis du kun søger et midlertidigt job i et sabbatår.

Kan du se dig selv hos os, hører vi meget gerne fra dig. Send din ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette medarbejder.

jobs.title: Social Media and Video Content Manager
jobs.description:
About Ajaia

Ajaia is a fast-growing AI consultancy and product studio that helps organizations move from experimentation to real results. We work across AI Strategy, AI Engineering and Automation, Workforce Enablement, and Custom Product Development, and we build our own AI products alongside client work.

Our mission is to help organizations win the AI moment.

About The Role

You will own content execution across social, short and long-form video, podcast workflows, and training video.

You own the calendar, the output, and the numbers. You write platform-native content for LinkedIn, X, and email. You edit video people actually finish watching. You build the AI-assisted workflows that make all of it faster without making it generic.

This role is AI-forward by design. You will use AI daily for ideation, scripting, editing, repurposing, and QA. We expect you to already work this way.

What You Will Do

  • Own social content operations from planning to publishing to performance reporting
  • Write platform-native content for LinkedIn, X, and email newsletters
  • Edit short and long-form video for marketing and thought leadership
  • Run podcast post-production, clips, and distribution
  • Produce and edit training video for internal and client-facing use
  • Build reusable AI-assisted workflows for scripting, editing, and repurposing
  • Hold the line on brand voice and quality across every output

Requirements

  • 3 to 5 years in social content, video editing, or multi-channel content management
  • Demonstrated ownership of publishing workflows and deadlines
  • Strong writing for LinkedIn, X, and email newsletter formats
  • Experience editing training or educational video
  • Evidence of AI-native execution in daily content work
  • Strong written communication and async habits on a remote team

Portfolio, required. Applications without samples will not be reviewed: LinkedIn, X, email newsletter, and video editing samples covering both short and long-form.

Schedule. Fully remote, with required overlap 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

Technical. Wired internet 100 Mbps minimum. Intel Core i7, Ryzen 7, or Apple Silicon with 16GB RAM and 256GB free storage. Windows 11 or current macOS. 1080p webcam and mic. Backup power and internet.

Process. Application and portfolio review, two-hour practical assessment, hiring manager interview, final conversation with leadership.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary plus performance incentives
  • Performance bonus up to 100 percent of base
  • Fully remote with earned flexibility
  • Professional development budget
  • Paid time off

Why join Ajaia

You will own a broad content function spanning social, video, podcast, and training, not one narrow slice of it. You will build thought leadership at a company doing AI implementation work that reaches production, and design scalable content systems rather than grinding out one-off assets.

Let's build what's next.

jobs.title: Technical Quality Program Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is growing rapidly and shipping new features and product improvements at a high rate to meet the needs of our customers.

The User Operations team is a function of the Customer Experience (CX) team maintaining clear lines of communication between customers and Product, ensuring customers get the most out of Notion and that their feedback is integrated into the product development process.

As the Technical Quality Program Manager, you will be responsible for building and maintaining world class support experiences related to product quality. You’ll be responsible for improving the bug reporter experience and maintaining and scaling processes for tracking and resolution of user issues related to product quality and feature requests.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Manage critical user experiences and internal workflows focused on improving product quality, influencing the development of new features, and supporting end users at scale

 - Continuously improve Notion’s bug-reporting and feature request funnels, from user-facing intake to escalation, tagging, tracking, reporting, and followup

 - Make data-informed recommendations for how to collect and prioritize feature requests, scale internal escalation processes, and resolve bugs and other product quality issues

 - Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to measure and drive CX’s bug management effectiveness and efficiency through tooling, process, and training improvements

 - Collaborate with Engineering to improve incident management workflows, ensuring clear escalation paths, timely communication, and effective resolution of customer-impacting issues

 - Build and maintain documentation, trainings, and QA processes for customer support issues related to quality, reliability, performance, and qualitative product feedback

 - Be an advocate for our customers and a thought partner to CX and Product partners




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 3-5 years experience in customer support operations, product operations, quality assurance, technical support, customer experience, or related field

 - Demonstrated experience leveraging AI to streamline cross-functional programs or processes

 - Experience working directly with engineers, product managers, or other technical roles as well as CX or customer-facing roles

 - Demonstrated experience solving ambiguous problems and using data to build consensus

 - Previous responsibility tracking and analyzing key operational metrics to ensure KPIs/service goals are met




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Notion product expertise

 - Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification

 - Technical knowledge or data querying experience (SQL)

 - Experience contributing to the product development process at a software company



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $61.54 – $67.79 hourly.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:
Arbeidssted: Bodø lufthavn

Arbeidstid: Rullerende vaktplan (dag, kveld, helg)

Oppstart: Så snart som mulig - intervjuer kjøres fortløpende

Stillingsprosent: 100%

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som klargjører er du ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til standard. I samarbeid med våre utleierepresentanter planlegger du behovet for leiebiler og leverer disse i henhold til plan. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av servicer og dekkomlegg i samarbeid med stasjonsleder. Det vil også være dager hvor du møter våre kunder og må hjelpe disse på en best mulig måte. 

  • Klargjøre leiebiler i henhold til våre standarder (vask mm)

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner 

  • Oversikt og kontroll på bestillinger og tilgjengelig bilpark

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus og dekklager

  • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg

  • Holde orden i utstyr og på arbeidsplassen

Kvalifikasjoner

Som klargjører har ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer til våre kunder. Vår hverdag styres av våre kunders behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. 

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (politiattest)

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor fysisk arbeidskapasitet

  • Strukturert med ordenssans

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: ALTERNANCE - PRODUCT OWNER - H/F
jobs.description:
Description :


Le portefeuille IAM (Identity & Access Management) regroupe les solutions de gestion des identités qui viennent compléter notre offre historique de PAM (PRIVILEGED ACCESS MANAGEMENT) :

* WALLIX IAG : notre solution d'IDENTITY ACCESS GOVERNANCE, dédiée à la certification des accès, à la gestion de la séparation des tâches (SoD) et au cycle de vie des habilitations.
* WALLIX ONE IDAAS : notre plateforme IDENTITY-AS-A-SERVICE, proposant le SSO (Single Sign-On), la MFA (authentification multifacteur), la fédération d'identités et le provisioning des utilisateurs, hébergée sur une infrastructure souveraine française.
* SÉCURITÉ DES IDENTITÉS NON HUMAINES (NON-HUMAN IDENTITY - NHI) : une nouvelle gamme de produits dédiée à la gestion des identités non humaines (comptes de service, clés API, agents IA), avec une feuille de route incluant la gestion des secrets et les architectures SECRETLESS.
* INTÉGRATION DES SOLUTIONS D'IDENTITÉ : garantir l'interopérabilité de ces produits via le WALLIX ONE CONSOLE, notre plan de contrôle unifié, afin d'offrir un modèle d'identité cohérent à travers l'ensemble du portefeuille.

Il ne s'agit PAS D'UN POSTE CENTRÉ SUR UN SEUL PRODUIT. Vous interviendrez sur plusieurs solutions, à la croisée des enjeux liés à l'identité numérique, à la gouvernance des accès et à la stratégie produit.

Votre mission :

Rattaché(e) au LEAD PRODUCT MANAGER du portefeuille IAM, vous contribuerez à l'ensemble du cycle de vie produit, de la phase de découverte jusqu'à la livraison, sur une ou plusieurs lignes de produits IAM.

Il s'agit d'un poste très opérationnel, offrant une véritable immersion dans le métier de Product Management appliqué à la cybersécurité au sein d'une entreprise cotée en bourse.

Découverte produit & stratégie :

* Participer aux entretiens avec les clients et prospects afin de comprendre leurs problématiques de gestion des identités, notamment dans les secteurs réglementés (finance, administrations, infrastructures critiques).
* Réaliser des analyses concurrentielles face à des acteurs tels qu'Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, SailPoint ou CyberArk.
* Contribuer à la rédaction des documents de cadrage produit, des analyses d'opportunités et des recommandations stratégiques pour la feuille de route IAM.
* Assurer une veille sur :
* les rapports des cabinets d'analystes (Gartner, KuppingerCole) ;
* les évolutions réglementaires (NIS2, DORA, recommandations de l'ANSSI) ;
* les tendances technologiques (IA agentique, identités des workloads, architectures secretless).

Gestion du backlog & delivery :

* Rédiger et affiner les User Stories, les critères d'acceptation et les spécifications fonctionnelles en collaboration avec les équipes de développement.
* Prioriser le backlog en s'appuyant sur les données, les retours clients et les objectifs stratégiques, et non uniquement sur les urgences.
* Participer aux cérémonies Agile (Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Rétrospective) et veiller à ce que les fonctionnalités livrées répondent bien aux objectifs produit.
* Coordonner les travaux avec l'équipe produit PAM sur les sujets transverses, notamment autour du WALLIX One Console et du modèle d'identité unifié.

Support au Go-to-Market :

* Contribuer à la création des supports internes :
* fiches produits ;
* battle cards concurrentielles ;
* scripts de démonstration.
* Accompagner les équipes avant-vente sur certains cas d'usage clients, notamment autour :
* des scénarios de déploiement d'IDaaS (Identity Provider principal, broker d'identité ou couche MFA) ;
* des workflows de gouvernance IAG.
* Participer au suivi des indicateurs d'adoption et des usages après les mises en production afin d'alimenter les évolutions futures.


  
  
Profil recherché :
  
  
Formation :

* Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau BAC+4/BAC+5 dans l'un des domaines suivants :
* informatique ;
* cybersécurité ;
* management de produits numériques ;
* école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation produit ou technologies.
* Vous recherchez un contrat d'alternance de 12 À 24 MOIS, à partir de SEPTEMBRE 2026.

Compétences & qualités :
