jobs.title: Rukakeskus Oy, Palvelupäällikkö uuteen elämyspalveluyksikköön
jobs.description:
**Haemme nyt Rukalle elämyspalveluiden palvelupäällikköä**

**Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa uutta elämyspalveluliiketoimintaa Rukatunturilla?**

Etsimme elämyspalveluiden palvelupäällikköä vastaamaan elämyspalveluidemme operatiivisesta toiminnasta, henkilöstöstä, turvallisuudesta sekä palveluiden ympärivuotisesta kehittämisestä. Tehtävässä pääset rakentamaan toimintaa yhdessä elämyspalveluiden ja hiihtokoulutoiminnan tiimin kanssa ja vaikuttamaan merkittävästi siihen, millaiseksi elämyspalvelukokonaisuutemme tulevaisuudessa muodostuu. Palvelupäällikkönä toimit keskeisessä roolissa varmistamassa, että asiakkaamme saavat turvallisia, laadukkaita ja mieleenpainuvia elämyksiä ympäri vuoden. Ensimmäisellä kaudella operoimme sähkökelkkasafareita, lumikenkä- ja pilkkiretkiä, revontuliretkiä ja sähköfatbike retkiä hiihtokoulun elämysten rinnalla. Yhdessä kehitämme elämyksiä, palveluita ja tuotteita asiakkaiden toiveiden ja palautteen pohjalta.

**Tehtäväsi**

Palvelupäällikkönä vastaat elämyspalveluiden päivittäisestä operatiivisesta toiminnasta sekä palveluiden kehittämisestä yhteistyössä muun organisaation kanssa.

**Keskeisiin tehtäviisi kuuluvat**

- Elämyspalveluiden päivittäisen operatiivisen toiminnan johtaminen ja sujuvuuden varmistaminen resurssien, kapasiteetin ja aikataulujen tehokkaalla organisoinnilla.

- Varmistat varaustietojen oikeellisuuden eri järjestelmissä ja ylläpidät varausjärjestelmien tuote-, hinta- ja kapasiteettitietoja.

- Esihenkilötyö ja työvuorosuunnittelu. Rakennat motivoitunutta, sitoutunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä työyhteisöä.

- Asiakaskokemuksen ja laadun varmistaminen myös sesonkien vilkkaimpina hetkinä

- Elämystuotteiden ja -palveluiden kehittäminen

- Elämyspalveluiden turvallisuuden johtaminen

- Yhteistyö muiden yksiköiden ja kumppaneiden kanssa


**Odotamme sinulta**

- Kokemusta matkailu-, ohjelmapalvelu- tai elämyspalveluliiketoiminnasta

- Esihenkilökokemusta, kykyä johtaa ja kannustaa henkilöstöä sesonkiympäristössä.

- Kokemusta palveluiden kehittämisestä ja tuotteistamisesta.

- Hyviä organisointi- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja.

- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.

- Kykyä toimia muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä sekä kehittää uusia toimintamalleja.

- Taitoja omaksua uusia digitaalisia järjestelmiä, ja sinulla on kokemusta varaus-, työvuorosuunnittelu- tai toiminnanohjausjärjestelmien käytöstä.

- Hyviä yhteistyö- ja suhdetoimintataitoja.

- B-ajokorttia


**Arvostamme lisäksi**

- Kokemusta kansainvälisestä toimintaympäristöstä

- Rukan aluetuntemusta

- Elämyspalveluiden ohjausosaamista tai kiinnostusta kouluttautua uusiin lajeihin ja ohjelmapalveluihin osana ympärivuotista toimintaa

- Halua osallistua myös käytännön ohjaus- ja opastustehtäviin silloin, kun se tukee asiakaskokemusta ja toiminnan sujuvuutta

- Joustavuutta kausiluonteisessa ja vaihtelevassa työympäristössä

- Kaupallista ajattelutapaa ja ymmärrystä kapasiteetin sekä resurssien tehokkaasta hyödyntämisestä


**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän matkailualan ytimessä, jossa voit kehittää myös omaa osaamistasi

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa palveluiden, toimintatapojen ja organisaation kehittämiseen.

- Ammattitaitoisen ja innostuneen työyhteisön ja tuen työssä menestymiseen

- Hyvät harrastusmahdollisuudet ja henkilöstöedut etenkin rinnelajien ja liikkumisen parissa


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä hakemuksesi, CV:si ja palkkatoiveesi meille viimeistään 10.8.2026.

Työsuhde on **vakituinen ja kokoaikainen** ja alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, kuitenkin viimeistään lokakuun alussa 2026. Työ edellyttää paikan päällä työskentelyä Rukalla. Käytössämme on Hiihtokeskus TES ja palkkaus.

Suosittelemme jättämään hakemuksen mahdollisimman pian, sillä haastattelemme hakijoita myös ennen hakuajan päättymistä.

Lisätietoja antaa Hanna Tauriainen, hanna.tauriainen@ruka.fi

jobs.title: Rukakeskus Oy, Palvelupäällikkö Rukan Hiihtokoulu
jobs.description:
Etsimme Rukalle hiihtokoulun palvelupäällikköä, johtamaan ja kehittämään hiihtokoulutoimintaamme osana kasvavaa rinne- ja elämyspalvelukokonaisuutta.

Hiihtokoulullamme on vahvat perinteet, ja nyt rakennamme sen seuraavaa vaihetta osana ympärivuotista rinne- ja elämyspalvelukokonaisuutta. Haluamme kehittää toimintaamme vastaamaan kasvavan liiketoiminnan tarpeita, sujuvoittaa arkea ja rakentaa hiihtokoulusta entistä elämyksellisemmän palvelukokonaisuuden niin kansainvälisille kuin kotimaisille vieraillemme. Samalla vahvistamme ympärivuotista toimintaa kehittämällä uusia kesäelämyksiä, jotka tuovat esiin alueemme ainutlaatuisen luonnon, tunturiympäristön ja bike parkin monipuoliset mahdollisuudet.

Palvelupäällikkönä johdat hiihtokoulun päivittäistä toimintaa ja kehität sitä pitkäjänteisesti yhdessä henkilöstön, rinnetoiminnan ja elämyspalveluiden kanssa. Rakennat ja ylläpidät toimintamalleja, jotka tukevat sujuvaa arkea, selkeitä vastuita sekä laadukasta asiakas- ja henkilöstökokemusta osana koko hiihtokeskuksen palvelukokonaisuutta.

Palvelupäällikön tehtävässä:

- Toimit hiihtokoulun esihenkilönä ja johdat hiihtokoulun päivittäistä toimintaa ja varmistat sen sujuvuuden. Suunnittelet myös työvuoroja.

- Hiihtokoulun päivittäisen operatiivisen toiminnan johtaminen ja sujuvuuden varmistaminen resurssien, kapasiteetin ja aikataulujen tehokkaalla organisoinnilla.

- Huolehdit toiminnan laadusta myös sesonkien vilkkaimpina hetkinä.

- Tunnistat kehityskohteita ja viet muutokset käytäntöön.

- Rakennat motivoitunutta, sitoutunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä työyhteisöä.

- Osallistat henkilöstöä aktiivisesti toiminnan kehittämiseen.

- Varmistat laadukkaan, tasalaatuisen ja elämyksellisen hiihdonopetuksen.

- Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä ja kehität palveluita yhdessä rinne-, myynti- ja elämyspalvelutiimien kanssa.

- Rakennat hiihtokoulusta vahvan osan koko hiihtokeskuksen palvelukokonaisuutta.


Etsimme sinua, joka

- olet hankkinut kokemusta operatiivisesta esihenkilötyöstä tai palveluliiketoiminnan johtamisesta. Kokemus hiihtokoulutoiminnasta ja hiihdonopetuksesta katsotaan eduksi.

- kehität toimintaa käytännönläheisesti ja viet muutokset onnistuneesti osaksi arkea.

- johdat ihmisiä valmentavalla, osallistavalla ja tavoitteellisella otteella.

- osaat organisoida toimintaa, priorisoida tekemistä ja pitää kokonaisuuden hallinnassa myös kiireisimpinä sesonkeina.

- ymmärrät asiakaskokemuksen merkityksen palveluliiketoiminnassa

- toimit luontevasti yhteistyössä eri tiimien ja sidosryhmien kanssa.

- omaa kokemusta työvuorosuunnittelusta ja palvelualojen työehtosopimus on sinulle tuttu (hiihtokeskus TES tuntemus katsotaan eduksi).

- omaksut nopeasti uusia digitaalisia järjestelmiä, ja sinulla on kokemusta varaus-, työvuorosuunnittelu- tai toiminnanohjausjärjestelmien käytöstä.

- kommunikoit sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.


Arvostamme lisäksi:

- hiihdonopettajan koulutusta tai muuta lumilajien ohjausosaamista ja kiinnostusta kouluttautua uusiin lajeihin ja ohjelmapalveluihin osana ympärivuotista toimintaa.

- halua osallistua myös käytännön ohjaustehtäviin silloin, kun se tukee asiakaskokemusta ja toiminnan sujuvuutta.

- kiinnostusta ympärivuotisten palveluiden ja uusien elämysten kehittämiseen

- kaupallista ajattelutapaa ja ymmärrystä kapasiteetin sekä resurssien tehokkaasta hyödyntämisestä


Tarjoamme sinulle

- mahdollisuuden kehittää hiihtokoulua osana kasvavaa ympärivuotista rinne- ja elämyspalvelukokonaisuutta sekä olla rakentamassa uudenlaisia palveluita kotimaisille ja kansainvälisille vieraille.

- monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän Rukan matkailualueen ytimessä, jossa voit kehittää myös omaa osaamistasi

- ammattitaitoisen ja innostuneen työyhteisön ja tuen työssä menestymiseen

- upeat harrastusmahdollisuudet ja henkilöstöedut etenkin rinnelajien ja liikkumisen parissa


Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi, CV:si ja palkkatoiveesi meille viimeistään 10.8.2026.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen ja alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, kuitenkin viimeistään syyskuussa 2026. Työ edellyttää paikan päällä työskentelyä Rukalla. Käytössämme on Hiihtokeskus TES ja palkkaus.

Suosittelemme jättämään hakemuksen mahdollisimman pian, sillä haastattelemme hakijoita myös ennen hakuajan päättymistä ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja antaa Hanna Tauriainen, hanna.tauriainen@ruka.fi

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description:
ETSIMME LAHDEN ALUEELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOON OSA-AIKAISEEN TYÖHÖN

MITÄ KOTIHOIDON TYÖ SISÄLTÄÄ?

Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Perushoito ja asiakkaan päivittäinen avustaminen

* Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti)

* Terveyden kokonaisvaltainen seuranta ja mittaukset

* Asiakkaan toimintakyvyn ja hyvinvoinnin tukeminen

Kotihoidossa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, jolla on todellista merkitystä asiakkaiden arjessa. Työ sopii myös opiskelijalle.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE?

* Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää laajasti omaa osaamistasi

* Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tueksesi

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi! Haastattelemme jo hakuajan aikana. Nähdään Alinassa!

----------------------------------------

Haluatko tietää lisää meistä? Löydät lisätietoa verkkosivuiltamme [https://alinahoivatiimi.fi/].

Alina on valtakunnallinen ketju, joka työllistää jo 350 alan ammattilaista. Paikallisia Alina-yrityksiä on jo yli 40 eri puolilla Suomea. Työtyytyväisyytemme sai arvosanaksi 4,39/5 vuonna 2025.

Alina on osa Norlandiaa [https://norlandiacare.fi/], joka tarjoaa innovatiivisia ja monipuolisia hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluita kaikille vauvasta vaariin sekä nelijalkaisille ystävillemme. Suomessa Norlandian toimintoihin kuuluvat hoivakodit YHDESSÄ palvelukortteleissa, Tampereella sijaitseva potilashotelli, Norlandia Päiväkodit ja Aberia.

jobs.title: Vuoropäällikkö, Lapinmaan ravintolat

jobs.title: Åpen søknad:  2 Selgere søkes til [50%]
jobs.description:
Vi søker to selgere som trives i kontakten med kundene, bak kassa, elsker å selge mat og drikke til travle kunder, og som ønsker å bidra til et entusiastisk og godt arbeidsmiljø.

Som selger i Narvesen vil du få varierte arbeidsoppgaver, en hektisk hverdag og gode kolleger som fort kan bli venner for livet. Hvis du har et lite konkurranseinnstinkt, tipper vi at du vil ha det gøy med alle salgskonkurransene vi kjører!

Hvem er du?
Kanskje du har butikkerfaring, eller du er klar for din første jobb i butikk? Uansett kan du være den riktige for jobben, så lenge du er

  • effektiv. Du takler stress godt, og liker høyt tempo
  • selvstendig. Du trives med å ha ansvar, og finner lett egne løsninger
  • glad i mennesker. Du får påfyll i møte med kundene, og bryr deg om hver eneste en
  • et ordensmenneske. Du liker å ha det rent og ryddig rundt deg
  • positiv. Du er en humørspreder – blant kolleger så vel som kunder

Hvorfor Narvesen?
Som en del av REITAN CONVENIENCE, har vi alltid vært opptatt av å bygge en vennlig kultur. Ditt gode humør smitter over på kundene, og vi vet at når de er glade og fornøyde vender de også tilbake. Ja, Narvesen stiller krav til deg som selger, men vi vil også at du skal ha høye forventninger til oss.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!


Narvesen er den originale kiosken i Norge. Vi har vært en del av hverdagen til det norske folk siden 1894. I dag er vi en fleksibel, smidig og fremoverlent convenience-kjede som leder utviklingen fremover med stadig nye tanker, ideer og løsninger. Vi er der for dem som raskt og enkelt ønsker å forenkle hverdagen på en måte som gir god samvittighet. Våre kunder er på farten, og vi skal hjelpe dem med påfyll i en ellers så travel hverdag. Narvesen er en del av Reitan Convenience Norway.

jobs.title: Kombinert Utleierepresentant (deltid)
jobs.description:
Arbeidssted: Sola lufthavn

Arbeidstid: Rullerende vaktplan (dag, kveld og helg)

Oppstart: Så snart som mulig - intervjuer kjøres forløpende

Stillingsprosent: 40 - 60 prosent

Stillingsprosent kan tilpasses den rette kandidaten.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du ansvarlig for å levere våre tjenester på en best mulig måte til våre kunder. Hverdagen består av utstrakt kundekontakt både ansikt til ansikt og pr. telefon og mail. Vi leverer en service hvor kundens behov alltid er i fokus. Videre er du også ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til vår standard. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av servicer og dekkomlegg. Logistikk, klargjøring, salg og kundeservice er kjernen i hverdagen. 

  • Klargjøring av utleiebiler (vask mm)

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus og dekklager

  • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner 

  • Presentasjon og innsalg av våre produkter til kunde på en best mulig måte

  • Håndtere telefon og epost henvendelser 

  • Organisere daglige reservasjoner i forhold til tilgjengelig flåte

  • Rapportering og annet forefallende kontorarbeid

Kvalifikasjoner

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du den våre kunder møter hver dag. Du representerer Sixt Bilutleie og er genuint opptatt av service og trives med kundekontakt. Vi stiller høye krav til våre produkter og hvordan vi presenterer disse, med ett ønske om å overgå kundens forventinger. Du har også ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer. Hverdagen styres av kundens behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. Ved å levere en premium opplevelse, er du med å bygger Norges beste bilutleiekjede.    

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (Politiattest)

  • Genuin serviceinnstilling og gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter

  • Gode salgs ferdigheter

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor arbeidskapasitet (også ved fysisk arbeid)

  • Strukturert og evne til å styre logistikk i en stadig skiftende/hektisk hverdag

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: Chef, seasons 2026-2027, Northern Finland, Lapland Hotels
jobs.description:
Are you ready for a winter youll never forget? Imagine working above the Arctic Circle, surrounded by pure nature, snow-covered forests, and the calm of Lapland. Your days are spent creating high-quality food, and your free-time could mean chasing the Northern Lights, visit Santa Claus, skiing, or relaxing in a traditional sauna.

StaffPoint is currently seeking passionate CHEFS to well-known Lapland Hotels-chains hotels and ski centers around Lapland. The role involves supporting the Chef de Partie, Sous-Chef or Chef de Cuisine with daily food preparation to meet the set standards and quality levels of our client, the Lapland Hotels-chain in northern Finland.

Choose your season in Lapland:

- Join us for a short, intensive Christmas season

- Or commit to the full winter season 2026–2027 (approximately November–April)

You can work with us in the following locations in Lapland: Kilpisjärvi, Luosto, Rovaniemi, Pallas, Ylläs, Levi, Hetta, Saariselkä or Olos.

What we offer:

- The possibility of accommodation through Lapland Hotels

- Staffpoint and Lapland Hotels personnel benefits

- A lively and international work environment

- Many winter leisure opportunities in beautiful Lapland

- A memorable season that stands out on your CV

What we require:

- EU citizenship/passport or a valid working permit for Finland

**_Granlund_** _is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our more than 1,600 professionals serve across 30 locations throughout Finland._

**Would you be our new Project Planner?**

As a Project Planner at Granlund, you will take responsibility for project schedules and project controls in complex construction, data center, and industrial projects. Acting as the Project Managers right hand, you will play a central role in supporting project leadership, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring that projects progress according to plan throughout their lifecycle.

You will work closely with Project Managers, Project Engineers, clients, designers, contractors, and other key stakeholders. Your responsibilities include developing and maintaining project schedules, supporting decision-making through project data and reporting, and ensuring that information flows effectively between different parties. Within projects, you will also guide the work of project engineers and help keep project teams aligned around common goals and timelines.

The role combines project planning, coordination, and leadership. Depending on the project portfolio, you may be responsible for one major project or several smaller projects simultaneously. Projects range from commercial developments to large-scale data center projects, with durations varying from a few months to several years.

The position is a full-time and permanent role, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The role offers a highly flexible working model with the possibility to work remotely from anywhere in Finland. You may also work from any Granlund office according to your own preference. Occasional travel to project sites, typically around once per month, is expected as part of the role.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for a construction professional with a strong understanding of how projects move from planning to execution. You have experience in project management, project planning, site management or another project-oriented role within the construction industry. Most importantly, you understand how construction projects are delivered and how different stakeholders, phases, and dependencies come together throughout the project lifecycle.

A relevant educational background in construction or engineering is preferred. You may hold a degree as a Construction Engineer, Bachelor of Engineering or Master of Science in Engineering. You communicate fluently in Finnish and have a good working knowledge of English.

As a person, you are honest, collaborative, and proactive. You are able to communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels and are comfortable taking ownership of your work. You combine a humble attitude with a structured and solution-oriented approach and enjoy working as part of a professional team where knowledge is shared and success is achieved together.

**Why join us?**

At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. You will contribute to demanding and large-scale projects such as data centers and industrial environments, where your work truly matters. As one of the leading data center design and consulting companies in the Nordics, we offer long-term career opportunities in a rapidly growing field, where projects are becoming increasingly significant in scale and impact. You will have strong opportunities to grow and develop your expertise, with career paths that can be shaped around your strengths and interests.

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Luxembourg Learning Centre (LLC), the University's main library, supports students, researchers, staff and the wider public by providing documentary collections, information services and expertise that contribute to learning, teaching, and research.

Your role
The role will focus on ensuring continuity of services, maintaining collection quality and supporting ongoing academic needs.
• Act as a key contact / interface between the libraries and University stakeholders, including faculty, researchers, students and administrative departments, in particular within the Faculty of Law, Economics & Finance (FDEF)
• Take ownership of collection plans and budgets for the relevant subject areas,  ensuring expertise and added value to faculty
• Contribute actively to the preparation, update and implementation of collection development strategies, acquisition plans and related documentation, and contribute to defining and adapting practices, tools and approaches based on needs
• Provide expert advice, research support and information literacy training tailored to the needs of students, researchers and teaching staff, and act as a sparring partner for academic users
• Reply to enquiries and support users in identifying, accessing and using relevant documentary resources, databases and information tools, providing added value guidance and expert advice where needed

• Monitor trends in teaching, learning and research in the relevant disciplines in order to keep collections and services up to date, analyse needs and propose improvements and adapted approaches
• Maintain regular interaction with academic stakeholders to identify evolving curriculum needs, new programmes, research priorities and resource requirements, and translate these into concrete collection and service developments
• Promote the libraries' collections, resources and services through targeted communication, outreach, training and advocacy activities that emphasise added value to faculty and researchers
• Analyse usage data and user feedback to support evidence based decisions, prioritise activities based on needs and timeframe, and drive continuous improvement of collections and services
• Contribute to shaping and improving practices for cataloguing, classification, signage, collection maintenance and the organisation of documentary resources according to applicable standards

Your profile
• Master's degree or equivalent by work experience in Library, Information or Documentation Science; or a Master's degree in a relevant discipline complemented by training or experience in information management
• At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in an academic or research library

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities

jobs.title: OpEx Leader - Luxembourg Site (m/f)

Description:

Job Description

At DuPont, we are redefining what operational excellence looks like in advanced manufacturing. We are seeking an experienced Operational Excellence (OpEx)
Leader to help accelerate the performance, digital transformation, and long-term competitiveness of our Luxembourg Site, supporting world-class businesses including Tyvek®, Typar®, Power & Utilities, and Shared Services.
This is a highly visible leadership role where you will partner with site leaders, engineers, operators, and functional teams to turn strategy into execution, build continuous improvement capability, and deliver measurable business results. You will champion the DuPont Business System, coach teams in structured problem solving, and drive a culture where performance is transparent, problems are solved at the source, and improvement is part of everyday work.
If you are passionate about Lean transformation, digital innovation, operational performance, and developing people, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact at one of DuPont's key manufacturing sites.

What You'll Do

Lead the Operational Excellence Journey

• Drive the deployment and sustainability of DuPont's OpEx Management System across the Luxembourg Site.
• Coach leaders and teams on Daily Visual Management, Operating Reviews, tiered accountability, performance management, and continuous improvement best practices.
• Establish meaningful SQDIP performance metrics that enable teams to identify gaps quickly and focus on what matters most.
• Shape and manage the site's OpEx roadmap, ensuring improvement efforts are aligned with business priorities and strategic objectives.
• Develop OpEx capabilities through coaching, mentoring, practical training, and hands-on leadership.

Champion Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving

• Lead structured problem-solving initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, A3 Thinking, PDCA, 5 Whys, Pareto analysis, and root-cause methodologies.
• Facilitate Kaizen events and improvement workshops that deliver sustainable operational results.
• Help drive key site priorities, including productivity, reliability, manufacturing efficiency, quality performance, waste reduction, yield improvement, and cost competitiveness.
• Coach teams to solve problems at the process level and create lasting solutions, not temporary fixes.

Accelerate Digital Transformation

• Partner with Operations, Engineering, IT, and functional teams to implement digital solutions that simplify work, improve decision-making, and enhance operational visibility.
• Support the adoption of technologies and systems including Power BI, PowerApps, SAP, IP21, digital dashboards, and automation tools.
• Ensure digital capabilities become an integral part of daily management and business performance reviews.

Deliver Measurable Business Results

• Provide governance and oversight for the site's continuous improvement portfolio.
• Track project execution, financial benefits, risk management, and value realization.
• Drive improvements that positively impact safety, quality, delivery, inventory, productivity, cost efficiency, energy usage, compliance, and overall site competitiveness.
• Establish robust sustainment mechanisms that ensure improvements continue long after implementation.

Foster Innovation & Collaboration

• Promote innovative thinking, automation, AI-enabled problem solving, and modern manufacturing practices.
• Connect Luxembourg teams with global DuPont networks, communities of practice, and best-in-class operational excellence resources.
• Help build a culture where every employee is empowered to identify opportunities, solve problems, and contribute to continuous improvement.

What You'll Bring

Education & Technical Expertise

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Operations Management, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
• Fluency in English and German.
• Strong understanding of operational performance management and continuous improvement systems.

jobs.title: Data Labeling Specialists
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Workada creates high-quality labeled data for advanced technology systems. Our team reviews, organizes, categorizes, evaluates, and quality-checks digital content so those systems can better understand information and perform real-world tasks.
We believe careful data work matters. Every reviewed item, categorized example, and quality-checked task helps improve how technology interprets information, follows instructions, and responds in practical settings.

About You

We're hiring detail-oriented individuals who are comfortable working on a computer and interested in careful, focused digital work. We're especially interested in:

  • People who can carefully review written information, images, documents, or other digital content
  • Strong readers and writers with good judgment
  • People who can follow detailed instructions consistently
  • Individuals who are comfortable using web-based tools and online platforms
  • People who take quality seriously and can spot mistakes or inconsistencies
  • Those who enjoy focused, independent work while contributing to a larger project
  • Strong character matters — we value integrity, reliability, curiosity, and a commitment to high-quality work



Qualifications

  • Comfortable using a computer for extended periods
  • Reliable internet connection
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to follow written guidelines and project instructions
  • Clear written communication skills
  • Basic familiarity with spreadsheets, online forms, or web-based work tools
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
  • Prior experience in data labeling, annotation, quality review, research, writing, customer support, operations, or administrative work is helpful but not required



Compensation

Compensation is $18- $22 an hour and a max of 40 hours a week.

A Place to Do Meaningful Work

Data labeling may sound simple, but it plays an important role in improving the technology people use every day. At Workada, your work helps create the examples and feedback that make advanced systems more accurate, consistent, and useful.

We're looking for people who care about accuracy, consistency, and careful judgment. Whether you're reviewing text, categorizing information, evaluating responses, or checking data quality, your work helps improve the way technology performs.

jobs.description:
**Monipuolinen liikunta- ja hyvinvointialan osaaja MTC:lle, Tampere (Lielahti)**

Etsimme MTC:lle osaajaa, joka yhdistää **hierojan koulutuksen** ja **ryhmäliikuntatuntien ohjaamisen** (esim. pump, RPV, kehonhuolto, toiminnalliset tunnit). Tämän kombon lisäksi arvostamme, jos sinulla on myös valmiuksia yksilövalmennuksiin (PT) ja halua osallistua salin asiakaspalvelun työtehtäviin.

Valmennuskeskus MTC on matalan kynnyksen liikuntakeskus Lielahdessa, Tampereella. Meillä on lämminhenkinen ja yhteisöllinen meininki – asiakkaamme viihtyvät luonamme ja moni tulee paikalle myös jutustelemaan, ei vain treenaamaan. Suurin osa asiakkaistamme on keski-ikäisiä ja eläkeikää lähestyviä naisia, joille tärkeintä on arjen toimintakyky ja hyvä olo – meillä ei siis lasketa kaloreita eikä juosta maratoneja, vaan keskitytään kokonaisvaltaiseen hyvinvointiin ja mukavaan fiilikseen.

Työpäivä voi koostua esimerkiksi hieronta-asiakkaista, parista tunnista asiakaspalvelua ja ryhmäliikuntatunnin ohjaamisesta, etsitään juuri se yhdistelmä, joka sopii sinulle parhaiten. Saat itse vaikuttaa vahvasti omaan aikatauluusi. Ryhmätuntien ohjaus on painottunut iltapäiviin ja iltoihin , mutta tarjolla on myös aamupäivä tunteja.

**Työn alkaminen:** Työ alkaa joustavasti syksyn aikana, sopimuksen mukaan

**Työn muoto:** Alkuvaiheessa työtä tehdään yrittäjänä tai kevytyrittäjänä laskuttaen. Myöhemmin katsotaan tilanteen ja yhteistyön sujumisen mukaan, löytyisikö muita sopivia tapoja järjestää työsuhde.

Jos olet koulutettu hieroja, joka osaa myös innostaa ryhmää liikkumaan, ja haluat olla osa lämminhenkistä ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä – ota yhteyttä ja kerro itsestäsi!

jobs.title: Butikschef
jobs.description:
Få nye udfordringer i en nystartet virksomhed med et stærkt fællesskab.

Vil du være en del af et nyt brand i Danmark – så søg ind til os i Hus og Hjem.

Vi har fællesskab og samarbejde som kerneværdier, da vi tror på, at godt arbejdsmiljø og glade kollegaer er med til at skabe en god kundeoplevelse.

Lyder det som noget for dig:

Du bliver en del af et stærkt team, hvor du vil komme til at spille en afgørende rolle i teamet. For at blive vores nye kollega skal du være god til at samarbejde, men også kunne tænke og arbejde selvstændigt samt tage ansvar. Du er resultatorienteret, serviceminded, har situationsfornemmelse og sans for god kundebetjening. Du formår at engagere dig og gå foran som det gode eksempel, er fleksibel og har en positiv indstilling til nye udfordringer, til kunderne og til kollegerne.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. bestå i sikre en altid indbydende og salgsklar butik med en høj standard.

Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling, og der vil være aften- og weekendarbejde.

Få en spændende og afvekslende hverdag med fuld fart på samt mulighed for gode og fleksible arbejdsforhold og løn efter kvalifikationer.

Kan du se dig selv i:

Du er medansvarlig for butikkens udvikling. Du sikrer, at der altid er den rette bemanding, og butikken løbende udvikles til at nå dens fulde potientiale.

Du er en yderst fleksibel og stabil medarbejder. Du ved, at du i en butik kan blive afbrudt, og arbejdsopgaverne kan ændre sig i løbet af dagen, samt at vi alle er afhængige af hinanden for at få butikken til at spille.

Du er ambitiøs. Du har lyst til at dygtiggøre dig, og lyst til at gøre dit bedste for at skabe et godt resultat. Derudover går du foran som det gode eksempel.

Du er imødekommende. Du ønsker at få andre til at føle sig godt tilpas i dit selskab, da du ved, at det er starten på god kollegaservice og en god kundeservice.

Du er en god kollega. Du ved, hvor vigtigt det er at være omgivet af gode kollegaer. Både socialt og fagligt. Du ønsker at hjælpe og støtte dine kollegaer, samt skabe god energi.

Du nyder at have direkte kundekontakt. Du formår at skabe tillid og forstå kunden. Du brænder for at give kunden en troværdig og god oplevelse. Sammen med dine dygtige kollegaer sørger du for, at kunden kommer igen.

Da vores koncept stammer fra Italien er det en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med import fra EU og udenfor EU.

Hvis jobbet som noget for dig, så skynd dig at sende din ansøgning, da vi holder samtaler løbende. Stillingen forventes besat 1. oktober 2026 eller hurtigst muligt.

Yderligere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse til os i Hus og Hjem på vores mail.

jobs.title: Senior engineer / lead engineer - software platform m/f for bangalore (h/f)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Electronics & Defense est une entreprise internationale de plus de 19 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, qui mobilisent expertises et esprit de corps pour concevoir des solutions de haute technologie dans les domaines de l'aéronautique, de la défense et du spatial. En combinant intelligence humaine et technologique, l'entreprise développe des produits et services pour les acteurs du monde civil et militaires, sur terre, en mer, dans le ciel et dans l'espace.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionThe Software Platform Senior Engineer / Lead Engineer, will be responsible for supporting a strong team of engineers working on hi-tech embedded applicative software in a provided project perimeter.



You will be part of Software Engineering Department which has multidisciplinary teams across multiple Safran sites working together to provide innovative, future products of high technological value in aeronautical, land and maritime industries.



You will work in close collaboration with the Reseach&Development headquarters of Safran Electronics and Defense in France. In the short term, you will join a task force dedicated to Low Level Testing.



You will have the responsibility of the Low Level Testing activities, by supporting your team directly. In this context you will be reporting directly to the Technical Manager and operationally to the Tech Lead.

Working with others, you shall responsible for:

- ensuring the highest level of quality for Team deliverables in compliance with DO-178C;

- providing help to the Team software engineers when stuck;

- handling the more complex pieces of software via Architecture/Integration/Development;

- challenge choices from the Management from a Technical standpoint by raising awareness on technical risks on challenging topics;

- train upcoming new engineers with knowledge learned from the Technical Management.



About Safran Electronics & Defence

Safran Electronics & Defence is an international company with over 14,000 employees mobilizing their expertise and team spirit to design high-tech solutions in aerospace, defence and space industries. By combining human and technological intelligence, the company develops products and services to help civilian and military players observe, decide and guide on land, at sea, in the sky and space thus contributing to safer world.

Safran Electronics & Defence's centre in Bengaluru is an upcoming centre of excellence to established to provide R&D and Engineering solutions to local (Make-in-India) as well as global requirements of the company.



Welcome to Safran, powering the aeronautical industry with trust.

Reference of excellence, open to the world, and part of the main characters of innovation, we share a common vision of a future for aviation.

Joining us is becoming part of the most challenging projects carried out in the field: propelling from the most pioneering Air Taxis startups to the legacy flagships counting HAL.

At Safran, we value long-term commitment from our collaborators, and promote an environment of trust at all levels, by empowerment.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager (m/f/d) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Become Senior Account Manager (m/f/d) at Retarus.

Retarus is a worldwide provider of cloud-based messaging solutions at enterprise scale. We serve over 40% of the companies listed on the S&P Global 100, e.g. Adidas, Bayer, SAP, BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs, T-Systems, Swarovski & UPS, as well as governmental agencies and major players in markets across the world. Privately owned and founder-managed for over thirty years, Retarus is customer-oriented, stable, a fair employer, and a strategic business partner with a long-term vision. With some 500 employees in 19 offices on four continents, Retarus operates locally and thinks globally: our teams are organized across borders and are highly integrated. This makes Retarus a multicultural, multilingual, and engaging workplace. We are committed to creating a diverse and dynamic environment for our employees, with generous compensation, time off, and a global, collaborative workplace.

What we offer

- Mobile working and flexible working time
- Collaborative, diverse company culture and superior team spirit
- Flat hierarchies and great feedback culture
- Development opportunities & career perspective
- International business & cross-site collaboration
- Modern, dog-friendly offices with nice amenities
- Company-paid health insurance, public transportation, lunch vouchers and further benefits

What you'll do

- Own the full new-business sales cycle end to end: prospecting (direct outreach, events, and partner channels), opportunity management, negotiation, and closing.
- Build a qualified pipeline from scratch and convert it into new customers in the Spanish market.
- Sell software solutions to mid-market and enterprise customers with medium-length sales cycles (typically 6–12 months, sometimes longer).
- Work closely with the pre-sales team, who will support you during technical discussions and solution design.
- Develop market presence, especially in underdeveloped verticals such as transportation, logistics, and tourism.
- Work with clear, realistic targets and maintain structured reporting and close collaboration with the wider team.

What you'll need

- A completed commercial apprenticeship or a degree in economics, sales, or a related field; motivated career changers with a strong drive for sales are also welcome.
- Several years of proven experience in new customer acquisition, ideally in a B2B or SaaS environment, allowing you to work autonomously and create impact quickly.
- Demonstrated hunter mentality with a clear focus on new business development and new customer acquisition.
- Resilience and persistence when facing initial market resistance and managing longer sales cycles.
- A collaborative, dependable working style that contributes to strong team fit and sustainable cooperation.
- A serious, credible, and professional sales approach, focused on substance rather than hype.
- Solid understanding of the Spanish market and its business landscape.
- Professional fluency in both English and Spanish.

What you can expect

At Retarus, you will work on impactful and dynamic projects, with real opportunities to make a difference. Our customers are leaders across diverse industries, with constantly evolving needs and high expectations. You’ll be working with cutting-edge technology and great creative leeway to meet customers’ needs – and the projects you work on will be deployed globally. Working at Retarus, you will collaborate closely with convivial, culturally diverse teammates. You will grow professionally in a dynamic and exciting workplace and design impactful solutions in real time with top companies.

Come as you are. Retarus is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex,

jobs.title: Embedded Software & Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
Work tasks: Key responsibilities
Firmware and embedded software development: - Develop and maintain embedded software and firmware primarily in Rust. - Use C where relevant for embedded and low-level development. - Develop for bare-metal RISC-V and embedded Linux on ARM environments. - Implement reliable software for resource-constrained embedded systems. - Investigate and resolve software, firmware and system-level issues. Hardware integration and verification: - Integrate firmware with electronics, hardware and communication interfaces. - Test, debug and validate software on target hardware. - Support hardware–software integration and system-level testing. - Contribute to verification activities and resolve integration issues. Engineering collaboration and documentation: - Work closely with electronics, optics and systems engineers. - Participate in code reviews and technical discussions. - Create and maintain clear technical documentation. - Help improve software development, testing and documentation practices. - Take increasing ownership of technical tasks as your understanding of our systems develops.

We offer: What we offer:
- A hands-on engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication technologies. - Meaningful technical ownership and the opportunity to see your work move from implementation to hardware integration and validation. - Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team. - The opportunity to develop your expertise across embedded software, electronics, optics and aerospace systems. - The ability to contribute to technical decisions and engineering practices as the company grows. - A gross annual base salary of €35,000–€57,000, depending on experience, skills and the expected level of responsibility. - Relocation support to Estonia if required. - Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs. Working arrangement: This is a primarily onsite position in Tallinn, Estonia, as the role involves close collaboration with hardware, integration and testing. Limited hybrid work may be agreed depending on the employee’s responsibilities and the stage of the work. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager. Other important information: This position may require the selected candidate to be eligible to obtain government security clearance. At Golbriak Space, we use our passion for purposeful innovation to help keep people safe and solve complex engineering challenges. We foster an inclusive environment built on integrity, responsibility and employee empowerment.

Option to work from home: No

Head of Treasury
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategically minded Head of Treasury to join our global Energy Storage Business organisation in a rapidly growing renewable energy market.


This is a unique opportunity to establish and lead the treasury function of a newly carved-out business, taking full ownership of building treasury operations from the ground up. As the ideal candidate you will have direct experience of this process.

You will set up banking structures, develop treasury processes, manage liquidity routines and ensure a seamless transition into an independently operating group of companies. Success in this role requires solid expertise in cash and liquidity management, financial risk management, hedging and bank relationship management.

You should also be comfortable navigating compliance, internal controls and treasury-related reporting requirements within a global corporate environment. This role will be a hands-on position where a self-driven person will thrive. Your work will be essential in safeguarding financial integrity, supporting the business with reliable treasury insights and enabling future growth.

As a key member of the global finance team, you will manage both local and international treasury needs, collaborate closely with banks, auditors, and internal stakeholders and drive continuous improvements across all treasury processes.

The ideal location for this position is Helsinki, Finland, however we would consider suitably qualified individuals based in Vaasa or Turku.

Key Responsibilities

Cash & Liquidity Management


* Ensure the company maintains adequate liquidity to support global operations and strategic initiatives.
* Manage global cash pooling structures, daily cash positioning, and short- to long-term cash flow forecasts.
* Optimise cash deployment and internal funding between group entities, enhancing working capital efficiency.
* Provide management with timely insights and recommendations on cash movements, trends and requirements.


Hedging & Financial Risk Management


* Develop, execute, and monitor hedging strategies for foreign exchange in alignment with corporate risk policies.
* Assess financial risks and propose mitigation strategies based on market developments and business needs.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and treasury governance frameworks.


Guarantees


* Manage the full portfolio of bank guarantees, letters of credit, parent company guarantees and other trade finance instruments.
* Oversee the issuance, amendment, extension, and cancellation of guarantees in a timely and compliant manner.
* Partner with commercial, legal, and project teams to structure trade finance solutions that support contract execution.


Bank Relationship Management


* Establish and maintain strong, strategic relationships with global banks and financial partners.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, facility structures, and service agreements to ensure optimal banking support for the business.
* Monitor banking performance, market conditions, competitive offerings to drive continuous improvement and cost efficiency.


Additional Contributions


* Liaison closely with the businesses' trade finance team on different trade finance topics
* Manage treasury reporting and ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations.
* Drive continuous improvement, automation, and digitalization within treasury processes.
* Provide guidance and support to finance team on treasury-related matters.
* Manage corporate financing activities, including credit facilities and capital structure development, as needed.

* Ability to communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.

jobs.title: Oppstartsmaskinist - VARD Brattvåg
jobs.description:
I VARD utvikler vi innovative og bærekraftige løsninger for den globale maritime industrien. Gjennom sterk ingeniørkompetanse, banebrytende teknologi og tett samarbeid designer og bygger vi noen av verdens mest avanserte fartøy.

Samtidig mener vi at menneskene våre er vår viktigste styrke. Vi legger til rette for et inkluderende og støttende arbeidsmiljø der talenter får utvikle seg, ideer blir verdsatt, og den enkelte får mulighet til å gjøre en forskjell.

Vard Brattvaag er et av VARDs norske verft og har gjennom flere tiår levert avanserte skipsbyggingsprosjekter til kunder over hele verden. Med sterk fagkompetanse, moderne fasiliteter og fokus på kvalitet arbeider vi med nybygg, reparasjon og ombygging av fartøy innen flere maritime segmenter. Som en del av VARD-konsernet bidrar vi til å utvikle fremtidens maritime løsninger.

Vi søker nå etter en Oppstartsmaskinist/ Commissioning Engineer som vil være med på laget vårt. I denne rollen får du muligheten til å bruke kompetansen din, samarbeide med dyktige kollegaer og bidra til spennende prosjekter på tvers av VARDs verdikjede.

Er du klar til å gjøre en forskjell i VARD?

Brattvåg | From Local Craft to Global Impact | Freysta


Duties and responsibilities
  • Forberedelse og utsjekk av systemer før og under oppstart
  • Oppfølging av servicepersonell
  • Regelmessige møter i igangkjøringsteamet
  • Planlegge og gjennomføre tester
  • Utsjekk av "pre-commissioning checklist" fra leverandører.
    Qualifications
    • Ønskelig med kompetansesertifikat maskinoffiser.
    • Erfaring med oppstart av nybygg er en fordel
    • Fagbrev innen relevant fagområde
    • Relevant erfaring fra skipsbygging, maritim industri eller lignende virksomhet
    • Gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper både muntlig og skriftlig
    • Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende sertifikater eller fagbrev.

    VARD jobber systematisk for inkludering og mangfold og oppfordrer alle til å søke, selv om din kompetanse ikke samsvarer 100% med det ovenfor.  

    Denne ansettelsen kan kreve bakgrunnssjekk eller sikkerhetsklarering fra Nasjonal sikkerhetsmyndighet.

    Personal qualities
    • Ansvarsbevisst og målrettet.
    • Gode samarbeidsevner
    • Kvalitetsbevist og yrkesstolthet
    • Identifiserer deg med VARDs verdier: Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship
    Our commitment to you
    • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med spennende og viktige oppgaver i et internasjonalt miljø
    • Konkurransedyktig pensjonsordning og forsikringspakke
    • Subsidiert lunsj i kantinen 
    • Subsidiert medlemskap på treningssenter
    • Bedriftshelsetjeneste
    • Gratis parkering og subsidiert lading for elektriske biler

jobs.title: PhD Stipend in Dynamic Modelling, Simulation and Optimization of Power-to-X Processes
jobs.description:
Aalborg University, Department of Energy, Campus Esbjerg, invites applications for a three-year PhD Stipend from October 1st or soon hereafter in dynamic modelling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production. The project is primarily rooted in process engineering while also addressing the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid. You will contribute to interdisciplinary research spanning process engineering, power engineering and sustainable energy systems and help develop future large-scale Power-to-X solutions.

Your work tasks
In this PhD fellowship at AAU Energy, you will work with dynamic modeling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production, such as green methanol and sustainable aviation fuel produced through Fischer–Tropsch and methanol-to-jet pathways. The project primarily focuses on the process-engineering aspects of renewable fuel production, with particular emphasis on the interactions among the electrical grid, electrolysers, fuel-synthesis processes, energy storage and heat integration in integrated Power-to-X systems.

You will develop and apply physics-based process models that describe the behavior of Power-to-X plants under varying operating conditions. This includes modelling electrolysers, fuel-synthesis units and supporting energy-system components and analyzing how these systems can operate efficiently and flexibly in response to fluctuations in renewable electricity generation, energy prices and wider energy-system conditions. The work will combine process simulation with operational optimization, techno-economic assessment and model validation.

The research will also examine the coordinated operation and control of Power-to-X processes, electrolysers and energy-storage systems in interaction with the electrical grid. You will contribute to research on grid-supporting operation and control strategies for integrated Power-to-X plants.

You will carry out your research in close collaboration with academic and industrialpartners in Denmark and across Europe. The position includes, among others, preparing scientific publications, presenting results at conferences and workshops, and participating in project meetings and activities. You will also make a limited contribution to teaching or supervision at Aalborg University, for example by supervising bachelor’s and master’s students working on relevant topics.

Your competencies 
You have, or are about to obtain, a master’s degree in chemical engineering, process engineering, mechanical engineering, energy engineering, sustainable energy engineering or a closely related field. You bring a solid foundation in areas such as process modelling, thermodynamics, heat and mass transfer, process dynamics and control, optimization or energy-system analysis, and you are interested in applying these disciplines to Power-to-X and renewable fuel production.

You have experience with process-modelling tools such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS or other related software and are motivated to develop and apply dynamic models of energy and chemical processes. You are familiar with programming languages and computational tools. Expertise in a particular software package is not required, but experience with one or more computational environments, such as MATLAB, Python or similar tools, will support your work in the project. Knowledge of Power-to-X, electrolysis, renewable fuels, process integration or energy storage will be advantageous.

Knowledge of electrical power systems, electricity markets, grid integration or the control of grid-connected energy systems would strengthen your profile but is not a requirement for the position. The core academic profile sought is within process engineering or a related discipline. You should have an interest in and motivation to learn about the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid, including how process-level operation and control affect plant flexibility and system-level performance.

You are able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research environment. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues and external partners and are comfortable discussing technical ideas across disciplinary boundaries.
You have good analytical abilities, scientific curiosity, and the ability to document and communicate your work clearly in writing and presentations. You have strong written and spoken English skills suitable for scientific collaboration and publication. We value your motivation and potential to develop across disciplines, and you are not expected to have prior expertise in every aspect of the project from the outset.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
You will join the Fluid & Process research group at AAU Energy, Campus Esbjerg, where you will become part of an international and interdisciplinary research environment combining process, chemical, energy, and electrical engineering. The group works with modeling, simulation, control, optimization, and experimental validation of fluid and energy systems, with applications including Power-to-X, carbon capture and utilization, green fuels, and sector coupling. The working culture is collaborative and informal, with close interaction among academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, PhD fellows, and students. We share an ambition to contribute to the green transition through research with practical relevance.

At Campus Esbjerg, you will work alongside academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, and PhD fellows across a range of energy-related disciplines. The campus setting supports close day-to-day collaboration across disciplines and research projects.

Collaboration with industry is an important part of the research environment, and many research and student projects are developed with external partners to address real-world engineering challenges. We aim to provide a supportive working environment with a healthy balance between professional commitments and life outside work.

The fellowship offers strong opportunities for professional and academic development.
As part of the three-year PhD program, you will conduct independent research under supervision and complete PhD courses corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS.
Courses may be taken at Aalborg University or other relevant institutions in Denmark and abroad. You will have opportunities to participate in specialized courses, summer schools, international conferences, and project workshops. The position will also provide experience in scientific publishing, research dissemination, teaching or student supervision, interdisciplinary project work, and collaboration with industrial partners.

AAU Energy offers access to modern experimental and computational facilities supporting research in sustainable energy systems. At Campus Esbjerg, these include facilities for thermal and fluid processes, electrical engineering, power electronics, renewable-energy control, offshore energy systems, and Power-to-X.

The research environment is being further strengthened through the C-TECH initiative, which is establishing a modular test site for carbon capture, electrolysis, and methanol synthesis at Campus Esbjerg. The facility is intended to support research, education, and industrial collaboration in Power-to-X and carbon capture, utilization, and storage. This creates an attractive setting for a PhD project connecting process modeling with industrial validation and integrated sustainable-energy systems.

Campus Esbjerg is located in one of Denmark’s major energy and offshore hubs, providing favorable conditions for collaboration with companies involved in renewable energy, Power-to-X, offshore technologies, and the wider energy transition. The relatively compact campus supports close professional relationships, close interaction with supervisors and colleagues, and collaboration across research and educational activities.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (4-5 pages), that:
    describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
When pursuing a PhD at Aalborg University, you'll receive a stipend which includes both salary
and pension benefits. The base salary starts at a minimum of 31.242,75 DKK before taxes, with an
additional 18,07% added for pension contributions. However, the final salary can be negotiated
based on your qualifications and experience, with seniority playing a key role in determining the
main salary.
Read more about pension options here.

At Aalborg University's Doctoral School, engineering PhD students enjoy unique career
development opportunities. These include personalized DISC profile assessments with feedback,
career-focused courses, and networking events with trade unions, employers, and other relevant
parties. Learn more about these initiatives at our Career Hub.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish) 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Vantage Support Group provides specialist workforce and compliance services for pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities and hyperscale data centres throughout Denmark.

  • Pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities

  • GMP production areas

  • ISO 14644 classified cleanrooms

  • Critical environments within hyperscale data centres

  • Technical installations and commissioning areas

The role requires exceptional attention to detail and strict compliance with contamination control procedures, client requirements and health & safety regulations.

  • Clean technical installations and critical infrastructure.

  • Carry out GMP-compliant cleaning within pharmaceutical production areas.

  • Perform post-construction and commissioning cleaning within hyperscale data centres.

Language Requirements

Communication

Additional language skills are considered an advantage when working in international teams.

Personal Profile

  • Flexibility regarding working hours.

  • Ability to work within multinational teams.

We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on some of Europe's most advanced technical facilities.

jobs.title: Director Sales and Key accounts
jobs.description:
You already know the maritime industry. You know who makes the decisions, why change takes time and why a trusted relationship matters more than a polished sales pitch.

Source2Sea combines the reach of a global maritime marketplace with the intelligence of a procurement platform. We are looking for a Global Key Account Director to join our Commercial team. Our people are our greatest assets and the driving force behind our mission, which is to enable ‘Shop with Insights. Spend with Confidence’.

We don't just digitalize procurement. We make it smarter. By combining marketplace reach with procurement intelligence, we help shipping companies, ship managers, caterers and suppliers make better purchasing decisions through data-driven insights, recommendations and intelligent procurement tools. We create value beyond the individual transaction, enabling buyers to gain greater visibility and control over spend while helping suppliers grow through digital collaboration.

Source2Sea is part of Wrist Group, the world leader in the field of procuring and delivering supplies to the maritime industry with a turnover in 2024 of more than DKK 5.7 billion.

Reporting to our CEO, you will become part of a strong and exciting commercial team. The position is based in Copenhagen.

Summary

The successful candidate will have excellent door opening skills at highest level in the industry - either through own network, via contacts or by creating an appealing proposition which begins a meaningful communication.

You are motivated by building B2B relationships – challenging customers to rethink how maritime procurement can create greater value through digitalization and data. Through active listening and strong problem solving skills, you are able toprobe and understand the customers pain points and opportunities, and can unlock these in a tangible way.

We expect you to have a “digital-first” mindset and to be the driving force within your area of responsibility; to build long-term partnership while managing day to day relationships.

Your primary responsibilities in this role will be:

Since Source2Sea is in high growth mode the tasks will be broad and varied and a high level of adaption to customer needs is expected. In other words you will be required to roll up your sleeves.

  • The predominant part of the role will be opening doors to shipping companies, listen and understand their business challenges and demonstrate how Source2Sea creates value through our marketplace and procurement platform.

  • Tactical planning and pipeline management to ensure a prioritized approach towards the right customers, based on their individual position, needs and likelihood to embark on the digital journey.

  • Drive customer dialog until commitment to trade on Source2Sea, while gradually looping in the Customer Success team, who will handle the onboarding process and experience.

  • Bring strategic customer insights back into Product, Customer Success and Leadership to help shape the continued development of the Source2Sea platform.

  • Create and maintain sales/account plans for target clients (forecasting, planning, budget management, follow-ups, etc.).

  • Together with the commercial team you will be planning and aligning buyer pipeline category and geographical needs with matching supplier pipeline.

We are looking for these Qualifications & Requirements:

  • A “digital-first” mindset, with the ability to see and sell the benefits of being digital.

  • Door opener and relationship builder, with a documented network with the ability to engage senior executives through a consultative, value-driven sales approach.

  • Minimum 7 years of sales experience at management level.

  • Experience in the maritime industry - from either Shipowner, Ship Manager, Supplier or Service Provider.

  • Active listener with strong problem solving skills.

  • Curiosity – it is not enough to ask "What?”. You want to know “Why?”

  • Ability to travel min. 7 days / month is expected.

In return we offer:

  • A combination of a financially robust enterprise that also offers a scale-up approach.

  • The opportunity to shape the future of maritime procurement.

  • Cutting edge use of technology incl. AI, driving efficiency and a unique customer experience – with a documented strong Net Promotor Score.

  • A modern, agile and forward-looking scale-up without legacy constraints.

  • An international team – currently 7 locations and +10 nationalities.

  • Highly digital and maritime-skilled colleagues to learn from.

  • A combination of working from home and at the office.

  • A professional and challenging job in a global company with an ambitious growth strategy.

  • High impact on own role with great personal development and growth opportunities.

  • The salary and benefits will correspond to your qualifications and results.

Visit www.source2sea.com or our LinkedIn profile to learn more about our great digital scale-up.

About Source2Sea

Source2Sea combines the reach of a global maritime marketplace with the intelligence of a procurement platform. We enable ‘Shop with Insights. Spend with Confidence’ across provisions, stores, spare parts and other vessel supplies through structured digital catalogues, intelligent procurement tools, actionable insights and recommendations.

By connecting shipping companies, ship managers and caterers with a global network of maritime suppliers, Source2Sea creates value beyond the individual transaction. The marketplace provides global supplier reach, greater choice and structured digital catalogues, while the platform transforms the maritime industry's strongest data foundation into greater spend visibility, smarter purchasing decisions, increased automation and more efficient supplier collaboration and growth.

Developed in close collaboration with leading shipping companies and suppliers, Source2Sea already supports global customers at scale and continues to expand its international supplier network and platform capabilities.

Source2Sea is an independent company founded and funded by Wrist Group, the global leader in marine supply and logistics. The venture was established in collaboration with BCG X in 2021 and is headquartered at Woods Augusthus in Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Sanitør til skadeservice | bliv en del af Ocab Sjælland
jobs.description:
Hos Ocab hjælper vi mennesker og virksomheder videre efter brand-, vand- og skimmelskader. Vi søger nu en sanitør, der har lyst til en hverdag med ansvar, faglige udfordringer og et stærkt fællesskab.
 
Som en del af vores team bliver du en vigtig brik i arbejdet med at begrænse skader og hjælpe kunderne godt videre. Vi ved, at en hurtig og professionel indsats kan gøre en stor forskel – både for bygninger og for de mennesker, der bliver berørt.


Om jobbet

Som sanitør hos Ocab får du en alsidig hverdag med opgaver hos både private kunder, virksomheder og forsikringsselskaber. Du arbejder tæt sammen med dine kolleger, men får også et stort selvstændigt ansvar i de enkelte opgaver.

Du bliver en del af et erfarent team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok – uanset om opgaven er stor eller lille.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Blotlægning og nedrivning i forbindelse med vandskader

  • Skimmelsanering

  • Opsætning og tilsyn med affugtningsudstyr

  • Dokumentation af opgaver fra start til slut

  • Deltagelse i vores døgnvagtsordning

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere om den bedste løsning for kunden

Derudover kan du også komme til at arbejde med

  • Asbestsanering

  • Sanering efter skadedyr

  • Rengøring og sanering efter brandskader

  • Oprydning og rengøring i forbindelse med socialsager

Vi forestiller os, at du

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager ansvar og møder dine kolleger og kunder med en positiv indstilling.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra skadeservice eller lignende branche – erfaring med skadeservice er en fordel

  • Har asbestbevis eller erfaring med asbestsanering (en fordel, men ikke et krav)

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt

  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og sætter en ære i at levere et godt stykke arbejde

  • Er fleksibel og trives i en hverdag, hvor planerne kan ændre sig

  • Er en god holdspiller, som bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø

  • Bor på Sjælland, så du har en rimelig afstand til de opgaver, du bliver tilknyttet

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise en straffeattest.

Vi lægger stor vægt på både dine faglige kompetencer og dine menneskelige kvaliteter. Derfor opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen – uanset baggrund, køn eller erfaring.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice og industriservice. Hver dag hjælper vi private, virksomheder og offentlige kunder med at begrænse skader og genetablere bygninger efter blandt andet brand-, vand- og klimaskader.

Hos Ocab bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed, moderne udstyr og engagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag

  • Dygtige kolleger og et stærkt sammenhold

  • Løn efter overenskomst

  • Pension og sundhedsordning

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge

  • Normal arbejdstid mandag-fredag kl. 07.00-15.00

  • Deltagelse i døgnvagtsordning

Arbejdssted: Sjælland

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette
kandidat.


Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakt driftsleder Stefan Nissen på + tlf. +45 25 10 16 42.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@ocab.dk


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!
