Er du drevet af at formidle og videregive din faglighed og erfaring?

Brænder du for at udvikle en ny uddannelse i tæt samarbejde med dygtige og engagerede kolleger, studerende og lokale virksomheder? Så kan det være dig, vi står og mangler til vores studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved efter- og videreuddannelsen i Automation og Drift.

Absalon etablerer september 2027 ny diplomingeniøruddannelse i Robotteknologi og automation. Diplomingeniøruddannelse i Robotteknologi og automation vil indgå i en tæt sammenhæng med diplomingeniøruddannelsen i Maskinteknologi og efter- og videreuddannelsen på akademiniveau i Automation og drift.

På ingeniøruddannelserne er det vores ambition at uddanne de bedste ingeniører i Danmark. Vi målretter vores uddannelse til arbejdsmarkedet ved at samarbejde tæt med den danske maskin-, automations- og procesindustri samt virksomheder og andre aktører i Biotekbyen Kalundborg og i Campus Kalundborgsamarbejdet, der bl.a. rykker ind i et nyt campusbyggeri i september 2028. Læs meget mere her. https://www.biotekbyen.dk/

Din profil
Vi søger en underviser, der brænder for at uddanne inden for grænseområdet mellem robotteknologi, automation, maskinteknologi og Industri 4.0. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i nedenstående:

Du er en dygtig og motiverende underviser, der er engageret i de studerende. Du bidrager sammen med dine kolleger til at skabe et aktivt, fagligt og socialt studiemiljø. Og det er vigtigt, at du kan bidrage positivt til den nære faglige relation, vi har mellem undervisere og studerende.

Du medvirker til at få det faglige, det praktiske og samarbejdet til at fungere godt. Vi er mere end en arbejdsplads, og vi drives af et stærkt kammeratskab og en fælles faglig interesse.

Du har lyst til at indgå i et arbejdsfællesskab og være med til at etablere en ny uddannelse. Vi opbygger og udvikler løbende vores ingeniøruddannelse, og meget skal gøres for første gang. Med den rette profil får du en central rolle i beskrivelsen og opbygningen af ny uddannelse med fokus på robotteknologi og automation Bl.a. skal vi i gang med at indrette og skaffe det rette udstyr til kommende robot- og automationslaboratorier.

Hvis du har indsigt i industriens behov for ingeniørkompetencer inden for robot og automationsområdet, vil det være en fordel.

Du har desuden nemt ved at indgå i dialog med virksomheder, både i forhold til muligheder for efter- og videreuddannelse og hvad angår samarbejde med studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne

Din ingeniørfaglighed kommer i spil i undervisningen, vejledningen og sparringen med kolleger inden for dele af følgende områder:
  • Integration og programmering af industrirobotter, f.eks. Universal robots, ABB, KUKA, FANUC
  • Siemens TIA-portal
  • Industrielle netværk
  • Vision-systemer og sensorteknologi
  • Safety-systemer og CE-mærkning
  • Integration af AI i robot- og automationsløsninger
  • PLC-, HMI- og SCADA-løsninger
  • CAD og 3D print
  • Teknisk dokumentation inden for maskin- og el-området.

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • har en baggrund som ingeniør og er gerne lektorbedømt
  • har relevant erhvervserfaring inden for ingeniørfaget
  • kan undervise på dansk og også gerne på engelsk.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som underviser på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved Automation og Drift har du en række forskellige opgaver i løbet af en arbejdsuge.

Undervise og projektvejlede de studerende. Du skal primært undervise og vejlede de studerende teoretisk og værksteds- og projektbaseret inden for dine fagområder. Du skal selv tilrettelægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisningen og samtidig være med til løbende at udvikle undervisningen.

Undervise på efter- og videreuddannelse (EVU) og på grunduddannelse. Du skal undervise studerende på fuldtidsstudium såvel som kursister med et fuldtidsarbejde ved siden af deres uddannelse på EVU. Til undervisningen på EVU kan også knytte sig opgaver med opsøgende kontakt til virksomheder og præsentation af uddannelsesudbud.

Fagligt samarbejde som en del af hverdagen. Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor du sparrer og samarbejder med dine kolleger. Sammen sørger I f.eks. for at tilrettelægge gode undervisningsforløb, udvikle undervisningsmaterialer, og måske er der et arrangement tilknyttet centret, som skal stables på benene.

Har du erfaring med og interesse i enkelte administrative opgaver vil det være en fordel. Ligesom det vil være en fordel, hvis du har interesse i at spille en central rolle i etablering af ny uddannelse inden for robotteknologi.

Undervisningen på de forskellige uddannelsesudbud vil fortrinsvis være på vores Campus Kalundborg, men på EVU-området kan der forekomme undervisning på Absalons campus i Roskilde. Du skal være forberedt på, at noget undervisning kan foregå i weekend eller på aftener.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver ansat i Centre for Engineering and Science, som driver uddannelserne Bioanalytiker, Radiograf, Diplomingeniør i bioteknologi, Diplomingeniør i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelserne Diplomuddannelse i bioteknologi, Procesteknologi og kemi, Akademiuddannelse i Automation og Drift, samt Akademiuddannelse i Innovation, produkt og produktion.

Du bliver en del af et team med uddannelsesledere, adjunkter og lektorer. På vores uddannelser i Kalundborg er vi 20 ansatte undervisere, og ved Diplomingeniør i Maskinteknologi er vi fem lektorer og en adjunkt fast tilknyttet. Vi arbejder på at skabe den bedste ingeniøruddannelse i tæt samarbejde med biotekindustrien i Nordvestsjælland samt vores engagerede studerende. Vi værdsætter høj faglighed og løser opgaver samt udfordringer i fællesskab, hvor vi alle er bevidste om vigtigheden af at bidrage til fællesskabet og til centrets samlede målsætning.

Vi holder til i nybygget campusbygning fra 2021 og i nabobygningen Helix Lab. Fra 2028 vil vi være en del af nyt Campus Kalundborg-byggeri.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 41.232, - kr. inkl. pension. For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 53.537, - kr. inkl. pension. Der er mulighed for at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg på baggrund af kvalifikationer og erfaring.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med ansættelse pr. 1. oktober 2026, meget gerne før
  • Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder Jesper Stensbo Knudsen, jesk@pha.dk, 7248 3224
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 14. august 2026
  • Vi forventer at afholde samtaler løbende, dog senest i uge 34 og 35.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

For stillingen gælder det, at du ansættes som adjunkt eller lektor alt efter dine kvalifikationer.

På Absalon er adjunkturet en 3-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og hvor alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

Als wichtiger Teil dieser Gruppe bietet die team SE mit ihren rund 350 engagierten Mitarbeitenden zentrale Dienstleistungen, die diese Mission in allen Geschäftsbereichen der team Gruppe vorantreiben.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du eine zentrale Verantwortung für die Risikosteuerung im Energiehandel. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Power‑ und Gas‑Portfolios über Ländergrenzen hinweg transparent, kontrolliert und im Einklang mit der konzernweit definierten Risikobereitschaft gesteuert werden.

- Bewertung von risikoadjustierter Performance (VaR, Margin‑at‑Risk, P&L‑Attribution)

Dein Profil:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium in Finance, Wirtschaft, Mathematik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Risikomanagement von Energiehandel (Power & Gas)
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in VaR, Margin-at-Risk, Stresstests, Backtesting
- Sicherer Umgang mit Risikomanagement-Software und Datenanalyse-Tools
- Analytische Fähigkeiten, Detailgenauigkeit und starke Entscheidungsstärke
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Deutsch sowie Teamfähigkeit
- Du bringst Kenntnisse in Datenmodellierung und Systemintegration mit
-

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager (Procurement) - Corporate Services
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is growing quickly, and our Corporate Services needs are becoming more complex. We’re looking for a Sourcing Manager, Corporate Services to own strategic sourcing and supplier management across critical areas of our company.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with Finance, Legal, InfoSec, Privacy, IT, Compliance, HR, and Facilities to lead sourcing processes, negotiate commercial terms, manage supplier performance, and help teams make clear decisions across cost, quality, speed, risk, and experience.

We’re opening this role to bring strategic sourcing support earlier into the decision-making process, helping leaders clarify the right approach, surface trade-offs, and move faster with confidence as Notion scales. Done well, this role will drive savings and cost avoidance while helping us build supplier agreements that protect the business and support how our teams work.

You’ll be a close partner to our HR and Facilities teams in particular, building sourcing plans that translate business needs into the right supplier strategy, sourcing motion, and negotiation posture.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Deliver measurable savings and cost avoidance across Corporate Services spend, helping fund new initiatives while protecting service quality.

 - Build strategic procurement plans with business partners, starting with HR and Facilities/Real Estate, translating business needs into clear sourcing strategies and negotiation plans.

 - Operate as an extension of stakeholder teams—surfacing trade-offs early, aligning on decisions, and driving clean execution without last-minute fire drills.

 - Partner closely with Legal and Finance to structure deals the business can live with: clear commercial terms, understood budget impacts, and risk-aware contracting.

 - Reduce risk across our vendor portfolio by strengthening contract coverage, supplier governance, and performance management routines.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5+ years of experience in sourcing, procurement, category management, or a related field, including 3+ years owning Corporate Services categories such as Facilities/Real Estate, HR Services, Travel, Marketing Services, or Contingent Workforce.

 - Experience independently leading complex sourcing events end to end, including RFx, supplier evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.

 - Strong business judgment and analytical rigor, including spend analysis, benchmarking, building business cases, and measuring savings/cost avoidance.

 - Deep understanding of source to contract and procure to pay practices, with the ability to guide teams through intake, approvals, vendor onboarding, POs, and contract handoffs without slowing the business down.

 - Strong cross-functional partnership with teams such as Legal, Finance, InfoSec, Privacy, IT, and Compliance, including command of key commercial and legal terms and a track record of reducing risk while delivering value.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $180,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

Your Tasks

Onboarding & Training

We will conduct mandatory onboarding sessions, including:

  • Site tour of the warehouse

  • Introduction to the team

  • Safety training and warehouse procedures

  • Operational training and work instructions

Onboarding activities will take place from August through the end of October.

Availability Requirements

To become part of the Salling Group team, we are looking for candidates who can commit to the following:

September – Mid November

  • Available for 1–3 shifts per week

  • Ability to attend mandatory onboarding and training activities

Mid November – End of December (Peak Season)

  • Available for 4–5 shifts per week

  • Willing to work weekends when scheduled

  • Ability to stay committed throughout the entire peak period

During this period, we will aim to schedule you on the same shift pattern to provide stability and consistency.

 

Flexibility is Important

A successful team member is someone who can also be available on-call.

This means that in cases of:

  • Sickness absence

  • Shift cancellations

  • Increased operational demand

We will call you if you are assigned to an on-call shift, and expect you to go to the shift – all shifts will be visible in your shift plan.

 

Shifts

Day Shift (includes weekends in the peak season)

  • 07:00 – 15:00

Evening Shift (only during peak season)

  • 15:00 – 23:00

Night Shift (only during peak season)

  • 23:00 – 07:00

From August until November, you will be booked mainly for day shifts, training will also be during day shifts.

Due to continued growth and an increasing patient demand, they are looking for an experienced Fertility Specialist to join our clinical team.

Whether you are seeking a permanent position or a flexible part-time opportunity alongside your current role, we would like to hear from you.

The Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a highly skilled multidisciplinary team where quality of care, collaboration and professional development are central to everything we do.

Unlike many fertility clinics, our clinical setup allows for an excellent work-life balance:

  • Flexible working arrangements and no work at the weekends.

  • Modern private clinic with highly experienced teams

  • Opportunity to influence clinical development

For candidates with the right experience and ambitions, there may also be the opportunity to develop into a Responsible Physician role in the future.

Your Responsibilities

As a Fertility Specialist, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality fertility care throughout the patient journey, including:

  • Conducting consultations with IVF and IUI patients, including fertility assessments and evaluation of pregnancy potential.

  • Planning and managing ovarian stimulation protocols for IVF and IUI treatment.

  • Performing ultrasound examinations and follicular monitoring.

  • Performing hysterosalpingo-contrast sonography (HyCoSy/HSU).

  • Performing oocyte retrieval procedures.

  • Performing embryo transfer procedures.

  • Performing TESA procedures.

  • Diagnosing and managing fertility-related conditions, including PCOS and endometriosis.

  • Managing treatment-related complications, including infection, bleeding and ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS).

  • Managing egg donation programmes, including donor assessment and evaluation.

  • Managing acute complications related to assisted reproductive treatment.

  • Developing and maintaining clinical treatment protocols and guidelines.

  • Interpreting laboratory results, including blood tests.

  • Performing donor approval and donor work-up in accordance with applicable regulations.

  • Contributing to the training, supervision and professional development of clinical staff.

Your Profile

We are looking for a physician who:

  • Is a licensed medical specialist within Obstetrics & Gynaecology

  • Has experience within reproductive medicine and assisted reproduction

  • Is passionate about delivering outstanding patient care

  • Works independently while contributing positively to a multidisciplinary team

  • Enjoys a collaborative, quality-focused clinical environment

  • Communicates confidently in English

Why Denmark?

Denmark is internationally recognised as one of the world’s leading countries within reproductive medicine and fertility treatment.

Living and working in Denmark offers:

  • Excellent work-life balance

  • High professional standards

  • Modern healthcare system

  • Safe society with a high quality of life

  • International working environment

The clinic also offers help with providing accommodation for the days you’ll be working at the clinic.

Interested?

If you are an experienced Fertility Specialist looking for a rewarding opportunity in one of Scandinavia’s most respected private fertility clinics, we would be delighted to have a conversation with you.

VKAREN.DK søger produktionsmedarbejdere til Dan-Foam i Aarup
jobs.description:
Vi tilbyder længere vikariater i en velrenommeret virksomhed, hvor der er fokus på din trivsel!

Kan du sige ja til at du er mødestabil og klar på nye udfordringer? Så læs mere her!

Om jobbet:

VKAREN.DK søger altid nye engagerede produktionsmedarbejdere til Dan-Foam i Aarup. Der er tale om længerevarende vikariater med opstart løbende og med gode muligheder for forlængelse og fastansættelse.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil primært foregå i madrasafdelingen, hvor du skal montere betræk på madrasserne. Her står du sammen med en kollega, hvor I sammen monterer betrækket ved hjælp af en maskine. Arbejdet kræver, at du er i fysisk god form, da det kan være tungt og med gentagende bevægelser, og størstedelen af arbejdet foregår stående.

Du er i tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger hele tiden, og det gode samarbejde er altafgørende for, at I lykkes. Du får en høj grad af frihed under ansvar, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger i teamet skal sikre, at alle opgaver løses på bedste vis.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har truckcertifikat, så du kan hjælpe med at flytte paller, hente materialer eller løse andre forefaldende opgaver – det er dog ikke et krav til stillingerne.

Vi søger løbende medarbejdere til både dag- og nathold.

Arbejdstider dag:

·         1. uge: onsdag-torsdag 07-19.

·         2. uge: mandag-tirsdag og fredag-lørdag 07-19.

Arbejdstider nat:

·         Søndag-tirsdag 19-07.

·         Onsdag-fredag 19-07.

Vi forventer:

Det er ikke afgørende, at du har relevant erhvervserfaring, da der er en grundig oplæring. Vi forventer dog, at:

·         Du trives med fysisk arbejde i højt tempo.

·         Du har en høj arbejdsmoral og går til opgaverne med engagement.

·         Du er fortrolig med IT og er ikke bange for at benytte det i din hverdag.

·         Du taler, læser og skriver dansk.

·         Det er en fordel med truckcertifikat, men det er ikke et krav.

Din profil:

Som kollega møder du ind med en positiv indstilling og en arbejdsgejst, der smitter af på dine kollegaer. Du er god til at holde hovedet koldt, selv når det går stærkt, og dine kolleger kan altid regne med dig. Du er mødestabil, kvalitetsbevidst og pligtopfyldende samt en holdspiller, der gerne strækker sig lidt ekstra for at hjælpe en kollega. Den samme indstilling vil du opleve fra dine kolleger, og det er dét, der gør jer til et godt team.

Vi tilbyder:

Vi tilbyder en spændende mulighed i en velrenommeret virksomhed, hvor der er en sund kultur, og hvor godt kollegaskab vægtes højt. Du bliver en del af en global, succesfuld virksomhed med en førende position og stærke kvalitetsbrands. Koncernen er ambitiøs og kontinuerligt i udvikling, og du bliver en del af en veletableret og professionel kvalitet set up med engagerede og fagligt kompetente kolleger.

Når du starter, vil der være et nøje planlagt oplæringsforløb, og du vil blive taget imod med åbne arme på din første dag. Der er mulighed for køb af mad i kantinen, og du har desuden muligheden for at benytte dig af virksomhedens motionsrum.

Din løn og øvrige ansættelsesvilkår er efter gældende overenskomst.

Om virksomheden:

Dan-Foam er Tempur Sealys centrale produktionsenhed til det internationale marked. Virksomheden udvikler, producerer og håndterer et enestående, men også komplekst produktprogram bestående af puder, madrasser, sengesystemer og accessoires, som sælges i mere end 90 lande.

Ansøgning:

Er du interesseret i stillingen, så tøv ikke med at sende dit cv og en ansøgning til jobfyn@vkaren.dk, mrk. ”Produktionsmedarbejder – Dan-Foam”.

Vi holder løbende samtaler og lukker rekrutteringen, når vi har fundet de rette kandidater.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte os på tlf. 70152010 alle hverdage mellem kl. 09.00 og 16.00.

jobs.title: VP, Communication
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is changing who gets to build software. As an agentic software creation platform, Replit enables anyone, from individual creators to teams inside the world’s largest companies, to turn natural language into applications, internal tools, dashboards, workflows, websites, and software that solves real problems.


We are looking for a Director or VP of Communications to help lead Replit’s next chapter of storytelling, reputation building, and market awareness.


This is a senior communications role for a creative, strategic, and hands-on leader who can help build and scale the communications function as Replit grows from a beloved developer platform into a defining company in AI, software creation, and enterprise transformation. This person will help own Replit’s external and internal communications strategy, including company narrative, media relations, analyst relations, executive communications, internal communications, crisis communications, customer storytelling, policy-related communications, and global awareness.


The role requires someone who can push through the noise and make the Replit story heard and for it to be a part of the narrative at all times. The Director / VP of Communications will help develop a compelling narrative that evolves with the company, the product, and the market, and deliver that narrative to the audiences across media, policymakers, partners, customers, potential ones and employees.The role will also support Replit’s international awareness, with a focus on key markets in Europe and Asia.


This person must be both strategic and execution-oriented. They should have been able to build a comms function at a fast-growing technology company or have been the second in command at one. But, this is not to be seen as a traditional press office role of taking a playbook from one company and adopting it in its entirety at Replit.


The person must be able to be creative, scrappy, maybe even spiky, to take what they know to work as a foundation and then build on it to make Replit a unique player that can punch above its weight in a very crowded and competitive marketplace.



ROLE

 - Help lead and scale Replit’s communications function, including communications strategy, team structure, agency management, operating rhythms, and execution standards.

 - Develop and evolve Replit’s corporate narrative as the company expands across AI, developer tools, enterprise, consumer, education, and global markets.

 - Lead communications programs across company announcements, product launches, enterprise momentum, customer stories, partnerships, policy-related issues, executive visibility, awards, events, and thought leadership.

 - Shape how the market understands Replit as an agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language.

 - Build clear, credible narratives around AI-powered software creation, developer productivity, enterprise adoption, security, governance, education, and the future of work.

 - Partner with the CEO, executive team, and functional leaders on positioning, reputation, media strategy, internal communications, and high-stakes company moments.

 - Build and maintain strong relationships with technology, business, AI, enterprise, developer, policy, and international media.

 - Partner closely with product, engineering, marketing, sales, partnerships, legal, policy, people, and finance to create coordinated communications programs that support company priorities.

 - Lead or support internal communications, including company meetings, leadership messaging, employee announcements, change communications, and moments that help the company stay aligned as it scales.

 - Manage proactive and reactive communications, including rapid response, issues management, crisis communications, and sensitive topics.

 - Prepare executives and spokespeople for media interviews, podcasts, conferences, customer events, internal moments, and industry presentations.

 - Support Replit’s global communications strategy, with particular focus on expanding awareness in Europe and Asia.

 - Track the AI, software, developer, enterprise, startup, and policy landscape to identify where Replit should lead, respond, or reframe the conversation.

 - Build a communications culture that values speed, clarity, creativity, judgment, and proof.



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.

 - 12+ years of experience in communications, PR, media, corporate affairs, or related fields for Director level; 15+ years for VP level.

 - Experience building, scaling, or significantly expanding a communications function at a fast-growing technology company.

 - Proven experience working directly with founders, CEOs, executives, and senior cross-functional leaders.

 - Strong relationships with technology, business, enterprise, AI, developer, and/or policy media.

 - Experience managing external agencies and cross-functional communications programs on a global level

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages for users, developers, enterprise buyers, employees, policymakers, partners, and the press.

 - Strong understanding of the AI landscape and how AI is changing software development, enterprise productivity, and the future of work.

 - Experience across several communications disciplines, including external communications, internal communications, media relations, executive communications, crisis communications, and strategic messaging.

 - Ability to translate complex technical ideas into clear, compelling stories without losing substance.

 - Cross-functional leadership experience, with the ability to influence and collaborate across product, engineering, sales, marketing, legal, policy, finance, and people teams.

 - Ability to see the big picture while operating in execution mode.

 - Passionate about their craft and the impact they can have

 - Strong judgment in fast-moving, high-pressure environments.

 - A creative, resourceful, “do more with less” mindset.

Replit is changing who gets to build software. What started as a platform for developers has become an AI-powered creation platform where individuals, teams, and enterprises can turn ideas into working apps, internal tools, dashboards, workflows, and websites faster than ever before. The company has had a fair amount of success with the outside world and in customer traction, particularly on the enterprise.



We are looking for an Enterprise PR Lead to help tell that story to the audiences that matter most: CIOs, CISOs, CFOs, business leaders, developers, analysts, partners, customers, and the press.



This role will own communications for Replit’s enterprise marketplace, customer momentum, and business adoption. You will help position Replit as the AI platform that gives every team in an organization the ability to build, ship, and solve problems securely, without waiting months for traditional software cycles.



The work will span the full range of enterprise communications: product launches, partnership announcements, customer stories, competitive positioning, analyst engagement, executive visibility, conference moments, speeches, thought leadership, vertical storytelling, and proof points that show how enterprises are using Replit to move from idea to production.



You will work closely with Replit’s sales, partnership, marketing and leadership teams to shape narratives that resonate with both technical and business audiences. The right candidate understands the enterprise technology landscape and can operate comfortably across media, analysts, influencers, customers, partners, and internal teams. They should be able to explain why Replit matters in a world where AI is changing how software gets built and have the ability to change and evolve fast given the competitive nature of this marketplace.



Strong writing is essential. So is judgment. This person must be able to take complex ideas such as AI agents, software creation, security, governance, procurement, developer productivity, business transformation, and competitive differentiation, and make them clear, credible, and compelling.



This is a role for someone who can help Replit punch above its weight in the enterprise conversation and make sure the market understands the scale of what Replit is building.




ROLE

 - Lead enterprise communications for Replit, including product, partner, customer, vertical, executive, and competitive narratives.

 - Build and evolve the messaging for Replit with the enterprise, with a focus on AI-powered software creation, secure adoption, governance, productivity, and business impact.

 - Develop communications programs around enterprise momentum, including customer adoption, partner announcements, use cases, and market proof points.

 - Build relationships with enterprise technology, business, AI, software, developer, and industry reporters.

 - Create compelling customer stories that show how companies are using Replit

 - Partner closely with sales and marketing to support enterprise campaigns, launches, events, customer references, and field narratives.

 - Work with product teams to translate technical capabilities into clear stories for business, developer, and enterprise audiences.

 - Engage analysts and influencers who shape the enterprise AI, software development, developer productivity, and CIO agenda.

 - Develop executive thought leadership for Replit leaders, including speeches, bylines, conference narratives, briefing documents, and social content.

 - Shape competitive positioning in a fast-moving market that includes AI coding tools, developer platforms, low-code/no-code platforms, hyperscalers, and enterprise software companies.

 - Identify opportunities for Replit to lead conversations around the future of software creation, AI agents, governed enterprise adoption, and business-led development.

 - Move quickly between strategic messaging work and same-day communications needs without sacrificing quality or precision.



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building relationships with enterprise technology, business, AI, software, developer, and industry press.

 - Ability to work directly with customers and partners to develop credible, specific, high-impact stories.

 - Comfort partnering with sales, marketing, product, partnerships, and executive teams.

 - Strong instincts for positioning in a competitive and fast-moving market.

 - Ability to make complex technical topics understandable without flattening what makes them important.

 - Ability to move between long-arc narrative building and urgent, same-day turnarounds.

 - Strong writing skills across formats, including blog posts, briefing documents, launch materials, bylines, social content, speeches, messaging docs, and customer stories.

 - Experience in enterprise communications across one or more areas such as product, partner, customer, vertical, executive, or competitive communications.

 - A strong understanding of how C-suite, developers, and business leaders evaluate, adopt, and govern new technology.

 - An understanding of AI tools and the changing landscape.

 - A genuine interest in how AI can expand who builds software, while understanding the importance of security, governance, and responsible adoption.

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-changing environment where priorities shift and the market moves quickly.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10 to 15+ years of communications experience, ideally in B2B technology, SaaS, AI, developer tools, enterprise software, cloud, security, or productivity platforms.

 - Experience across multiple enterprise communications disciplines, including product, partner, customer, vertical, analyst, and executive communications.

 - Experience communicating to both technical and non-technical enterprise audiences.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're redefining how software is built and who gets to build it. Our mission is to achieve Autonomy for All: making programming accessible, collaborative, and powered by AI. Realizing that vision requires a platform that legitimate users can trust and adversarial actors cannot exploit.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to help build Replit's Trust & Safety and Anti-Abuse program from the ground up. You'll turn noisy behavioral, identity, payment, infrastructure, and content signals into the measurement systems, detections, and decisions that protect Replit's users, platform, and economics. You'll work closely with Engineering, Support, Legal, Security, Infrastructure, Money, and Growth to make abuse economically unviable while keeping friction low for legitimate users.



Replit sits at the frontier of AI-native abuse. Our platform is a target for phishing and scam hosting, cryptomining, LLM token farming, card and coupon fraud, referral abuse, and increasingly, abuse driven by AI agents themselves. You'll help define how we identify, measure, and respond to these threats without compromising the experience of good users.



WHO YOU ARE

You're a data scientist who moves fast, goes deep, and thinks adversarially. You can spin up an analysis in hours that would take others days, not by cutting corners, but because you've built the intuition and technical toolkit to get to the right answer quickly. You dig past the top-line abuse rate to understand selection effects, missing labels, policy changes, attacker adaptation, and the false positives hidden inside an aggregate metric.

You understand that Trust & Safety data is imperfect and outcomes are high stakes. Ground truth is delayed, biased, and often incomplete; attackers react to defenses; and an apparently effective rule can quietly harm legitimate users. You pressure-test your own work, quantify uncertainty, and distinguish correlation from evidence strong enough to justify enforcement.

You use AI agents and tools aggressively to multiply your output: writing code, exploring data, generating hypotheses, and prototyping investigations. But you treat every AI-assisted output as a draft, not a deliverable. You know what good analysis looks like and won't ship anything that doesn't meet that bar.



YOU WILL

 - Own the analytical foundation for Trust & Safety, including abuse prevalence, fraud loss, false-positive and false-negative rates, time to detect, time to mitigate, appeal and reversal rates, and verification step-up conversion.

 - Build reliable datasets and dbt models that connect product events, account and identity signals, payment activity, infrastructure usage, content classifications, enforcement actions, appeals, and support outcomes.

 - Develop and evaluate risk models, rules, and anomaly-detection systems for threats such as phishing, scam hosting, cryptomining, token farming, payment fraud, promotional abuse, and AI-agent exploitation.

 - Design rigorous offline evaluations, shadow-mode tests, holdouts, and controlled experiments to measure detection quality and the user impact of new policies, enforcement actions, and progressive verification.

 - Define thresholds and decision frameworks that balance abuse reduction, economic loss, customer friction, and false positives across free, paid, and enterprise users.

 - Investigate emerging abuse patterns, quantify their impact, identify coordinated behavior, and turn ambiguous signals into clear recommendations for product and engineering teams.

 - Develop predictive models that estimate account, device, transaction, workspace, or deployment risk and embed those signals into detection, review, and escalation workflows.

 - Partner with Support and Legal to improve case review, appeals, reason-code quality, and feedback loops so human decisions become useful model and policy signals.

 - Build monitoring that detects model drift, attacker adaptation, data-quality failures, and unexpected harm to legitimate users.

 - Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical partners, including the tradeoffs, uncertainty, and evidence behind high-impact decisions.



EXAMPLES OF WHAT YOU COULD DO

 - Build a measurement framework for Replit's abuse surface, reconcile incomplete labels across automated detections, human review, appeals, chargebacks, and support cases, and establish a trustworthy baseline for the first time.

 - Design and evaluate a risk-scoring model for suspicious account clusters using identity, device, payment, graph, and product-behavior signals, then define thresholds that materially reduce fraud while protecting legitimate users.

 - Analyze a phishing detection rule that appears highly precise, uncover that it disproportionately bans paying users with legitimate brand references, and redesign its evaluation and review path to reduce false positives.

 - Measure a progressive verification "ladder of trust," determining when to step users up to additional verification and quantifying the tradeoff between abuse prevented and legitimate-user conversion lost.

 - Detect coordinated token-farming or promotional-abuse networks by combining account-linkage graphs, referral behavior, payment patterns, and infrastructure usage, then partner with Engineering to operationalize the findings.

 - Evaluate a new enforcement policy in shadow mode, estimate its counterfactual impact, and recommend whether to launch, revise, or reject it before any users are affected.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of experience in data science, product analytics, fraud, risk, trust and safety, or a related field.

 - Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience working with large behavioral datasets and building reliable data models or pipelines.

 - Experience developing and evaluating predictive models, experiments, or decision systems, with sound judgment around uncertainty and tradeoffs.

 - Ability to turn ambiguous data into clear recommendations and communicate them effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

 - Comfort working with imperfect labels, biased samples, and high-impact decisions where false positives matter.

 - You use AI tools extensively to increase your effectiveness while maintaining a high bar for analytical quality.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building or evaluating anti-abuse, fraud, identity, security, spam, integrity, or content-safety systems at scale.

 - Built, shipped, and maintained ML models in production (classification, anomaly detection, or risk scoring), including feature engineering on behavioral and transaction data, threshold selection against precision/recall economics, and post-launch monitoring

 - Experience with graph analysis, entity resolution, coordinated-behavior detection, reputation systems, anomaly detection, or risk scoring.

 - Experience measuring false positives and enforcement harm, designing human-review workflows, or using appeals and case outcomes as model feedback.

 - Familiarity with progressive verification, KYC, account trust, or identity providers such as Prove, Persona, Socure, or Stripe Identity.

 - Experience with causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, propensity score methods, synthetic control, or uplift modeling.

 - Experience with a modern data stack such as dbt, BigQuery, Snowflake, Fivetran, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Segment.

 - Experience at a consumer platform, developer tool, cloud provider, marketplace, fintech company, or other product with a meaningful adversarial surface.



BONUS POINTS

 - You've built AI-powered analytical tools, investigation systems, automated detections, or novel measurement approaches.

 - You have experience with AI-native abuse such as prompt injection, LLM token farming, model extraction, or agent-driven abuse.

 - You understand freemium, usage-based, or promotional pricing models and the abuse incentives they create.

 - You've worked directly with operational review teams and can translate analytical signals into practical playbooks, queues, and escalation paths.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect - MENA
Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Hyderabad Infra team builds and maintains Notion's internal async task runner and configuration management platform. The async task runner plays a critical role in ensuring our millions of users have a fast, reliable, and secure experience. The configuration management platform enables safe, explicit configuration management for Notion's product and infrastructure engineers.



As part of the Hyderabad Infra Team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape how Notion manages and scales its async task runner and configuration management platform, enabling innovation across the company.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - You will contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our async task runner to meet the needs of over 100 million global users and support the rapid growth of our product and business.

 - With guidance from senior team members, you'll help ensure our systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. You'll evaluate and integrate new technologies to keep us ahead of emerging challenges.

 - Your work will empower our engineering team to build features confidently while you grow your skills in distributed systems and infrastructure.

 - You will develop the skills and confidence to debug live production systems with minimal disruption, whether replacing components or managing failovers. You will participate in an on-call rotation, responding to incidents to uphold service reliability and quickly restore normal operations.

 - You will partner with product engineers and other infra teams to ensure our platforms align with evolving business needs and product goals.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - A software developer with at least 4 years of experience and the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

 - Systems thinker: You understand distributed systems and can design solutions that account for tradeoffs like consistency, latency, and scalability.

 - Pragmatic problem-solver: You prioritize business impact and understand the balance between craft, speed, and long-term maintainability. You’re opinionated but not ideological, and you learn new technologies as you go.

 - Ownership and initiative: You thrive in a fast-moving, unstructured environment and are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous problems. You act with a bias toward action and focus on results.

 - Customer Empathy: You excel at collaborating across teams, offering guidance and solutions to unblock engineers and support them in building reliable systems. With empathy at the core of your approach, you focus on addressing the needs of those who depend on the async task runner.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Driftskoordinator / Køkkenkoordinator
jobs.description:
Freya Service ApS søger en engageret og erfaren Driftskoordinator / Køkkenkoordinator til vores voksende team. Stillingen kombinerer ledelse, medarbejderstyring, kundekontakt og praktisk køkkenarbejde. Den rette kandidat bliver en vigtig del af at sikre høj kvalitet i vores serviceleverancer og samtidig støtte vores køkkenteams, når der er behov for det.

Arbejdsopgaver

  • Planlægge, koordinere og administrere daglige vagtplaner og medarbejderfordeling ved hjælp af Planday og andre planlægningssystemer.

  • Følge op på medarbejdere på forskellige arbejdspladser og sikre en stabil daglig drift.

  • Kontrollere medarbejdernes fremmøde samt check-in og check-out tider for at sikre korrekt tidsregistrering.

  • Have daglig kontakt med medarbejdere og kunder via telefon, beskeder og e-mail.

  • Opbygge og vedligeholde gode relationer med eksisterende kunder samt hjælpe med at finde nye samarbejdsaftaler og kontrakter.

  • Besøge kundernes arbejdspladser for at følge op på kvalitet, medarbejdernes arbejde og kundetilfredshed.

  • Rekruttere, oplære, støtte og motivere medarbejdere for at sikre en professionel arbejdsstyrke.

  • Håndtere akutte ændringer i vagtplaner og finde løsninger ved sygdom eller ekstra bemandingsbehov.

  • Sikre at virksomhedens regler, hygiejnekrav og arbejdsprocedurer bliver overholdt.

  • Bidrage til forbedring af arbejdsgange og effektivisering af den daglige drift.

  • Hjælpe med administrative opgaver, herunder brug af regnskabsprogrammer og interne systemer.

  • Arbejde cirka 40 % af tiden som kok, hvor du støtter vores køkkendrift ved travle perioder.

  • Tilberede mad af høj kvalitet og sikre gode standarder for fødevaresikkerhed og hygiejne.

  • Træde til og hjælpe kokke og køkkenpersonale, når der er behov for ekstra støtte.

Kvalifikationer

  • Minimum 2-3 års erfaring fra professionelt køkken.

  • Godt kendskab til asiatisk, dansk og europæisk madlavning.

  • Erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen, vikarbranchen, hospitality eller et travlt køkkenmiljø er en fordel.

  • Gode ledelses- og medarbejderhåndteringsevner.

  • Erfaring med Planday og gerne kendskab til regnskabs- og administrationssystemer.

  • Gode organisatoriske evner og evne til at løse problemer hurtigt.

  • Kan håndtere flere opgaver samtidig i en travl hverdag.

  • Gode kommunikationsevner på engelsk. Dansk er en fordel.

  • Kørekort er en fordel, da jobbet indebærer besøg hos kunder. Der vil være mulighed for støtte til at tage kørekort gennem et kørekursus.

  • Ansvarsbevidst, stabil, initiativrig og serviceminded.

Vi tilbyder

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

  • Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling i en virksomhed i vækst.

  • Et professionelt og støttende arbejdsmiljø.

  • En varieret stilling med ansvar for drift, medarbejdere, kunder og køkkenarbejde.

  • Mulighed for at få en vigtig rolle i udviklingen og væksten af Freya Service ApS.

jobs.title: Head of Thin Film Processing - DTU Nanolab
jobs.description:
DTU Nanolab offers a truly unique opportunity, we are seeking a Head of Thin Film Processing, a position that has not been open for more than 20 years.

At DTU Nanolab we operate at the intersection of academia and industry, creating a unique environment for research, innovation and collaboration. Being Head of Thin Film Processing offers a rare chance to step into a central role within one of Denmark’s most advanced research and technology facilities.

We are looking for an experienced nanofabrication manager who can lead a team of highly experienced process specialists while advancing state-of-the-art technologies and driving the development and optimization of new process flows.

The role demands strong technological insight, solid leadership capabilities, and the ability to navigate a complex and ambitious professional environment. In return, we offer a position with significant influence, where you will help shape the future of nanotechnology.

Job content
As the Head of Thin Film Processing, you will be overall responsible for processes and tools related to plasma etch and deposition of materials. This includes but is not limited to ICP and RIE etchers, PECVD, LPCVD and PVD as well as ALD and relevant in-line characterization equipment (SEM, AFM, XRD, XPS, ellipsometry). You will interact with and advise both academic and industrial users, you will identify needs and participate in the procurement of new equipment and be responsible for processes and material cross-contamination rules related to new and existing tools. In this role, you will provide strategic and operational leadership for a team of highly experienced process specialists, while contributing as an active member of DTU Nanolab’s core management team. We foster a supportive and collaborative working environment with a strong team spirit, and expect you to lead with curiosity, pragmatism, and a solution-oriented mindset.

Furthermore, you will take part in projects that will expand DTU Nanolab’s technological capabilities and expertise in close interaction with research groups and other academic and industrial collaborators. Additionally, you will play a significant part in DTU Nanolab’s ongoing efforts to strengthen collaboration across the Nordic countries and EU, within for example: EuroNanoLab, Nordic Nanolab Network or EU Chips Joint Undertaking efforts.

Qualifications
You must have a Master of Science degree and a Ph.D. degree within a relevant field, such as Micro/Nanofabrication, Physics, Microelectronics, or similar. Industrial experience is a distinct advantage.

We expect you to have:
  • At least 10 years of experience within cleanroom fabrication related to etch and deposition of various materials.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with both academic and commercial users
  • Broad knowledge of nano-fabrication methods such as lithography (UV, DUV, e-beam), wet chemical etching, dry etching, thin film deposition and process characterization, backend and packaging on a wafer level scale.
  • In depth knowledge of plasma processes for deposition and etching of materials (ICP, RIE, PECVD, LPCVD, PEALD and sputter).
  • In depth knowledge of non-plasma processes (anneal, oxidation, diffusion doping, RTP, ALD, thermal and e-beam PVD).
  • Several years of experience with process development including process yield and process windows.
  • A broad understanding of the micro- and nanofabrication industry and an in depth understanding of its requirements, challenges and timelines.
  • Deep knowledge of common semiconductor materials like silicon, various oxides and metals.
  • Experience and understanding regarding cleanroom, chemical and electrical safety.
  • Proven leadership experience, including responsibility for leading highly skilled technical staff.
  • Fluency in English - both spoken l and written, preferably also Danish but at least an interest and ambition to learn Danish.

Furthermore, it is desirable that you:
  • Are communicative, proactive and curious.
  • Are self-driven and team oriented.
  • Have the ability to inspire and engage others.
  • Have a wholehearted enthusiasm for semiconductor fabrication technology.
  • Have several years of relevant industrial experience.

At DTU Nanolab, safety is a top priority, and we are looking for candidates who can thrive in a highly safety-conscious environment and meet the following physical and mental requirements:
  • Is able to work in an environment where it can be necessary to wear specialized safety and protective equipment.
  • Is able to respond quickly and effectively in emergency situations, including evacuation in case of alarms.
  • Is able to perform tasks that require work while standing up and mobility for longer periods.
  • Is mentally able to handle work with potentially hazardous chemicals and gases in accordance with our mandatory safety procedures.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC).

In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The position is a full-time position. Starting as early as possible with respect to mutual agreement.

As Head of Thin Film Processing, you will directly report to the Director of DTU Nanolab.

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus, located approximately 10 km north of Copenhagen.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 20 September 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates.

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Jörg Hübner, Director, jhub@dtu.dk or +45 2278 5157.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Nanolab is a common infrastructure and research facility located at and fully owned by the Technical University of Denmark, DTU. The core facilities consist of a large cleanroom and a state-of-the-art electron microscopy center. The research activities carried out at DTU Nanolab span from nano- and microfabrication with Silicon-based materials, carbon and polymers to the highly sophisticated analysis of nanoscale materials in hard and soft matter.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.title: Team Leader – Night Shift Operations
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead one of our most critical operational teams?

As our Night Shift Team Leader, you will be responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and operational management of our night shift operation, ensuring that customer deliveries are executed safely, efficiently, and on time.

You will report directly to the Operations Manager and become part of the site's leadership team.

As we operate in a GDP-regulated environment, compliance, quality, traceability, and continuous improvement are fundamental to everything we do.

 

About the Role

The Night Shift operation is responsible for the complete handling of outbound shipments, including picking, packing, and final distribution.

You will lead a team of approximately 10 employees, consisting of both full-time and part-time staff from many different nationalities and cultural backgrounds.

Working closely with the Shift Supervisor, you will ensure that staffing levels, operational flow, capacity planning, and daily priorities support an efficient, compliant, and high-performing operation.

As Team Leader, you are responsible for both people leadership and operational excellence. You will create an engaging working environment while continuously improving processes, quality, productivity, and delivery performance.

 

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Overall responsibility for the daily execution of the night shift operation

  • Leading, coaching, motivating, and developing employees

  • Ownership of operational processes and continuous process improvements

  • Ensuring compliance with GDP requirements, internal procedures, and quality standards

  • Investigating operational deviations, incidents, and quality-related issues

  • Monitoring and improving KPIs and operational performance

  • Planning staffing, capacity, and operational resources

  • Driving productivity, service quality, and delivery reliability

  • Supporting recruitment, onboarding, and employee development together with HR

  • Implementing new processes, systems, and continuous improvement initiatives

  • Collaborating closely with day shift management and support functions to ensure an efficient end-to-end operation

  • Promoting a positive safety culture and ensuring compliance with Health & Safety requirements

  • Producing products on scooter with the team

 

Your Profile

We are looking for an experienced and visible leader who enjoys creating results through people and thrives in a fast-paced operational environment.

We expect that you:

  • Have proven people management experience within warehousing, logistics, distribution, manufacturing, or similar operational environments

  • Are a hands-on leader who enjoys working close to the operation and your employees

  • Have experience with KPI management and performance management

  • Can maintain structure and overview in a complex operation with many simultaneous activities

  • Have experience working with shift-based operations and hourly-paid employees

  • Are data-driven and possess some IT skills

  • Communicate clearly and are able to create engagement and commitment across the organisation

  • Remain calm under pressure and make sound decisions in a dynamic environment

  • Enjoy working with colleagues from different nationalities and cultures

  • Lead by example and are willing to go the extra mile when required

  • Have excellent organisational skills and a strong attention to detail

  • Are fluent in both English (the company's operational language) and Danish, both written and spoken

Experience working within a GDP-regulated or pharmaceutical logistics environment will be considered an advantage but is not essential.

 

What We Offer

We offer an exciting leadership opportunity where you will have a direct impact on one of the company's most critical operational functions.

In return, we offer:

  • A key leadership position with significant responsibility

  • The opportunity to influence and develop our night shift operation

  • A professional and well-structured logistics environment

  • Close collaboration with an experienced leadership team

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Competitive salary, pension scheme, and employee benefits

  • A comprehensive onboarding programme and thorough training

 

Working Hours

This is a permanent full time position of 37 hours per week. The ordinary night shift schedule is distributed across six working days according to a fixed roster. The precise daily working hours, including paid working time and breaks, are stated in the employment contract.

You will work six days per week according to a fixed roster.

Scheduled working hours are between 00:00 AM to 07:00 AM.

Flexibility is expected during periods of high operational demand, employee absences, vacations, or other business requirements.

Salary
Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

The guaranteed salary, including eligible fixed salary components and pension contributions, will meet the applicable minimum salary requirement under the Danish Supplementary Pay Limit Scheme

Location

Nordsjælland, Denmark

Interested?

If you would like to become part of a professional organisation where quality, compliance, and operational excellence are at the heart of everything we do, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled once the right candidate has been identified.

egeplast is a highly innovative manufacturer of plastic pipe systems for underground utility infrastructure – ensuring a reliable supply of clean drinking water, heat and electricity, as well as access to high-speed internet. You fit in with us:

- You have completed a technical degree or a master craftsman qualification, for example in pipeline construction, plant engineering or HVAC.
- You have gained practical professional experience, for example as a site manager, project manager in a planning office or sales representative for piping components or similar products.
- Good knowledge of the relevant target groups and an existing network within the market are desirable.
- You are highly self-motivated and work in a structured and independent manner.
- You have strong communication and negotiation skills and are confident in dealing with different customer groups.

- You are able to convince others of innovative and sustainable product solutions.

Company

jobs.title: Job i udlandet - Dansk onlinecasino søger kundeservicemedarbejder
jobs.description:
Vi søger en dygtig kundeservicemedarbejder til vores kontor i Gzira, Malta med opstart hurtigst muligt. Din primære opgave bliver at besvare indkomne skriftlige henvendelser fra vores kunder via e-mail og chat. Vores mål er at sikre, at alle kunder modtager professionel vejledning og den bedst mulige service. Der vil desuden være mulighed for at få flere ansvarsområder i takt med dine præstationer og kompetencer.

Som kundeservicemedarbejder er service din vigtigste opgave. Du skal have lyst til at formulere dig skriftligt, være løsningsorienteret og brænde for at yde en fremragende kundeoplevelse. Ingen opgave er for stor eller for lille, når det handler om at hjælpe vores kunder.

Dine opgaver:

  • Besvare kundeforespørgsler via e-mail og chat.

  • Sikre, at komplekse kundehenvendelser bliver løst hurtigt og tilfredsstillende.

  • Yde teknisk support og vejledning om spil.

  • Overvåge hjemmesidens tilgængelighed og funktionalitet samt rapportere fejl og problemer.

  • Deltage i test af nye produkter og tjenester.

  • Medvirke til at promovere nye produkter og kampagner.

  • Bidrage til andre arbejdsopgaver i virksomheden efter behov.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er serviceorienteret, udadvendt, hjælpsom og imødekommende.

  • Har fremragende skriftlige danskkundskaber og gode engelskkundskaber.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og motiveret for at nå interne mål.

  • Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljer.

  • Har erfaring med digitale arbejdsopgaver – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Gode muligheder for udvikling og ansvar

  • Danske kollegaer med et danske chefer

  • Sociale arrangementer

  • Hjælp med praktiske ting ved flytning til Malta

  • 150 euro til flybillet

  • Relocationpakke, så du kommer godt fra start med bolig

Stillingen er på fuld tid og omfatter vagter alle ugens syv dage, fordelt på fem ugentlige vagter inden for tidsrummet kl. 08.00–21.00.

Lokation: Gzira, Malta. Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os.

jobs.title: Senior SCADA Consultant (m/f/d) (Software-Architect)
jobs.description:
Do you want to contribute to a secure, reliable construction and operation of renewbale assets for a international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry? PEAK Wind is looking for a Senior SCADA Consultant who can be an integrated part of our SCADA and Cyber Security team, ensuring best-in-class deliverables for our clients, and building a bridge between technical, commercial, and operational OT and SCADA assets.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of renewable energy assets. We take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and Independent Power Producers among our clients.

Solution-driven Senior SCADA Consultant with Technical Network Know-how
Based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, or Zaragoza you will be supporting clients in all aspects of the project lifecycle, from early development to operation.

We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative way of working. SCADA and Cyber Security is a key area for our clients and receives increased attention on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across different disciplines ensuring seamless integration, operation, and Cyber Security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Drafting and reviewing requirements suppliers and service providers of OT systems, SCADA, and Cyber Security for renewable assets, mainly within onshore and offshore wind
- Negotiating SCADA and Cyber Security requirements in various supply and service contracts on behalf of our clients
- Designing basic network archtiecture and identifying functional requirements from network designes
- Supporting operational teams on OT, SCADA, and Cyber Security investigations and improvements
- Identifying and integrating technical upgrades, new systems, and functionalities
- Managing sub-suppliers for performance management, defining maintenance, and optimizing the reliability

Experienced SCADA Consultant with a holistic mindset:
We are looking for a candidate with knowledge within OT/SCADA systems and Cyber Security. You have broad experience working with SCADA, critical OT or IT systems, across the array of different systems used in production environments. Furthermore, you are familiar and used to working with security standards such as ISO270xx, IEC62443, NERC-CIP, or similar. Knowledge of industrial computer networks is an advantage but not a requirement.

Irrespective of your background, you are solution-oriented and like to find smarter and more efficient ways to solve problems. You are motivated by solving problems and finding solutions that work in the real world and not just on paper. Preferably you have experience in project management or experience from a Supervisor position, which has given you commercial awareness and the ability to work independently. Experience in the wind turbine industry will also be considered an advantage.

The ideal candidate is self-driven, proactive, and has a solution-oriented attitude. You are a good communicator with a proven ability to build sound business relationships and represent them in project meetings and presentations. As PEAK Wind is an international company, you need to have good English communication skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

Interested and want to know more?
If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.

PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. - You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills
